c7bfc0940748593a8173.title: Promotional Products Operations Coordinator
c7bfc0940748593a8173.description:
**About IMC Designs**

IMC Designs operates in the advertising specialties and promotional products industry, helping businesses promote their brands through customized merchandise and branded products. Promotional merchandise can support corporate marketing campaigns, customer appreciation programs, employee recognition initiatives, trade shows, business events, and other brand-building activities.

Coordinating these services requires accurate product information, organized customer orders, timely communication, supplier coordination, and careful attention to customization requirements and delivery schedules.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Promotional Products Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day coordination of promotional product orders, supplier communications, order documentation, and customer requirements. This position is ideal for a professional who enjoys managing multiple priorities, maintaining accurate records, resolving operational issues, and helping ensure that promotional products move efficiently from order placement through fulfillment.

**Job Summary**

IMC Designs is seeking a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator to help manage the administrative and operational processes associated with customized promotional merchandise and branded product orders.

The coordinator will support order entry, product specification reviews, supplier follow-ups, order status tracking, artwork and customization coordination, shipment monitoring, and customer communication. The role will help ensure that product details, quantities, pricing information, customization instructions, and delivery requirements are accurately documented and communicated to the appropriate parties.

Working with sales representatives, customers, suppliers, designers, and fulfillment partners, the coordinator will help identify order discrepancies, follow up on outstanding information, monitor production and delivery timelines, and maintain organized records throughout the order lifecycle.

This position is well suited for an organized professional with experience in operations coordination, order management, administrative support, customer service, purchasing, or production coordination. Familiarity with promotional products, branded merchandise, print production, or advertising services is beneficial but not required.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join IMC Designs and develop valuable operations experience in the advertising services and promotional products industry. As a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator, you will help support the processes that turn customer branding requirements into completed promotional product orders.
* You will gain practical experience in order management, supplier communication, product customization coordination, delivery tracking, and customer support while working with multiple stakeholders to keep projects organized and moving forward.
* The work arrangement offers the opportunity to perform coordination and administrative responsibilities from an approved remote location while developing transferable skills in operations, procurement support, account coordination, and order fulfillment. Compensation, equipment provisions, and other employment benefits will be confirmed by the employer.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate promotional product orders from initial order documentation through production, shipment, and fulfillment.
* Enter, review, and maintain accurate order records, including customer information, product descriptions, quantities, pricing, customization details, shipping addresses, and requested delivery dates.
* Review product specifications, artwork instructions, imprint methods, color requirements, and branding details to identify missing information or potential discrepancies before orders proceed.
* Communicate with suppliers and vendors to obtain product availability updates, pricing information, production timelines, artwork approvals, and shipment details.
* Track order progress and maintain updated records of pending approvals, production status, backorders, shipping information, and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate the exchange of artwork files, logos, proofs, and customization instructions among customers, designers, sales representatives, and suppliers.
* Follow up on outstanding customer approvals, supplier confirmations, purchase orders, and other documentation required to keep orders moving forward.
* Monitor production and delivery schedules, identify potential delays, and communicate changes to the appropriate internal teams and customers.
* Assist with preparing and reviewing purchase orders, order confirmations, invoices, shipping documents, and other operational records as assigned.
* Maintain organized electronic files, order documentation, supplier information, and customer communication records using company-approved systems.
* Coordinate with sales and account management teams to clarify customer requirements, resolve order discrepancies, and support timely customer updates.
* Help investigate issues involving incorrect product specifications, missing merchandise, delayed shipments, customization errors, or incomplete order documentation.
* Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports that provide visibility into order status, outstanding tasks, supplier responses, and fulfillment progress.
* Support invoice and order reconciliation by comparing documented product quantities, pricing, shipping charges, and order details when applicable.
* Prioritize multiple orders and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and clear communication in a remote work environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve order tracking, documentation standards, supplier follow-up procedures, and other operational workflows.
* Handle customer, supplier, pricing, and business information responsibly in accordance with company policies.
* Perform additional administrative and operational coordination duties as needed to support promotional product order fulfillment.

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in business administration, operations management, supply chain management, or a related field is preferred.
* Approximately 1–3 years of experience in operations coordination, order processing, customer service, purchasing support, administrative operations, production coordination, or a similar role preferred.
* Experience maintaining accurate records and coordinating multiple orders, projects, requests, or deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing product specifications, quantities, pricing, customization requirements, and delivery information.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, or Google Workspace for managing spreadsheets, correspondence, documentation, and order trackers.
* Familiarity with order management systems, customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, inventory systems, purchasing software, or project management tools is an advantage.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with customers, suppliers, designers, sales teams, and fulfillment partners.
* Ability to follow up proactively on outstanding information, identify discrepancies, and help resolve operational issues before they affect order completion.
* Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize competing priorities in a remote work environment.
* Ability to work independently, maintain productivity, and communicate progress effectively without continuous direct supervision.
* Reliable internet access and a suitable remote workspace, subject to the employer's remote-work requirements.
* Experience with promotional products, branded merchandise, custom apparel, print production, corporate gifts, or advertising services is preferred but not required.
* Ability to learn product terminology, customization processes, supplier procedures, order workflows, and company-specific business systems.
* Commitment to accuracy, customer service, confidentiality, and consistent follow-through.

**Additional Benefits**

* This position offers an opportunity to build practical experience in promotional products operations, order coordination, supplier communication, and customer support within the advertising services industry.
* The role also provides opportunities to develop transferable skills in order management, procurement support, project coordination, and fulfillment operations that can support future career growth.

Join our team as a Promotional Products Operations Coordinator if you’re passionate about streamlining processes, leading innovative programs, and delivering exceptional promotional solutions that elevate our brand presence!

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

2cb682e3b665122e93ec.title: Catering Project Coordinator
2cb682e3b665122e93ec.description:
**Location: Telecommute**
  
**Job Type: Contract**
  
**Compensation Range: $20 - 30 per hour**
  
  
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented **Catering Project Coordinator / Operations Analyst** to support a new catering initiative for a leading restaurant organization. This individual will play a key role in managing order fulfillment, monitoring restaurant capacity, and coordinating communication across internal teams and external partners.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing high volumes of orders, and using data and tracking tools to ensure smooth daily operations. This is a hands-on coordination role that requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Load balance a high volume of orders (10-200) across 58 restaurants.
* Review each restaurant's order volume to ensure total capacity remains under daily and time-period thresholds.
* Execute a multi-step order transfer process, including communication with 3+ parties and logging all transfer activity.
* In ad-hoc instances, engage the RSC Team and Field Operations Leaders to align on next steps and execute.
* Schedule and send order confirmation emails to Guests via Outlook using established templates.
* Communicate with internal teams and third-party partners:
* Provide internal updates for alignment (RSC Team).
* Share order updates with Restaurants for awareness (Field Operations).
* Coordinate software troubleshooting with the Third Party support team.
* Competencies
* Quickly learns new browser-based software.
* Proficiencies:
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft Outlook
* Internet browser
* Ability to follow step-by-step instructions.
* Strong organization skills and attention to detail for handling a high volume of tactics at high
* speed.
* Strong written communication skills.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 1-3+ year of experience in operations, marketing support, order management, customer service, or administrative coordination.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (sorting/filtering, basic formulas; pivot tables a plus) and Microsoft Outlook (templates, scheduling).
* Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive tasks with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience following standard operating procedures and documenting activity in logs or trackers.
* Clear, professional written communication for internal and external audiences.

4982c7923d7db93c7f4d.title: Sales Operations Specialist (100% Remote)
4982c7923d7db93c7f4d.description:
Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world.
  
  
ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations.
  
For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.
  
  
**The kind of people we look for:**  

* Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
* Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
* Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
* Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
* Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
* Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

**Summary:**  
The Sales Operations Specialist serves as a key operational partner to the Sales organization by coordinating reporting, systems support, process administration, and performance tracking activities. The role maintains sales performance metrics, supports customer relationship management (CRM) and business systems, assists with sales events and enablement initiatives, and coordinates cross-functional projects to help improve productivity, efficiency, and execution. Through accurate reporting, effective communication, and operational support, the position helps ensure sales teams have the tools, information, and resources needed to achieve business goals.
  
  
**What This Role Does:**  
Sales Operations, Analytics & Business Performance
  

* Maintains sales performance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking tools.
* Compiles and analyzes sales activity, conversion rates, installations, cancellations, and revenue data to support reporting needs.
* Prepares reporting, analysis, and presentation materials to support sales leadership meetings, business reviews, and operational initiatives.
* Performs data validation and reporting audits to help ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Sales Process, Systems & Operational Excellence
  

* Leads and supports initiatives designed to improve sales processes, operational efficiency, and workflow effectiveness.
* Develops, updates, and maintains standard operating procedures (SOPs), documentation, and process guides.
* Assists with the administration of Salesforce and other sales systems, including reporting support, data maintenance, and user assistance.
* Partners with Business Operations and Technology teams to support system enhancements, process updates, and user adoption efforts.

Sales Enablement, Event Operations & Field Support
  

* Coordinates operational activities for sales events, lead generation programs, and community outreach initiatives.
* Develops, tracks, and reports event performance metrics, including attendance, leads, conversions, installations, and revenue results.
* Assists with event logistics, inventory management, materials preparation, and budget tracking.
* Maintains sales enablement resources, onboarding materials, and field support tools to promote consistent execution across sales teams.

Cross-Functional Project Leadership
  

* Leads and supports cross-functional projects involving Sales, Marketing, Finance, Training, Recruiting, Technology, and Business Operations.
* Coordinates project activities, timelines, communications, and deliverables to support successful implementation.
* Assists with tracking project progress, identifying potential issues, and escalating concerns as appropriate.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You Will Bring:**  

* An associate degree is required; a bachelor's degree is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* A minimum of five (5) years of experience in sales operations, business operations, sales enablement, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of sales operations principles, performance management, forecasting, pipeline analysis, and KPI reporting.
* Knowledge of CRM platforms, sales technologies, reporting tools, and data management practices, including Salesforce and business intelligence solutions.
* Experience in analyzing complex data sets, identifying trends, and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Skilled in developing dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance metrics that support operational and strategic decision-making.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Technology, Training, Recruiting, and Business Operations functions to create a high-quality, results-driven, team-oriented environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly through presentations, reports, and executive summaries.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and driving adoption of new processes, systems, and operational initiatives.
* Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.
* Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
* Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed and travel up to 10%, which may include occasional overnight travel.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and modern communication tools for virtual teams (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Slack).

**Physical Demands:**  
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with documented disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodations would impose an undue hardship. Employees seeking accommodation should contact the People Department to initiate the interactive process.
  
  
Employees may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time:
  
  

* Sitting, standing, and walking (90-100%)
* Keyboarding (95 - 100%)
* Viewing computer monitor, tablet, and cell phone requiring close vision (70-90%)

**Work Environment:**  
**100% Remote with Travel:** Primarily works indoors from a home office or at customer, vendor, or business locations. Approximately 10% travel is required and may include driving, overnight stays, out-of-state trips, and exposure to varying weather conditions.
  
  
**Compensation:**  
$62,000 to $78,000/yr plus Inside Sales Team Bonus determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity considerations. Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. For details on our comprehensive benefits program, visit www.clearcaptions.com/careers to explore our total rewards package.

27f3001dbbd495af07ad.description:
Overview:

At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact?

As the **Specialist - OSP** **Analyst I**, you will provide outside plant project support for a geographic area. This role will work closely with our internal and external partners supporting construction projects by monitoring and auditing the inbound shipments and utilization of materials. Additionally, you will maintain inventory levels and ensure accuracy in applicable tracking systems. You will handle bill of materials and work with partners to ensure applicable receipt of construction materials with a high degree of accuracy.

This position will also be providing administrative support to internal teams to track outside plant build status, build milestones as well as utilizing trends to forecast. The Specialist - OSP Analyst will identify process and system improvements used to compile our construction/material reporting. Position will also include, but not be limited to support for outside plant construction efforts.

**This position offers remote work flexibility; however, preference will be given to candidates located within 60 miles of Appleton, Wisconsin to support in-market needs. Occasional travel to job sites and warehouse sites up to 30% of the time, or as required.**

*This position can be hired at a Specialist-OSP Analyst (2026-29982) or Specialist-OSP Analyst I (2026-29983) level depending on the skills and qualifications of the candidate. Separate job postings outline the minimum requirements for each role. Please review both postings and apply to any level for which you are qualified and interested.*

Responsibilities:

* Submits Bill of Materials (BOM) submissions required for construction project procurement. Tracks shipments and monitors damaged goods upon receipt.
* Utilization of internal GIS and material platforms to extract/submit BOMs, monitor utilization, and reconcile construction material quantities.
* Tracking of usage and remaining inventory at storage location. Ensure our inventory and usage tools are kept current (SAP, TPAT).
* Helps maintain appropriate inventory levels for applicable market and projects.
* Conduct cycle inventory counts and performs annual reconciliation as directed.
* Maintains records, documentation, and files critical to business and financial operations. Duties include filing, archiving, or retrieving records as required in support of audits, financial reporting, or other business operations. This includes working with Finance to maintain accurate and appropriate inventory levels.
* Coordinate with internal teams for the disposal, transfer, or recycling of materials as needed.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree (or higher) -OR- 4+ years professional work experience.
* 4+ years of utility construction experience -AND/OR- engineering experience
* 1+ years of analytical experience
* Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and insurance.

**Other Qualifications**

* Experience with inventory management preferred
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Excellent written and oral communications skills
* Computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new tools (i.e.: GIS, UTS, Clarity, etc.) as they are deployed.
* + Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel preferred
* Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
* Organized, self-motivated, detail orientated, analytical, able to work with minimal supervision.
* SAP Experience/knowledge
* 2+ years of telecommunications experience
* Project Management experience/exposure

Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today!

**Benefits**

Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, education assistance, and paid time off benefits such as vacation (15 days accrued per year for full-time; pro-rated for associates working between 20-39 hours), sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full-time and pro-rated for all other associates), seven paid national holidays and one floating holiday, paid parental leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment), among others. Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability coverage is also available for associates working 30 or more hours per week. Associates scheduled to work under twenty hours per week or for a limited term (i.e. interns) are eligible for medical coverage, the 401(k) plan (if 18 or older), as well as sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full-time and pro-rated for all other associates).

Click here for more specific information regarding our comprehensive well-being program.

**Who is TDS Telecom?**

TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Serving over 1 million connections, our mission is to create a better world by delivering innovative communication solutions that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Visit tdstelecom.com to learn more!

At TDS, we are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and value the difference of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives in our workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by law.

**Pay Transparency**

The listed pay range reflects the minimum and maximum base salary. Actual offers will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, location, and role-specific competencies. Some positions may also offer additional compensation, such as bonuses or equity awards.

4212b9a09f17d5b75512.description:
**Executive Assistant to the Director of Operations**

Your Child and Mine Early Learning | A Place to Grow | Personal Touch Early Learning

Department: Executive Administration & Operations

Reports To: Director of Operations

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Philadelphia, PA & Surrounding Areas

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to our Director of Operations.

This individual will serve as a key liaison between the Director of Operations, center directors, administrative staff, and leadership team to ensure daily operations run efficiently across multiple early childhood education facilities.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, professional, dependable, and capable of managing competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality and ensuring timely execution of operational responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive & Administrative Support

Manage the Director of Operations’ calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities.

Prepare meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and track action items.

Draft professional correspondence, reports, memos, and internal communications.

Organize and maintain operational documents, records, and electronic files.

Coordinate meetings with center directors, vendors, and external partners.

Follow up on delegated assignments to ensure deadlines are met.

2. Multi-Site Operations Coordination

Serve as a point of contact between the Director of Operations and individual childcare centers.

Monitor daily operational updates from center directors.

Assist in coordinating staffing needs, facility concerns, and administrative requests.

Track outstanding operational issues and follow up until resolved.

Help ensure center directors submit required reports and documentation on time.

Coordinate site visits, inspections, and leadership meetings.

3. Compliance & Documentation

Assist with organizing documentation related to DHS licensing, Keystone STARS, and other regulatory requirements.

Monitor upcoming compliance deadlines and required submissions.

Maintain organized records of inspections, corrective action plans, and licensing documentation.

Support preparation for internal audits and regulatory visits.

Track employee clearances, training requirements, and documentation in coordination with HR and center leadership.

4. Staff & Leadership Accountability

Maintain a centralized tracker of assignments delegated to center directors and administrative personnel.

Follow up on weekly priorities, operational goals, and outstanding tasks.

Collect weekly operational reports and summarize key findings for the Director of Operations.

Assist with coordinating employee onboarding, training schedules, and leadership development activities.

Escalate unresolved concerns or missed deadlines to the Director of Operations.

5. Reporting & Data Management

Compile weekly and monthly operational reports.

Track enrollment updates, staffing needs, attendance trends, and center performance indicators.

Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and task management systems.

Organize information for leadership meetings and operational reviews.

Assist with monitoring supply requests, maintenance needs, and vendor follow-ups.

6. Communication & Special Projects

Facilitate professional communication between corporate leadership and center directors.

Coordinate special projects assigned by the Director of Operations.

Follow up with vendors, contractors, and service providers.

Assist with planning company meetings, staff development days, and organizational events.

Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Minimum 2–3 years of experience in executive assistance, administrative management, or operations coordination.

Experience in early childhood education, multi-site operations, or a regulated industry preferred.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and spreadsheet management.

Experience with childcare management platforms such as Brightwheel or Childware is a plus.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

Professional discretion when handling confidential employee, family, and business information.

Strong follow-through, problem-solving, and time-management abilities.

Ability to travel between childcare locations as needed.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

Timely completion and follow-up of assigned operational tasks.

Accurate and organized reporting.

Effective communication between leadership and center directors.

Consistent tracking of compliance and administrative deadlines.

Improved operational efficiency across all assigned locations.

Ability to anticipate the Director of Operations’ needs and resolve routine administrative issues independently.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is not simply an administrative assistant, but a proactive operational partner who can anticipate needs, maintain accountability, and help keep multiple locations organized and functioning efficiently.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, communicating with multiple departments, and ensuring important tasks do not fall through the cracks.

Our goal is to hire someone who can take ownership of administrative coordination so the Director of Operations can focus on leadership, center performance, compliance, and organizational growth.

Pay: $18.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

64e6038d64cbc4f021df.title: Remote Receptionist/Administrative Assistant
64e6038d64cbc4f021df.description:
**Overview**

Our small San Diego mobile massage company with 8 to 10 mobile massage therapists is seeking someone with strong customer service skills, creative problem solving abilities, experience with spreadsheets/word processing/data entry, and booking appointments would be a big plus. Must be comfortable talking on the phone. We would need your availability to be 18 to 25 hours a week, mostly weekdays, but occasionally weekends.

Its the perfect position for a sharp, outgoing undergad who needs a flexible schedule. We were lucky enough to work with both of our last 2 undergrad Admins for several years. They are both now in their forever careers. By the end of their tenure, they were at least some familiar with all of the daily operations and challenges that come with managing an office. Between the two of them they pretty much designed all of our policies and procedures as we grew. And we are now in a new growth phase as we will be managing at least 2 new wellness operations which will be branded seperately.

**Duties**

* Answer phones and reply to email inquires with professionalism, while demonstrating excellent customer service skills.
* Manage calendar appointments and coordinate events for up to 10 Therapists over the 3 brands. Were currently using a schedule booking system which will eventually change to one that can support brands seperately.
* Handle data entry, filing, and document proofreading to maintain accurate records and ensure clarity in all communications
* Assist with bookkeeping tasks such as invoicing.
* Support client communication efforts through email correspondence, follow-ups, and information dissemination
* Perform general clerical duties including typing reports, organizing files, and managing office supplies remotely to optimize workflow

**Experience**

* Experience setting appointments is a big plus.
* Strong computer literacy with proficiency in Google Workspace, and data entry tools and scheduling.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask effectively and prioritize tasks efficiently
* Experience answering phones with professionalism and courtesy​

Set your own schedule! If the phones aren't ringing, and there is no administrative task that needs to be done, study for a final while you get paid! I am not interested in making sure you're working non-stop. I'm interested in quality work, done in a timely manner, as needed. There will he busy days and there will be slow days... but if you're an energetic professional who thrives in a remote setting you will fit right in. Join us today!

Pay: $13.00 - $17.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

c2f99cbd74cbabb03662.title: Operations Assistant
c2f99cbd74cbabb03662.description:
**About the Role**

We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Operations Assistant** to help keep our tutoring company running smoothly behind the scenes. This role sits at the center of our day-to-day operations, supporting the people, processes, and systems that enable us to deliver an excellent experience for our students and families.

You’ll work closely with our customer service team, administrative staff, and tutors to ensure tasks are completed, communication is clear, issues are addressed promptly, and nothing falls through the cracks. From coordinating team activities and tracking outstanding tasks to improving workflows and solving day-to-day problems, you’ll play an important role in keeping the business organized and operating efficiently.

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates well, and enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Coordination & Support**

* Coordinate the day-to-day activities of our customer service, administrative, and tutoring teams.
* Help ensure team members are clear on their responsibilities, priorities, and outstanding tasks.
* Follow up on action items, deadlines, and unresolved issues to ensure timely completion.
* Support onboarding, training coordination, and ongoing communication with team members.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for operational questions and day-to-day challenges.
* Identify gaps in communication, accountability, or processes and help ensure they are addressed.

**Tutor & Scheduling Operations**

* Help coordinate tutor availability, scheduling, and related administrative processes.
* Monitor tutor-related tasks and follow up on missing information, documentation, or outstanding requirements.
* Assist with resolving scheduling conflicts, tutor changes, and other operational issues.
* Help maintain accurate tutor records, internal documentation, and operational trackers.
* Support consistent communication between tutors, internal teams, and families when needed.

**Customer Service & Administrative Support**

* Support the customer service team in managing workflows, follow-ups, and outstanding customer requests.
* Help ensure inquiries, concerns, and administrative tasks are handled promptly and routed to the appropriate person.
* Monitor open issues and follow up to ensure they reach a resolution.
* Assist with maintaining accurate student records, internal systems, and company documentation.
* Provide administrative support across the business as priorities and needs evolve.

**Systems, Processes & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and update internal trackers, task lists, documentation, and operational systems.
* Help establish and maintain clear, repeatable processes for recurring tasks.
* Identify inefficiencies, recurring problems, and opportunities to improve how the team operates.
* Assist with implementing process improvements and ensuring new procedures are followed consistently.
* Keep leadership informed of operational bottlenecks, emerging issues, and items requiring attention.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive, resourceful approach to problem-solving.
* Strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple tasks without losing track of details.
* Comfort coordinating with different people and teams while keeping work moving forward.
* Ability to prioritize competing needs and adapt when circumstances change.
* Confidence using digital tools, spreadsheets, task trackers, and other administrative systems.
* Good judgment when deciding what to resolve independently and what to escalate.
* A dependable, ownership-oriented mindset with a focus on getting things done.
* Experience in operations, administration, customer service, scheduling, or team coordination is beneficial.
* Experience in education, tutoring, or another service-based business is a plus.

**Schedule & Availability**

* **Preferred working hours:** 1:00–5:00 PM Pacific Time.
* Some flexibility is required to accommodate operational needs, team coordination, and time-sensitive issues.
* Reliability and consistent availability during agreed-upon working hours are important.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Day-to-day operations run smoothly, with fewer missed tasks, delays, and communication gaps.
* Customer service, administrative staff, and tutors receive timely support and clear direction.
* Scheduling issues and operational problems are identified and addressed promptly.
* Internal systems, records, and processes remain accurate and organized.
* Team members follow through on their responsibilities, and outstanding items are consistently tracked to completion.
* Leadership has greater visibility into what is happening across the business and can trust that routine operational details are being managed effectively.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Are you generally available 1pm-5pm PST? Do you have flexibility to occasionally change or extend hours? What is your preferred working schedule/number of hours per week?
* What tools or systems have you used to keep track of multiple tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and responsibilities across different people?
* Briefly explain your experience in your most recent Operations role. What were you responsible for managing?
* Please record a short Loom video (<3 minutes) answering the following question: Tell us about a time you noticed something falling through the cracks in a previous role. How did you identify it and what did you do to fix it? Note: Applications without a Loom video URL will be discarded.

Work Location: Remote

a53546b44a218d9428d5.title: Tax Operations Administrator
a53546b44a218d9428d5.description:
**About Wealth Enhancement**

Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.

Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit www.wealthenhancement.com.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Tax Operations Administrator**!

  

This role at Wealth Enhancement Tax & Consulting Services (WETCS) is accountable, along with other members of the Tax Operations Team, for ensuring effective and efficient operations of our business. WETCS is the in-house tax services organization at Wealth Enhancement Group, a top-5 RIA (Registered Investment Advisor) wealth management and financial advisory firm with over 100 locations nationwide.

  

This role helps implement, execute, and optimize operational processes impacting WETCS clients, tax advisors, financial advisors, and internal departments that work with our Tax organization and is critical to achieving high client, financial advisor, and tax advisor satisfaction. This position helps enhance WE and WETCS brands via high-quality work output and professional, responsive, and respectful interactions with clients, and WE employees.

This is a **Remote** position.

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is **$70,000.00 to $80,000.00**, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.

**Primary Job Functions**

**Client and Financial Advisory Team Engagement (~15%)**

* Engage with clients to clarify tax operations processes, get Engagement Letters signed, and address client inquiries about tax organizers, required documents, and tax operations.
* Work with clients and Financial Advisory Teams to ensure tax documentation required by Tax Advisors to process new client referrals is available when needed.
* Follow-up with clients to get missing tax documentation and ensure Tax Advisors do not have to engage in operational tasks.
* Work with Financial Advisors to ensure clients' tax-relevant financial information and related documents are shared with Tax Advisors.
* Ensure clients and Financial Advisors are updated on work status, as needed.
* Help resolve any client and Financial Advisor issues with tax operations.

**Tax Systems Data Setup and Management (~15%)**

* Set up client, financial advisor, tax advisor, services, pricing, and other required information in tax operations systems and/or tax software.
* Enter / upload client data and documents into systems.
* Transfer client documents, as needed, to the appropriate systems storage locations.
* Review and ensure accuracy of all tax operations systems data.

**Tax Operations Workflow Management (~45%)**

* Send, track, and ensure signing of Engagement Letters.
* Prepare, send, track, and ensure completion of tax organizers.
* Manage receipt, storage and return of client tax documents.
* Process and scan/ingest client documents into tax software.
* Identify missing documents and follow up to get them.
* Gather 1099s and other tax-related forms
* Manage 8879s submissions and eFile tax returns
* Manage / update workflow statuses in tax operations systems / software
* Prepare organizers, tax returns, etc. for clients and Tax Advisors
* Resolve issues raised by Tax Advisors regarding missing documents and process
* Track regulatory notices, planning / projections / consulting services requests, etc.

**Tax Operations Process Improvement (~5%)**

* Assist in defining and implementing tax operations processes.
* Assist with measuring tax operations effectiveness and efficiency.
* Help identify areas for continuing process and systems optimization.

**Reporting, Invoicing, and Record Keeping (~10%)**

* Provide pre-defined and ad hoc reporting on tax operations.
* Create and send client invoices, manage chargebacks, and coordinate with Accounting.
* Ensure tax operations and client records are kept up to date.

**General Administrative Support (~5%)**

* Set up client appointments with Tax Advisors.
* Assist in organizing team activities / offsites.

**Foster Teamwork (~5%)**

* Build and maintain good relationships with Tax Advisors, Financial Advisors, and clients.
* Collaborate with team members to improve team effectiveness, productivity, & satisfaction.
* Share expertise and assist team members as appropriate.
* Participate in team meetings, activities and offsites.
* Contribute to maintaining a positive and fun team culture.

**Improve Service Quality by Using Ai and Digital Tools**

* Use approved AI and digital tools to simplify work, improve service quality and increase efficiency, while validating outputs for accuracy, privacy and business alignment.
* Identify and escalate inaccurate information and knowledge gaps, or issues related to digital tools.

**Education/Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Associate degree preferred.
* Bachelor's degree strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 3 years of tax operations administration experience.
* Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks or projects simultaneously.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Intermediate-level experience using Microsoft Excel, Adobe Acrobat, DocuSign, Salesforce, and CCH Axcess Document
* Collaborative; strong team-orientation.
* Positive solution-focused attitude.
* Calm and focused under pressure.
* Highly organized and diligent.
* Strong process and detail orientation.
* Drive for results and excellence.
* Must be willing to work long hours during peak tax seasons.
* Proficient at using AI and digital tools.

*WEG hires employees and makes decisions about their salary qualifications based on factors such as the role to be performed; educational and professional experience, qualifications, skills and credentials; tenure, cost-of-living and demand for the role in the applicable market. To comply with state, pay transparency laws, we must disclose the entire salary grade. The entire salary grade for those who are classified as this level is $77,261.00 - $97,600.00. However, the base salary range bolded above ($70,000.00 to $80,000.00) is what we expect to pay as a starting range for this position.*

7d60d5ac8ba6977b24b5.title: Salesforce Administrator
7d60d5ac8ba6977b24b5.description:
Summit School Services companies share a strong commitment to provide the highest level of transportation safety, quality transportation, outstanding customer service and positive employee relations. Our corporate headquarters, located in Warrenville, Illinois, houses the administrative and corporate support functions for the organization. Our 250+ local customer service centers (CSCs) are supported by regional operations teams located throughout North America.

We are seeking a mid-level Salesforce Administrator to help oversee, maintain, and continuously improve our Salesforce platform for a leading school bus transportation organization with 275+ end users across multiple departments and bus yard locations. This role is hands-on and combines core Salesforce administration with Business Analyst responsibilities – partnering with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable solutions across the Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Account Engagement, Experience Cloud, and Conga CPQ & Billing.

The administrator will resolve support tickets daily using Ivanti, manage work intake and delivery through a Jira backlog, and support a roadmap that includes enabling Salesforce DevOps Center within approximately the first year.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hands-on experience across a multi-cloud Salesforce platform, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Account Engagement, Experience Cloud, and Conga CPQ & Billing
* Work closely with platform leadership on a small team where your work shapes the roadmap
* Support an organization that has been transporting students safely since 1917
* Fully remote position

### 

### **Key Responsibilities**

Platform Administration & Configuration

* Administer and optimize Sales Cloud and Service Cloud to support 275+ users across multiple departments and locations, ensuring system performance, reliability, and adoption.
* Configure and maintain objects, fields, page layouts, Lightning pages, validation rules, assignment rules, approval processes, email templates, and declarative integrations where applicable.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards; partner with stakeholders to define KPIs, standardize reporting definitions, and improve data visibility and decision-making.
* Monitor Salesforce releases and proactively recommend improvements, deprecation (e.g., under-utilized fields, layouts, workflows), and platform capabilities that align to business needs.

Automation

* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation using Flow Builder (record-triggered, scheduled/auto-launched, and screen flows), including debugging, fault handling, and governance to reduce technical debt.

Security & Access Management

* Manage the user access and security model: profiles, permission sets and permission set groups, role hierarchies, sharing/restriction rules, public groups, queues, user policies, and delegated administration.
* Troubleshoot and resolve user access issues across permissions, sharing, and record visibility.

Support Operations & Work Intake

* Own and resolve support tickets daily using Ivanti, including intake/triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, and escalation as needed; track trends and recommend preventive fixes.
* Manage work intake and delivery through the team’s Jira backlog, keeping prioritization, status, and updates current.

Data Management

* Perform data management activities: imports/exports, deduplication, data quality monitoring, and ongoing hygiene using data loading tools; help define and enforce data standards.

Business Analysis

* Facilitate discovery sessions, document current/future-state processes, elicit and refine requirements, and write user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Participate in story grooming and refinement led by the Delivery Manager, and help maintain a prioritized backlog in partnership with the Director, Delivery Manager, and business owners.

Release & Change Management

* Translate requirements into solution designs, configure and test changes, and coordinate UAT (test scripts, support, and sign-off).
* Deploy changes using change sets or DevOps tools following the release process owned by the Delivery Manager, and complete post-release validation and hypercare.
* Support the Delivery Manager in enabling Salesforce DevOps Center within ~12 months, including process definition, environment strategy, and deployment governance.

Extended Platform Support

* Support and administer Account Engagement (Pardot) fundamentals as needed (prospects, segmentation, forms, engagement programs, and connected campaigns), partnering with Marketing on best practices and data alignment.
* Support and administer Experience Cloud sites as needed, including external user provisioning and access troubleshooting.
* Provide administration support for Conga CPQ & Billing (configuration support, user access, issue triage, and coordination with internal/external resources for complex changes).

Documentation & Training

* Maintain documentation (configuration notes, runbooks, data definitions, and how-to guides) and deliver end-user training for new features and process changes.

  
The salary range is $90,000 - $105,000 annually

**Qualifications**

### **Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (preferred)

Experience

* 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator supporting Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud in a production environment
* Proven expertise with Flow Builder automation and a strong understanding of declarative automation best practices
* Experience resolving daily end-user support tickets through a structured intake process, including prioritization, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation; able to analyze recurring issues and propose preventive improvements
* Comfort managing work intake and delivery through a Jira backlog
* Experience with sandbox environments, testing/UAT, and deploying changes using change sets and/or DevOps tools; familiarity with (or strong interest in enabling) Salesforce DevOps Center
* Demonstrated Business Analyst skills: requirements elicitation, process mapping, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and partnering with stakeholders to drive decisions and outcomes
* Experience administering Account Engagement and aligning marketing automation with Salesforce CRM data (preferred)
* Experience supporting Experience Cloud sites or portals, including external user provisioning and access troubleshooting (preferred)
* Hands-on experience with Conga CPQ & Billing or similar CPQ/billing solutions in a Salesforce environment (preferred)

Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model and security/access model
* Proficiency with data loading and mass update tools, with a commitment to data quality and governance
* Experience with data quality/deduplication tools, reporting standards, and KPI enablement across multiple departments (preferred)

Certifications

* Salesforce Platform Administrator (required)
* Salesforce Platform Administrator II (required, or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce Platform App Builder, Salesforce Business Analyst, Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud Consultant (preferred)

Core Competencies

* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across configurations
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions with clear tradeoffs and documentation
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality (testing mindset, regression awareness, and clean configuration)
* Customer-service orientation and ability to build trust with users across departments
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable communicating technical and functional requirements to non-technical stakeholders
* Collaborative, proactive, and continuous-improvement mindset; stays current on Salesforce major releases and admin best practices

87ee0cd7e563a441eed9.title: Field Nursing Operations Manager (Northeast)
87ee0cd7e563a441eed9.description:
* **This is a fully Remote and Work From Home (WFH) opportunity within the US, requiring up to 60% travel.**

**This Role covers Northeast states**

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Science 37's mission is to accelerate clinical research by enabling universal trial access for patients. Through our solutions; Direct-to- Patient Site and Patient Recruitment, we accelerate enrollment by expanding the reach of clinical trials to patients beyond the traditional site and rigorously qualifying patients prior to referring them to a traditional site. Our solutions are powered by a proprietary technology stack with in-house medical and operational experts that enhance quality through standardized workflows and best-in-class study orchestration.

The **Field Nursing Operations Manager** is a Registered Nurse who has experience across multiple therapeutic areas with the ability to work independently and integrate well within the Nursing Solutions Group. With interest/expertise in Science 37's decentralized model of care delivery, the Field Nursing Operations Manager is responsible for the operational oversight, implementation and daily management of all nursing activities for clinical research studies within their region at Science 37. The Field Nursing Operations Manager ensures the professional delivery of patient care in compliance with all federal and state regulations, Good Clinical Practice, and Standard Operating Procedures. In addition, the Field Nursing Operations Manager coordinates with other departments to help carry out company objectives and ensures compliance with study protocols.

This position manages a specific location region, the role will be 40% Administrative and 60% Travel.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Duties include but are not limited to:

* Supervise all nursing activities related to the assigned Region.

* Deploy across regions to provide targeted study coverage, aligning specialized nursing background with corresponding therapeutic trial requirements

* Ensure the safety of study participants and per diem mobile research nurses within the assigned Region.

* Provide a safe environment for study participants, caregivers, and study personnel at all times through compliance with all federal, state, and professional regulatory standards. Maintain strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.

* Collaborate with per diem mobile research nurses on helping to solve issues, educate on aspects of the role and assigned studies, and act as a resource support.

* Ensure the quality of data collection and timely data entry into the Science 37 Platform by nursing staff.

* Act in a line management capacity for assigned per diem nurses, documenting meetings with assigned direct reports, as required.

* Identify, develop, and deliver training protocol-specific training, skills, remediation, and any other training as necessary.

* Develop study-specific nurse-facing resource materials to maximize the nurses' ability to successfully carry out a protocol in the home

* Delivers study-specific training to nurses in their assigned Region

* Ensures appropriate documentation of all training

* Serve as the Nursing SME for assigned studies, collaborating cross-functionally.

* Actively participates in the implementation and execution of clinical trial activities from study start-up preparations, planning, execution and closure. Provide mobile research nurse services to qualified study participants, as needed.

* Apply clinical research and nursing practices to develop solutions to complex problems.

* Participate in activities that will further the operational development of Science 37's nursing service delivery.

* Develop relationships with study team members and serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on all nursing processes.

* Advise nursing leadership of actual or potential issues.

* Participate in internal audits of nursing documentation in the Science 37 Platform and work to improve and/or correct deficiencies.

* Identify opportunities to improve processes and minimize inefficiencies.

* Assist with any other ad hoc projects, analysis, or analytics as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

**Qualifications**

* BSN degree preferred

* Active RN licensure in home state required

* Compact Licensure preferred

* Minimum 5+ years clinical/research experience preferred

* Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification

* Active driver's license

* Ability to work remotely

* Maintain a positive reflection of the company by representation in participant's homes or in clinic settings

* Minimum of one year of supervisory experience required; 3+ years preferred

**Skills/Competencies**

* **Practices professionalism and integrity in all actions** – Demonstrated ability to foster concepts of teamwork, accountability, cooperation, self- control, and flexibility to get the work done. The ability to adapt to a rapidly changing work environment. Able to successfully work as a matrix in a decentralized team environment. Skilled in situational responsive decision-making.

* **Expert nursing practices** – An expert nurse with strong clinical experience and the ability to effectively train others. Should be proficient in performing nursing skills, including but not limited to venipuncture, IV placement, medication administration, comprehensive and focused nursing assessments, ECGs, vital sign collection, and emergency first-responder care. Identifies deficiencies in documentation and clinical practice. Additionally, medical record review and abstraction for protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria.

* **Flexibility** – Able to make quick accommodations to schedule changes as well as process changes and to travel with limited notice.

* **Strong communication and presentation skills** - Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to establish and maintain positive study participant and project team member rapport. Ability to interact with study participants and caregivers in a compassionate and empathetic manner. Excellent customer service skills

* **Computer skills** - Working knowledge of MS Office suite and Google applications. Able to generate business correspondence, create forms, and generate reports as required. Willingness to gain expertise in the use of proprietary software.

* **Problem solving** – Ability to quickly and proactively identify problems, formulate solutions, execute solutions, and assess efficacy of solutions.

* **Interpersonal savvy** - Understands interpersonal and group dynamics and reacts in an effective and tactful manner and has a range of interpersonal skills and approaches with ability to select a best-fit approach. Understands and demonstrates cultural competency and sensitivity.

* **Ability to educate** – Able to communicate with and educate study participants, health care workers and study staff from diverse socioeconomic, geographical and cultural backgrounds.

* **Organizational Skills** – Ability to multitask with priorities defined by research protocol and visit. Planning for specific visits with equipment and additional supplies for potential needs and malfunctions in mind.

**Capabilities**

* Up to 60% travel, as needed, for study participant visits, project team meetings, client presentations and other professional meetings/conferences, as needed.

* Ability to support and complete administrative duties.

* Ability to obtain nursing license in multiple states based on study needs.

* Physical ability to perform nursing tasks and lift equipment up to 15 kg in weight.

* Access to a reliable vehicle in order to perform study participant visits and transport equipment.

* Ability to drive and/or fly to local and/or remote locations to perform study participant visits, dependent on distance to location

* Ability to use technology effectively and appropriately.

* Ability to communicate in English (both verbal and written).

* Ability to work nights and/or weekends, as needed.

**DIRECT REPORTS**

* Mobile Research Nurse (Per Diem)

c6ac318b66905d00bcb4.description:
Location: Remote, US / Atlanta, GA area preferred

### **\*\*We will review every application received by October 28, 2026 (11:59 pm ET), so there is no need to rush or reach out to us directly.\*\***

### **About Acoustic**

Acoustic is built on the belief that people can feel when a brand is paying attention. We help marketers read what their customers actually do and respond in the moment. The same idea applies to our team.

Our colleagues work across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ, and they notice when the details are right. Our People team is small and scrappy, so you’ll see the impact of your work and build the systems behind it.

### **About the role**

As our **People Operations Coordinator**, you’ll be the face of Acoustic and our People team to candidates, new hires, and employees navigating questions about benefits and processes. Our People team is lean, and you’ll have the opportunity to partner on programs that reach employees in every country we operate in. Day to day, you’ll own the execution behind our HR systems, hiring, onboarding and offboarding, benefits and performance cycles.

While Acoustic is remote, our Head of People (Americas) is based in Atlanta, so you’ll have opportunities for in-person working as you grow in your role.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Own our HR Tech Stack (BambooHR, Workable, CultureAmp):** process employee data changes, run regular audits, and keep data squeaky clean and compliant across countries. You’ll help drive workflow improvements and keep up with new features that can help us work smarter.
* **Recruiting Support:** Help schedule interviews, keep candidates updated, send offer letters, manage background checks, and make sure stakeholders are up-to-date on open roles.
* **Manage the HR inbox:** answer employee questions about benefits and documents, as well as process employment verifications.
* **Benefits Administration:** process enrollments, changes, and coverage terminations, and provide support during Open Enrollment. Send monthly headcount updates to our international benefits carriers so coverage stays accurate.
* **Employee Lifecycle:** Own the processes and documents for onboarding/offboarding across regions, including I-9s and E-Verify for US employees. Assign compliance training and policy acknowledgments to new hires, track completion, and keep signed onboarding checklists on file. You’ll be the glue between HR, IT, employees, and managers to ensure their experience is seamless.
* **Process documentation and improvement:** Document our processes and build new workflows, automations, and templates to help us stay organized.

  
**Requirements**  

### **You could be a great match if**

* Have 1-2 years of experience in HR, recruiting coordination, or a similar administrative role
* Think in systems. You don’t just execute the task; you build the process, so it’s easier the next time.
* Are energized by complex people problems and look for the answer that is the right choice for the employees and Acoustic.
* Write clearly so colleagues in other time zones can act without waiting for a follow-up message.
* Are detail-oriented, can spot patterns in data, and own and fix mistakes when you find them. You get excited to test process changes and iterate.
* Are excited by a dynamic role with multiple requests and deadlines – no two days are the same.
* Handle sensitive information with discretion and care.
* Are comfortable working across cultures and adapting processes to local rules and norms.
* Are curious about AI and want to use it to work faster and more accurately. You’ll have access to company AI tools in this role; how would you put these to work?
* Are eager to grow and learn – this role will manage the core components of our HR work and help contribute to company-wide projects.

### **Bonus points if you**

* Have experience with an HRIS or ATS tool
* Have supported employees in more than one country.
* Have worked in SaaS or tech.
* Have used AI tools to automate or speed up admin work.

### **This role may not be a match if**

* You prefer well-defined assignments and are uneasy with ambiguity
* You don't enjoy repetitive work. Accurate data and documents are key components of this role.
* You'd rather focus on one project at a time

  
**Benefits**

Compensation and benefits

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Company-sponsored short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
* 401(k) program with company match
* Flexible PTO: take what you need, when you need it
* Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents

Acoustic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

34a39dca44945912fb4c.title: Supervisor, Service Assurance
34a39dca44945912fb4c.description:
Come be a Part of our Success!

Since 2010, White Label Communications, LLC has been empowering our partners with private-label communication solutions that are built to scale, built to last, and built to exceed expectations. We’re the “business-in-a-box” pioneers, equipping them with everything they need to meet customers’ needs and increase revenue, all on their own terms — and under their brand.

From UCaaS to CPaaS to CCaaS and more, we fuse modern tech, rock-solid performance, and reliable U.S.-based support to elevate your success in a fast-moving, always-connected world.

We are currently hiring for a **Full-time Supervsior, Service Assurance** to join our Client Services & Support department.

**Location:** Exton, PA (Hybrid)  
**Schedule:** Monday-Friday, Standard Business Hours  
**Operational Availability:** Must be available evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed to support major incidents, outages, customer escalations, and business-critical support operations.  
**Reports To:** Director, Service Assurance

**Position Summary**

The Supervisor, Service Assurance coordinates the day-to-day work, performance, and continuous improvement activities of the Client Services and Technical Support teams. This role provides frontline oversight of support delivery across UCaaS, CCaaS, DaaS, and related technology platforms while reinforcing service level objectives, operational standards, customer satisfaction targets, and employee development goals.

The Supervisor, Service Assurance provides frontline oversight of support activities, incident response execution, service quality, customer communications, workforce coordination, and adherence to support processes. This individual works closely with Engineering, Development, Product, Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Executive Leadership to help ensure customers receive a world-class support experience.

This position is a critical supervisory role within the Service Assurance organization, responsible for ensuring exceptional customer experiences, operational excellence, and high-performing support teams. The Supervisor, Service Assurance serves as the connection between frontline operations and department leadership while driving accountability, service quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across the organization.

The ideal candidate is an experienced support supervisor who can balance daily operational oversight, incident coordination, employee coaching, customer advocacy, and performance reporting in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Supervision & Employee Support**

* Provide day-to-day supervision, work direction, and support to Client Services Representatives, Team Leads, and Support Technicians.
* Communicate team goals and reinforce performance expectations established by department leadership.
* Conduct regular check-ins with team members to provide feedback, discuss development opportunities, and support career progression.
* Provide documented performance feedback and contribute to annual reviews and improvement plans in partnership with department leadership and Human Resources.
* Participate in interviewing and selection activities and coordinate onboarding for new team members.
* Coordinate employee training plans and reinforce ongoing technical and professional development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate staffing coverage across shifts, holidays, and on-call rotations, escalating coverage risks when needed.
* Document and escalate employee relations matters to department leadership and Human Resources.

**Operational Oversight**

* Supervise daily support activities across phone, ticket, email, and escalation channels.
* Monitor support queues and ensure service levels are consistently achieved.
* Ensure support processes, workflows, and escalation procedures are followed.
* Review ticket quality, resolution accuracy, and customer communication standards.
* Coordinate workforce schedules and daily resource assignments.
* Support operational efficiency by identifying and implementing approved process improvements.
* Monitor backlog levels and coordinate workload balancing across support teams.

**Service Level & Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor and report on key support metrics.
* Recommend and carry out corrective action plans when performance targets are not being met.
* Identify trends impacting customer experience and operational performance.
* Prepare operational performance updates for department leadership.

**Incident & Outage Coordination**

* Serve as the frontline operational coordinator during customer-impacting incidents and outages.
* Coordinate cross-functional response efforts involving Engineering, Development, Product, Sales, Account Management, and Support teams.
* Ensure timely escalation of critical incidents.
* Coordinate customer communications during service interruptions and major incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridge calls and provide timely status information for leadership updates.
* Coordinate post-incident reviews and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure corrective actions are identified, assigned, and completed.

**Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement**

* Administer established quality assurance activities for support interactions and recommend improvements.
* Review tickets, calls, and customer communications for quality and consistency.
* Monitor adherence to established policies and procedures.
* Identify coaching opportunities and training needs across the organization.
* Ensure documentation and knowledge base articles remain current and accurate.
* Apply approved best practices to improve customer experience and operational effectiveness.

**Trend Analysis & Customer Advocacy**

* Identify recurring customer issues and systemic service concerns.
* Analyze support trends to proactively address root causes.
* Monitor customer feedback, CSAT, and NPS performance.
* Identify high-risk customers and recurring escalation patterns.
* Partner with Engineering, Development and Product teams to address ongoing service challenges.
* Support initiatives focused on improving customer retention and satisfaction.

**Reporting & Executive Communications**

* Prepare weekly operational reports and review findings with department leadership.
* Compile monthly reporting packages for department and executive leadership.
* Provide recommendations and carry out approved action plans based on operational data.
* Provide visibility into risks, trends, and opportunities for improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with other departments to ensure service delivery.
* Advocate for customer and reseller needs.
* Contribute customer feedback and trend analysis to product enhancement discussions.
* Reinforce alignment between daily support activities and broader business initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Five (5) or more years of experience in technical support, service assurance, customer support, or service delivery, including progressive responsibility.
* Three (3) or more years of experience supervising, coaching, or providing daily work direction to support employees.
* Experience supervising support activities within a 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience coordinating customer-impacting incidents and outage communications.
* Strong understanding of support center operations and KPI management.
* Proven experience creating executive-level reports and presentations.
* Experience providing performance feedback, interviewing candidates, coaching employees, and supporting professional development.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting UCaaS platforms, CCaaS platforms, DaaS applications, and VoIP technologies.
* Knowledge of SIP,RTP, Contact Center Technologies, Incident Management Frameworks
* Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, ConnectWise
* Experience supporting reseller and channel partner organizations.

Benefits of working for WLC include generous paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), voluntary Life insurance, short-term/long term disability, hybrid work environment, casual dress code, opportunity to develop and contribute ideas, collaborative, and professional environment.

*White Label Communications, LLC iis an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Customer Care & Account Manager

**Newtech Dental Laboratories**

Position Overview

Newtech Dental Laboratories is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented **Customer Care & Account Manager** to join our team. This position combines customer service, technical communication, administrative responsibilities, billing, and sales support.

The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator who can build and maintain strong professional relationships while managing the day-to-day needs of our dental clients.

In addition to providing customer service, each representative will be assigned a portfolio of existing dental practices and will be responsible for maintaining those relationships, monitoring account activity, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping ensure continued client satisfaction.

* Assist with general administrative duties, documentation, and other tasks supporting daily laboratory operations.

Qualifications
