* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional, friendly, and confident telephone communication skills.
* Comfortable building relationships with clients and conducting proactive sales outreach.
* Proficiency with computers, data entry, email, and standard office software.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with other departments.
* Willingness to learn dental terminology, restorative materials, and laboratory processes.

**Preferred:**

* Previous experience in dental laboratories, dental offices, or the dental industry.
* Experience in customer service, account management, inside sales, or client retention.
* Familiarity with dental terminology, restorations, and laboratory workflows.
* Experience with billing systems, CRM software, or laboratory management software.

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching

d886b589e6f9982979d9.description:
**Job Description:**  
**ASSOCIATE OPERATIONS MANAGER**  
Department: Operations  
Reports To: Vice President of Operations Classification: Exempt or Non-Exempt, as determined by Company  
Location: Philadelphia, PA  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Associate Operations Manager supports the Operations Team in the coordination and management of the Company's distribution and final-mile logistics operations in the Philadelphia market. The position serves as a key operational resource working with customers, drivers, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Sales, and management to maintain service quality, operational continuity, and customer satisfaction.  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

* Support the VP of Operations with daily operational coordination, projects, reporting, follow-up, communications, and implementation of operational initiatives.
* Oversee daily operations of Spoke Logistics Independent Contractor drivers at customer location including daily loading and launch of drivers.
* Serve as a liaison among customers, drivers, Operations, and other departments to ensure operational success and a positive relationship between all parties.
* Communicate customer-specific requirements, delivery instructions, schedules, special handling procedures, service expectations, route changes, and other operational information to drivers and Operations.
* Assist customers, drivers, and Operations Team with operational questions, service requests, delivery issues, complaints, escalations, and other exceptions; coordinate appropriate follow-up through resolution.
* Provide driver orientation and guidance, including scheduling, coordination, orientation materials, onboarding support, and follow-up to ensure required requirements and procedures are understood and completed.
* Provide field support to drivers and Operations, including assistance with new routes, customer locations, service issues, equipment or vehicle needs, operational changes, and other on-site requirements.
* Monitor operational and customer-service performance KPIs, including on-time performance, completion rates, service exceptions, POD compliance, claims, complaints, and other applicable KPIs.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, customer reports, records, procedures, documentation, and other information required by management or customers.
* Identify recurring service or operational issues and communicate trends, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities to management.
* Coordinate with Finance regarding billing questions, service discrepancies, accessorial charges, deductions, vehicle rental expenses, and other account-related matters.
* Support Compliance, Sales, Account Management, and Operations with audits, documentation, customer requirements, new-account implementation, process improvements, and special projects.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer, employee, financial, operational, and other sensitive information.
* Support driver recruiting activities, including candidate communication, interview scheduling, recruiting coordination, onboarding preparation, and follow-up with applicants and Operations as needed.
* Assist with implementation of new customers, routes, locations, services, programs, and changes to existing customer requirements.

**AUTHORITY & RESPONSIBILITY**  
The Associate Operations Manager coordinates and supports operational activities but does not independently modify contracts or pricing, commit the Company to additional services or expenditures, hire, terminate, or discipline employees or drivers, alter controlled procedures, or otherwise bind the Company unless specifically authorized.  
**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**  
Demonstrates strong organization, communication, responsiveness, customer service, problem-solving, judgment, and follow-through; proactively identifies and communicates  
issues; maintains accurate documentation; and ensures assigned operational, vehicle, orientation, recruiting, field-support, and customer matters are appropriately coordinated through resolution.  
**DISCLAIMER**  
This job description describes the general nature and level of work expected and is not exhaustive. The Company may modify, assign, or reassign duties and responsibilities as business needs require. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment or alters the at-will employment relationship where applicable.  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
Spoke Logistics, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and in performing essential job functions, as required by law.  
**Job Requirements:**  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant college education or logistics experience preferred.
* Experience in courier, final-mile delivery, transportation, logistics, account management, customer service, recruiting, orientation, or operations preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with customers, drivers, management, candidates, and internal departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and logistics, TMS, GPS/telematics, recruiting, or similar systems preferred.
* Ability to travel to customer locations, operational sites, and field locations as required.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**  
Operations Management • Customer Service •Customer & Driver Communication • Driver Orientation & Guidance • Field Support • Driver Recruiting Support • Customer Service • Problem Solving • KPI Monitoring • Reporting • Organization • Follow-Through • Accountability • Confidentiality • Professional Judgment  
**PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
May require lifting up to 50 lbs, prolonged standing or sitting and computer use, frequent telephone and electronic communication, and occasional travel to customer locations, Company facilities, or operational sites. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as required by applicable law.

e1bb0b4ebf819b03c5ea.description:
At Project HOME, every role contributes to our mission of empowering individuals to achieve stability, wellness, and self-determination. As our MOUD Program Coordinator, you'll play an important role in helping individuals access and stay connected to substance use treatment and supportive healthcare services.

This unique position combines healthcare administration with meaningful patient interaction. You'll coordinate daily program operations, manage medication authorizations, support patient scheduling and outreach, and work closely with medical and behavioral health teams to reduce barriers to care.

If you're organized, resourceful, and passionate about supporting individuals impacted by substance use disorders, homelessness, and other challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Experience in substance use treatment is valuable, but equally important is a compassionate, nonjudgmental approach and a genuine commitment to the communities we serve.

* **Location:** Stephen Klein Wellness Center, 2144 Cecil B. Moore Avenue, Philadelphia, PA 19121
* **Schedule:** 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
* **Compensation:** Up to $23.90 per hour, based on experience

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Coordinate Daily Program Operations**

* Coordinate patient scheduling, appointment reminders, and daily clinic workflows to support efficient MOUD services.
* Prepare patient lists and clinical information for daily team meetings and care coordination.
* Support front desk operations during MOUD clinic hours, assisting with patient check-in, insurance verification, and communication between clinical and operations teams.
* Coordinate with medical assistants and providers to ensure patients are appropriately prepared for appointments.
* Manage the MOUD program phone line and respond to patient scheduling and service coordination needs.

**Support Medication Access & Patient Care**

* Prepare, submit, and track medication prior authorizations to prevent interruptions in patient treatment.
* Coordinate with specialty pharmacies to ensure long-acting injectable buprenorphine is ordered and delivered on time.
* Conduct outreach to patients who miss appointments, identify barriers to care, and help reconnect them with services.
* Assist patients with navigating referrals and accessing primary care, substance use treatment, behavioral health services, and specialty care.
* Work closely with medical providers, behavioral health professionals, Certified Peer Specialists, and other team members to support coordinated patient care.
* Engage patients using trauma-informed, patient-centered, and harm reduction approaches.

**Manage Documentation & Program Data**

* Maintain accurate patient records, tracking spreadsheets, referral information, and program documentation.
* Monitor patient appointments, health screenings, laboratory requirements, and follow-up needs.
* Support data collection, reporting, and documentation required for program evaluation and grant compliance.
* Use electronic health records and other systems to organize information and support clinical workflows.
* Collaborate with program leadership to identify opportunities for workflow improvements, program development, and quality improvement initiatives.

**Support Program Development & Training**

* Assist with onboarding and orienting new staff to MOUD program procedures and workflows.
* Develop and maintain training materials, reference documents, and standardized program resources.
* Coordinate schedules and learning opportunities for students, interns, and external observers.
* Support the Program Manager in identifying community partnerships, outreach opportunities, and initiatives that strengthen program services.
* Participate in community engagement and advocacy activities that promote accessible, patient-centered care.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* Bachelor's degree in social science, healthcare, or a related field and at least two years of related work experience; OR an associate degree and four years of related experience; OR six years of related experience.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to engage respectfully with individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Ability to work independently, solve problems, and adapt to changing needs in a busy healthcare environment.
* Familiarity with spreadsheets, databases, charts, and other administrative tools.
* A compassionate, nonjudgmental approach to working with individuals experiencing substance use disorders, mental health challenges, homelessness, and other barriers to care.

**What You May Bring**
----------------------

* Experience in healthcare administration, public health, community health, human services, or substance use treatment settings.
* Familiarity with harm reduction principles, trauma-informed care, and patient-centered approaches.
* Experience working with culturally diverse, underserved, or medically vulnerable populations.
* Experience using electronic health records (EHR) and managing healthcare documentation.
* Knowledge of medication prior authorizations, patient scheduling, or care coordination processes.
* Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.
* Experience supporting program reporting, quality improvement, or community-based initiatives.
* A demonstrated interest in expanding access to equitable, low-barrier healthcare.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

Project HOME is committed to supporting the well-being of our employees through a comprehensive benefits package.

Eligible employees enjoy:

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with low employee costs
* Company-paid life and disability insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* 401(k) with employer matching
* Generous Paid Time Off, including paid sabbatical leave
* Employee wellness programs
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

**Who We Are**
--------------

Project HOME is a nationally recognized nonprofit dedicated to ending homelessness and poverty through integrated housing, healthcare, education, employment, and supportive services.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Project HOME is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Acquisition Agent (Sales Representative) | Real Estate Investment Company | Greater Philadelphia, South Jersey & New Castle County | Full-Time**

**Get in early with a company that’s built to grow.**

We buy, renovate, sell, and manage properties across the Greater Philadelphia area, South Jersey, and New Castle County. We’ve done it profitably, we have the track record to prove it, and now we’re sharpening our systems to scale in a big way.

We’re still a small team, so the people we add now won’t be background players. They’re the ones we build around. If you’re a natural conversationalist who wants to build a real career in real estate investing, with the leads, the training, and the support to do it, this is that opportunity.

**The Role**

You’ll be the first voice homeowners hear when they’re thinking about selling. Your job is to build trust, understand their situation, and set appointments for our team to make offers. Our marketing department brings in a steady flow of inbound leads, and our Sales Manager coaches you through a proven process, so you spend your time on conversations, not hunting for leads.

**What You’ll Do**

* Talk with homeowners who are interested in selling their property
* Set appointments through calls, texts, and emails
* Follow our established sales process and bring a coachable attitude to it
* Keep our client database and CRM accurate and up to date
* Learn each seller’s needs and situation so we can offer the right solution
* Work closely with our Sales Manager and marketing team to keep improving results

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are personable and genuinely enjoy conversations with people
* Listen first and can read what a seller really needs
* Follow up consistently, without being chased
* Stay organized with a full pipeline
* Are motivated by targets and rewarded by results
* Are hungry to learn and want your effort to translate directly into income

Real estate or sales experience is a plus. A great attitude, a strong work ethic, and coachability matter most.

Send us:

854ebf5191faf4f92f35.title: Customer Success Manager
854ebf5191faf4f92f35.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

***Location:*** *Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST or MST time zones are preferred.*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for "Most Innovative Housing Concept" and the Best of IBS Award for "Best Home Technology."

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We're building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

**About This Opportunity**

As Customer Success Manager, you will build and lead the team that stands behind every Frontline customer, from the day their system is installed through every fire season after. You will own Frontline's customer support function and lead our Wildfire Response Specialists, the team that helps homeowners and commercial customers make sure their systems are ready, running, and doing their job when a wildfire is approaching.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within ten miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam. When fire is close, customers need fast, calm, accurate help, and you will be responsible for making sure they get it at any hour.

This is a founding, hands-on leadership role. You will hire and coach the team, design the coverage model and on-call rotation, build the playbooks and escalation paths the team runs on, and lead the team through active fire events. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Installation Operations, Field Service, and Product so that customer issues get resolved quickly and turn into lasting product and process improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Hire, onboard, and lead Frontline's Wildfire Response Specialists, and grow the team as our customer base and coverage hours expand.
* Coach the team on system troubleshooting, crisis communication, de-escalation, and documentation, and run regular 1:1s, call reviews, and performance management.
* Build a culture of calm, ownership, and genuine care for customers, and protect the team from burnout through fair scheduling, post-event debriefs, and access to support resources.
* Serve as a hands-on leader: take escalated calls, step into coverage gaps, and share the after-hours on-call rotation with the team

**24/7 Response Operations**

* Design and run the team's coverage model, including shift schedules, an after-hours on-call rotation, and surge staffing plans for Red Flag Warnings and active fires.
* Lead the team during active fire events: decide outreach priorities, assign customers to specialists, track system status across affected properties, and keep leadership informed in real time.
* Own the escalation matrix that connects the team to on-call engineering, field service, and leadership, and make sure it works at 2am as well as it does at 2pm.
* Train and maintain a bench of cross-trained employees who can support the team during large or multiple simultaneous fire events.
* Manage schedules, timekeeping, overtime, and labor costs for an hourly team in compliance with federal and state wage and hour rules, including meal and rest breaks.

**Customer Support & Customer Experience**

* Own the end-to-end customer support experience across phone, text, email, and app messages for homeowners and commercial customers.
* Define and track SLAs and key metrics, including response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, escalation rate, and customer satisfaction, and report them to leadership on a regular cadence.
* Serve as the final escalation point for complex, sensitive, or unresolved customer issues.
* Build proactive programs that keep customers ready: new-owner onboarding (app setup, contacts, and alerts), pre-fire-season readiness check-ins, and outreach during Red Flag Warnings.
* Lead post-fire recovery: make sure every affected customer is contacted and that foam and water refills, inspections, and repairs are scheduled with Field Service.

**Systems, Process & Documentation**

* Build and maintain the team's infrastructure, including the ticketing system, phone routing for 24/7 coverage, response playbooks, call scripts, SOPs, and knowledge base.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to define the tools the team needs, such as visibility into which customers are near an active fire and each system's live status.
* Work with leadership and Legal to set clear protocols for sensitive actions, such as verifying a caller's identity and getting customer consent before any remote action on their system.
* Track system performance and property outcomes after fire events so the data can inform product improvements and Frontline's performance reporting.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Solutions Engineering, Installation Operations, and Field Service to make sure field issues are captured, documented, and resolved by the right team.
* Bring recurring customer issues and feedback to Product so they shape roadmap decisions.
* Work with Sales, Marketing, and our partners to keep messaging about system capabilities and Frontline's response service accurate and consistent.

**Qualifications**

**Must-Have:**

* 5+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, emergency communications, or monitoring center operations, including at least 2 years leading a team.
* Experience leading a team that provides extended-hours or 24/7 coverage, including building shift schedules, on-call rotations, and escalation paths.
* Proven ability to stay calm and lead others through high-pressure, time-sensitive situations.
* Experience building or scaling a support team, function, or process in a growing company.
* Experience owning support metrics and reporting (SLAs, CSAT, first-contact resolution, escalation rates).
* Hands-on experience with ticketing and phone platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and building the processes around them.
* Experience managing hourly employees, including scheduling, timekeeping, and overtime.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to de-escalate difficult conversations with care.
* Availability to take part in an after-hours on-call rotation and to work extended hours during active fire events.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Slack.

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Background in emergency dispatch, alarm or central station monitoring, a network operations center, or fire and life safety.
* Experience supporting connected hardware, IoT, smart home, or security products.
* Incident Command System familiarity (e.g., FEMA IS-100 and IS-700) or working knowledge of wildfire behavior, Red Flag Warnings, and evacuation zone tools such as Genasys Protect or Watch Duty.
* Background in home services, construction, or field service, including experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software.
* Experience building a customer-facing knowledge base or self-service support resources.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Salary Range: $90,000 - $115,000 annually, based on experience.
* Company-provided cell phone and laptop
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
* Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
* Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
* Company-provided equipment
* Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
* And much more!

**Join Our Mission!**

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

*Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

Every time a member or provider reaches out about benefits, claims, or care, they need a clear, fast, and accurate answer, and Member Services is where that promise is kept or broken. As Vice President, you’ll run a large, global operation while reimagining how service gets delivered through automation, smarter workflows, and better tools. You’ll hold the line on client SLAs and contractual commitments, and you’ll build the roadmap that makes service easier for members and for the teams behind them. This is a builder-operator role, and how well you run today and design tomorrow directly shapes client retention, member trust, and the long-term success of our business.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Lead a global service organization:** Direct the TPA Member Services department, including directors, managers, and supervisors across US and international sites, onsite and remote, to deliver one consistent standard of service.
* **Set standards across sites:** Establish consistent culture, standards, and accountability worldwide while respecting local labor laws, practices, and customer needs.

* **Develop leaders:** Build succession depth, coach managers, and raise the talent bar so the organization is stronger every year.
* **Own service performance:** Drive results across inbound contact, case resolution, escalations, and quality assurance, keeping an exceptional member experience at the center of every decision.
* **Deliver on client commitments:** Hit client SLAs, performance guarantees, and contractual obligations consistently, with goals, metrics, and operating rhythms for staffing, forecasting, scheduling, and quality that make performance visible and repeatable.

* 5+ years of leadership experience in a TPA, healthcare organization, or benefits administration
* Proven record of running a large-scale service operation against client or contractual SLAs
* Experience leading global teams across multiple geographies and time zones, including onsite and remote workforces

**Technical Skills:**

**Benefits**

Question: Given your phone sales background, how would you evaluate our current scripts? What baseline Quote-to-Booking Conversion Rate do you consider acceptable for luxury livery, and how would you coach a dispatcher who excels at logistics but struggles to close sales?

2) Scenario: I need a high-level view of how dispatch decisions hit our bottom line without digging into raw logs. I want a monthly breakdown of money lost to dispatch errors (like service credits for late pickups) versus fleet efficiency.

Question: What weekly/monthly data points would you pull from Limo Anywhere for an executive summary? How would you format it to highlight the Cost of Quality alongside metrics like Average Revenue per Trip?

2d7386ebef3168f67138.title: Appraisal Office Coordinator / Administrative Assistant
2d7386ebef3168f67138.description:
About the Position

Peerless Appraisals, LLC is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and professional **Appraisal Office Coordinator / Administrative Assistant** to join our team.

This is a work-from-home position that will begin at approximately **15-20 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours as business volume increases or when providing coverage for other team members.

A primary responsibility will be coordinating and scheduling appraisal inspections for multiple appraisers. However, this is **not solely a scheduling position**. We are looking for someone who can become cross-trained in our office operations and develop into a dependable backup across multiple administrative functions.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who is detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, able to manage multiple priorities, and willing to take initiative to see tasks through to completion.

**Real estate or appraisal experience is NOT required. Training will be provided.**

Responsibilities

* Coordinate and schedule appraisal inspections for multiple appraisers.
* Contact homeowners, borrowers, real estate agents, builders, property managers, and other points of contact to arrange inspection appointments.
* Maintain accurate schedules and detailed internal notes for appraisers and office staff.
* Follow up on scheduling issues, access problems, appointment changes, and outstanding information.
* Communicate and confirm appointment and property information with appraisers.
* Serve as a liaison between appraisers, clients, homeowners/borrowers, real estate agents, builders, property managers, and other points of contact.
* Assist appraisers during inspection appointments with access, contact, scheduling, and safety-related issues.
* Accurately enter and maintain appraisal order, property, and client information.
* Monitor and respond to the company's primary email inbox when providing backup coverage.
* Communicate professionally and promptly with clients regarding appraisal orders, status updates, questions, and requests.
* Assist with new appraisal order bids, order assignment, and client requirements.
* Communicate internally with appraisers regarding assignments, deadlines, client requests, and scheduling.
* Assist with client outreach, prospective-client communication, and new-client development.
* Assist with onboarding appraisers with new clients and maintain appraiser profiles, including licenses, E&O insurance, and other required documentation.
* Assist with invoicing, billing, payment tracking, and follow-up on outstanding receivables.
* Help maintain a high level of client satisfaction by responding promptly and professionally and helping resolve issues as they arise.
* Provide backup support for other administrative team members as needed.
* Assist with additional administrative projects and responsibilities as the needs of the company change.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly.
* Accurate and efficient typing and data-entry skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Professional and courteous phone and email communication skills.
* Dependable and responsive during scheduled working hours.
* Ability to work independently in a work-from-home environment.
* Good judgment and problem-solving skills.
* **Self-motivated with the ability to identify issues, take initiative, and independently follow tasks through to completion.**
* Comfortable communicating with clients, homeowners, real estate professionals, appraisers, and other members of the public.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential business and customer information.
* Flexibility to adjust working hours based on business needs.

**Preferred, but not required:**

* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* College degree.
* Prior administrative, customer service, scheduling, or office experience.
* Located in the San Antonio area.
* Previous experience working remotely.

**Real estate/appraisal experience is NOT required; training will be provided.**

Schedule

This position is expected to begin at approximately **15-20 hours per week (approximately 3-4 hours per weekday)**. Additional hours may be available as business volume increases or when providing coverage for other employees.

The position offers some scheduling flexibility; however, **availability from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday, is required.**

Our workload can fluctuate, so flexibility is an important part of this position. Working hours may occasionally increase or shift based on business volume, employee coverage, client needs, appraiser scheduling changes, and other time-sensitive business needs.

Compensation & Benefits

* Starting pay of **$20.00 per hour**
* W-2 employee position
* Approximately 30 hours per week initially
* Opportunity for additional hours
* Work-from-home position
* Company phone provided
* Laptop/computer required; a company laptop can be provided if needed
* **401(k) plan available after 3 months of employment**
* Medical and dental insurance are not currently offered
* Paid time off is not currently offered

What We're Looking For

This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys staying organized, communicating with people, solving problems, and keeping a busy office running smoothly.

Because we are a small company, our administrative team members often help one another and take on different responsibilities depending on the needs of the business. We are looking for someone who is comfortable learning multiple aspects of our operation rather than performing only one narrowly defined task.

The successful candidate will be someone we can depend on to recognize what needs to be done, communicate effectively, ask questions when appropriate, and follow tasks through to completion.

**If you are organized, dependable, comfortable working independently, and interested in becoming an important part of a growing small business, we encourage you to apply.**

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

Application Question(s):

* This position is expected to begin at approximately 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Availability between 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM Central Time is required each weekday. Are you consistently available during these hours?
* The starting pay for this position is $20.00 per hour. Are you comfortable accepting this starting rate?

Location:

* San Antonio, TX (Required)

Work Location: Remote

80313e654c118802a4f3.title: HSE Manager - Major Projects
80313e654c118802a4f3.description:
**Company Description**

**HSE Manager - Major Projects**

**Location:**

Flexible – remote work is an option when not travelling

**Travel:**

~40%

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

 **Job Description**

**Position Overview**

This role provides senior HSE leadership for Ramboll Energy as well as other GBA major project portfolios in the Americas, with a primary focus on aligning HSE planning, governance, resourcing and execution across major projects, including EPC and EPCM delivery models. Rather than operating as the day-to-day HSE Manager for every project, the role will work upstream with internal stakeholders to ensure HSE is engaged early in business development, tendering, project planning and delivery preparation. The successful candidate will partner with Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and other key functions to make sure HSE risks, responsibilities, resource needs and delivery expectations are clearly understood before projects move into execution.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a credible senior HSE professional with strong major-project experience, sound understanding of EPC and EPCM delivery models, and the ability to influence internal stakeholders before key commercial and delivery decisions are made. They will be comfortable operating across a portfolio of projects, strengthening the way HSE is integrated into the project delivery model, supporting Project HSE Managers where escalation is needed, and stepping into a project HSE Manager role only where project demand or resource constraints require direct deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Major Projects HSE Alignment & Governance

* Lead alignment of HSE expectations, planning requirements and governance arrangements for major projects across the Americas, including EPC and EPCM delivery models.
* Act as the senior HSE point of coordination between the GBA, Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure HSE is engaged early in business development, tendering, project planning and delivery preparation so that risks, scope, budget and resource requirements are identified before commitments are made.
* Translate Ramboll and client HSE expectations into practical planning requirements that can be understood and applied by project, commercial and technical teams.
* Provide strategic HSE input during proposals, contract reviews and internal delivery planning to establish clear roles, responsibilities, interfaces and escalation routes before project execution begins.

**Early HSE Involvement, Planning & Resource Readiness**

* Build understanding across the Americas business of when and why HSE must be involved in major projects, particularly during tendering, contracting, mobilisation and execution planning.
* Work with internal stakeholders to define scalable HSE organisation structures, resource requirements and competency needs for major projects before execution risks materialise.
* Support project teams in identifying when dedicated Project HSE Manager support, specialist HSE input or additional project HSE resources are required.
* Ensure HSE requirements are embedded into project delivery plans, procurement strategies, contracting approaches, mobilisation plans and commissioning readiness activities.
* Where required due to resource demand, temporarily step into the Project HSE Manager role for major projects while maintaining focus on broader portfolio alignment and improvement.

**Internal Stakeholder Integration & Delivery Model Support**

* Work closely with Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and relevant business leaders to integrate HSE into the major project delivery model.
* Support internal teams in understanding how contract model, scope definition, client expectations and contractor interfaces affect HSE responsibility, capability and resourcing.
* Influence early commercial and technical decisions so that HSE obligations are realistic, adequately resourced and capable of being delivered in practice.
* Provide challenge and support to ensure HSE requirements are reflected in bid documents, contracts, procurement packages, contractor scopes of work and project execution documentation.
* Promote clear interfaces between Ramboll, clients, contractors, subcontractors and suppliers, particularly where EPC or EPCM delivery introduces complex responsibility boundaries.

**Escalation, Assurance & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as an escalation point for internal project HSE issues and project delivery challenges that cannot be resolved by the assigned Project HSE Manager or project team.
* Provide senior HSE support and challenge to Project HSE Managers, Project Directors and project leadership teams where risks, interfaces or stakeholder expectations require additional alignment.
* Review the effectiveness of HSE planning, governance, contractor management and assurance arrangements across major projects and identify opportunities to improve the delivery model.
* Lead or support assurance reviews, lessons-learned activities and management reviews to verify that HSE requirements are understood, resourced and consistently applied.
* Drive continuous improvement in how HSE supports major project delivery across the Americas, using project experience, performance trends and stakeholder feedback to strengthen future planning and execution.

**Culture, Engagement & Business Understanding**

* Strengthen business understanding of HSE’s role in major project success, particularly the need for early engagement, clear accountability and appropriate resourcing.
* Coach internal stakeholders and project leadership teams on effective HSE planning, escalation, contractor interface management and risk-based decision-making.
* Promote a learning-focused culture that uses project feedback, assurance findings and lessons learned to improve future major project delivery.

**Regulatory & Compliance Oversight**

* Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSE standards across EPCM projects.
* Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSE requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
* Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

Performance Management & Reporting

* Establish consistent HSE performance reporting across EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
* Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Safety Management, Engineering, Environmental Health, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional HSE certification appropriate to the Americas market, with Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred or the ability to obtain CSP within an agreed timeframe.
* 10+ years of progressive HSE experience, including significant exposure to major projects, EPC, EPCM or complex construction management delivery models.
* Strong understanding of how HSE requirements are defined during tendering, contracting, procurement, mobilisation, project execution and commissioning.
* Proven ability to influence internal stakeholders, including project delivery, procurement, sales, tender management, engineering, commissioning and senior project leadership.
* Experience identifying project HSE resource needs, defining HSE scopes of work and supporting scalable organisation models for complex projects.
* Ability to provide senior escalation support where project HSE issues, stakeholder alignment or delivery model challenges require additional intervention.
* Working knowledge of construction-phase HSE controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, regulatory compliance and management-system implementation.
* Ability to travel to project and stakeholder locations as required, while maintaining focus on portfolio-level alignment and improvement.
* Strong communication, facilitation, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred:**

* Degree-level education supported by significant major-project HSE experience may be considered where professional certification is in progress or an equivalent international route applies.
* Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
* Experience supporting owner’s EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
* International or remote project experience.

 **Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to shape how HSE is integrated into major project planning and execution across the Americas.
* A strategic role with influence across project delivery, commercial, technical and HSE stakeholders.
* Strong organizational commitment to safety, health, wellbeing, and continuous improvement.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities in a Global HSEQ organisation.

**Salary Transparency Statement**

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,000 to $197,000 yearly. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

**Where People Flourish**

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

**How to apply**

Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

6bd9c9aee90f309d300d.title: Project Director - Clinical Study Management
6bd9c9aee90f309d300d.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.  
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced clinical research professional to oversee the successful execution and delivery of clinical projects within an assigned region. This role serves as a key point of contact for sponsors, providing project oversight and ensuring clinical studies are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Clinical Project Managers (CPMs), cross-functional teams, and external vendors to support project planning, resource management, and operational performance. This position also contributes to business development initiatives, team development, and continuous process improvement to ensure consistent, high-quality project delivery.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the primary regional representative for clinical projects, ensuring successful execution and delivery in alignment with sponsor expectations, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Establish and maintain strong sponsor relationships, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of issues, and alignment on project expectations and deliverables.
* Oversee clinical project planning, implementation, and execution in collaboration with Clinical Project Managers and cross-functional teams.
* Review and approve project scope, budgets, timelines, performance metrics, resource requirements, and training plans to ensure successful project delivery.
* Monitor project progress, critical paths, risks, and performance indicators, providing guidance to Clinical Project Managers to address challenges and maintain project quality.
* Ensure clinical projects comply with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), regulatory requirements, corporate guidelines, and industry best practices.
* Oversee project forecasting, resource allocation, and staffing requirements to ensure appropriate support for current and upcoming clinical projects.
* Monitor internal team and third-party vendor performance, ensuring services consistently meet sponsor expectations and project requirements.
* Support team management activities, including recruitment, performance evaluations, employee training, development, and departmental budget planning.
* Contribute to business development activities, including proposal development, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), bid defenses, and prospective client engagement.

**Skills & Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Minimum of **7 years of relevant professional experience** in clinical research or a related field, supported by ongoing professional training and development.
* A three-year advanced college diploma or degree in a relevant discipline, preferably Health Sciences, Clinical Research, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of clinical project planning, execution, oversight, and delivery within established quality and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain collaborative relationships with sponsors, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional project teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate project updates, risks, and expectations clearly and effectively.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to monitor multiple project priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Ability to assess project requirements, identify potential risks, resolve issues, and support effective decision-making to achieve positive outcomes.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to foster teamwork, support employee development, and promote accountability.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to delivering high-quality services and achieving project objectives.
* Commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and improving operational processes and team performance.

### **What We Offer**

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

* Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
* Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
* One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
* Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
* Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
* Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
* Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
* Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

*Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.*

### **Our Services**

* End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
* Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
* Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
* Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
* Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

### **How to Apply**

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

### **Equal Opportunity and Accessibility**

*Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

*Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to* *recruitment@alimentiv.com**.*

*Please note that the salary range may vary depending on the country in which the position is based.*

  

### **Performance-Based Incentive Program**

At Alimentiv, we recognize and reward great performance. In addition to a competitive salary, eligible employees can participate in our **Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP)**, which offers the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on individual contributions, team achievements, and company performance.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Alimentiv is aware of the continued increase of phishing scams, leveraging various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media. Please note that Alimentiv only uses company email addresses, which contain “@alimentiv.com”, to communicate with candidates via email. If you are contacted by someone about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender’s email address and that they are asking you to apply on this website. If you believe you’ve been a victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report.

**Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams**

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

853e154ec0eef3b3b314.description:
**What Makes Wonderlic Different?**
-----------------------------------

* **Fully Remote:** Anywhere in the U.S; Chicago HQ
* **A Four-Day Workweek:** Enjoy a full-time schedule of just 32 hours across four days, with more time for life outside of work.
* **Meaningful Time Off:** Generous PTO, paid holidays, and a paid company shutdown from December 24 through January 1.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company matching, and 10 weeks of paid new parent leave.
* **Well-Being That Matters:** A dedicated wellness benefit to support your overall well-being.

**About Us**
------------

**Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.**

At Wonderlic, we believe great work and a fulfilling life should go hand in hand. We're a remote-first company offering a **full-time, 32-hour workweek across four days**, giving our team more time to focus on what matters at work and beyond it.

Our mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with us. We combine decades of science-based assessment expertise with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that help organizations make smarter employment decisions. Our intuitive assessment solutions empower HR teams to identify top applicants, predict on-the-job performance, and build stronger, more successful workforces.

We're proud to bring the same thoughtful, evidence-based approach to how we work as we do to the solutions we create. We believe people do their best work when they have the flexibility, support, and time to thrive, both professionally and personally.

**What Sets Us Apart**

* **Scientific Excellence:** We apply rigorous scientific methodologies to develop assessments that accurately measure individual potential and help organizations make informed talent decisions.
* **Innovation:** We continually explore emerging technologies and methodologies, including machine learning and AI, to keep our solutions at the forefront of talent assessment.
* **Lasting Impact:** By integrating I-O psychology and evidence-based insights, we help organizations hire more effectively, develop talent, and improve long-term employee success and retention.

**Overview:**
-------------

Wonderlic is looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) with deep expertise in the HR technology space. At Wonderlic, we're on a mission to revolutionize the talent solutions space with our leading products, Wonderlic Select and Wonderlic Develop. This pivotal role is not just about maintaining client relationships—it's about driving revenue growth through renewals and expansion, while developing successful long-term partnerships, ensuring our clients derive maximum value from our offerings.

**Your Impact:**
----------------

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, your primary goal will be to drive revenue growth by ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty. You will leverage your sales acumen and HR tech expertise to manage a diverse portfolio of existing customers, building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor. Your ability to navigate complex client needs and align our products with their strategic goals will be crucial in achieving renewals and expansion.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* **Drive Growth and Retention:**
  + Proactively identify opportunities within your existing customer base to drive renewals and expansion, meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
  + Cultivate strong client relationships through strategic conversations that align Wonderlic's solutions with the client's business objectives.
* **Customer Engagement:**
  + Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, representing their voice to internal teams, and ensuring smooth transitions between Sales and Customer Success.
  + Conduct business reviews to assess and ensure the value realization of our products and develop tailored action plans to address any issues.
* **Renewal and Expansion Cycle Management:**
  + Manage and drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from identifying needs to closing renewals and expansions.
  + Use customer health monitoring tools to identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a proactive approach to customer success.
* **Product and Market Expertise:**
  + Develop and maintain deep knowledge of new and existing product offerings, industry trends, and competitive conditions to provide strategic insights and recommendations.
  + Introduce new products and features to customers, ensuring they are fully informed of their value and benefits.
* **Customer Advocacy and Feedback:**
  + Function as a customer advocate within the company, streamlining the customer experience to prevent turnover.
  + Create feedback loops between customers and product teams to identify and remove barriers to customer adoption.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

* **Proven Success:** Recognized for exceptional commercial achievements and consistently exceeding targets – especially in formalized recognition programs.
* **Consistent Excellence:** A strong track record of meeting and surpassing expectations.
* **Stability and Growth:** Demonstrated ability to achieve long-term success and growth within previous roles.
* **HR Tech Expertise:** Extensive experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, ideally with HR technology solutions (Recruiting, HCM, LMS, etc.).
* **Industry Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the challenges faced by HR, Recruiting, and Employee Development leaders.
* **Leadership:** Recognized subject matter expert with experience coaching or mentoring others.
* **Curiosity and Creativity:** Naturally curious and creative in your approach to solving problems.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of **SaaS Customer Success or Account Management experience**, ideally in HR technology solutions (Recruiting, HCM, LMS, etc.).
* **Proven track record** of managing a portfolio of accounts, securing renewals, and **driving revenue growth** through cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
* **Strong sales acumen**, with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with HR and L&D decision-makers.
* **Analytical skills** and the ability to leverage data to guide client conversations and uncover opportunities.
* **Proactive and collaborative mindset**, with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  

Target Total Compensation: This position offers OTE of $110,000 to $140,000, split between a base and variable compensation.

**Our Policy**
--------------

Affirmative Action Plan/Equal Employer Opportunity (AAP/EEO) Statement: Research suggests that both the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can make members of some groups (including women, members of the LGBTQIA+ and BIPOC communities, and candidates of less traditional age, education, or background) less likely to apply for jobs when they don't meet 100% of the qualifications. At Wonderlic, we are in the business of identifying potential, and we encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Wonderlic is proud to be an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. Here, diversity is valued and celebrated, and this is what makes us such a successful team. Wonderlic does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, parental status, military/veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

In addition, we will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please get in touch with us at jobs@wonderlic.com to request an accommodation.

Disclaimer: This job description is not designed to include a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties and responsibilities may change or be assigned at any time, with or without notice.

Our mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with us. We combine decades of science-based assessment expertise with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that help organizations make smarter employment decisions. Our intuitive assessment solutions empower HR teams to identify top applicants, predict on-the-job performance, and build stronger, more successful workforces.

We're proud to bring the same thoughtful, evidence-based approach to how we work as we do to the solutions we create. We believe people do their best work when they have the flexibility, support, and time to thrive, both professionally and personally.

**What Sets Us Apart**

* **Scientific Excellence:** We apply rigorous scientific methodologies to develop assessments that accurately measure individual potential and help organizations make informed talent decisions.
* **Innovation:** We continually explore emerging technologies and methodologies, including machine learning and AI, to keep our solutions at the forefront of talent assessment.
* **Lasting Impact:** By integrating I-O psychology and evidence-based insights, we help organizations hire more effectively, develop talent, and improve long-term employee success and retention.

**Overview:**
-------------

Wonderlic is looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) with deep expertise in the HR technology space. At Wonderlic, we're on a mission to revolutionize the talent solutions space with our leading products, Wonderlic Select and Wonderlic Develop. This pivotal role is not just about maintaining client relationships—it's about driving revenue growth through renewals and expansion, while developing successful long-term partnerships, ensuring our clients derive maximum value from our offerings.

**Your Impact:**
----------------

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, your primary goal will be to drive revenue growth by ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty. You will leverage your sales acumen and HR tech expertise to manage a diverse portfolio of existing customers, building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor. Your ability to navigate complex client needs and align our products with their strategic goals will be crucial in achieving renewals and expansion.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* **Drive Growth and Retention:**
  + Proactively identify opportunities within your existing customer base to drive renewals and expansion, meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
  + Cultivate strong client relationships through strategic conversations that align Wonderlic's solutions with the client's business objectives.
* **Customer Engagement:**
  + Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, representing their voice to internal teams, and ensuring smooth transitions between Sales and Customer Success.
  + Conduct business reviews to assess and ensure the value realization of our products and develop tailored action plans to address any issues.
* **Renewal and Expansion Cycle Management:**
  + Manage and drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from identifying needs to closing renewals and expansions.
  + Use customer health monitoring tools to identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a proactive approach to customer success.
* **Product and Market Expertise:**
  + Develop and maintain deep knowledge of new and existing product offerings, industry trends, and competitive conditions to provide strategic insights and recommendations.
  + Introduce new products and features to customers, ensuring they are fully informed of their value and benefits.
* **Customer Advocacy and Feedback:**
  + Function as a customer advocate within the company, streamlining the customer experience to prevent turnover.
  + Create feedback loops between customers and product teams to identify and remove barriers to customer adoption.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

* **Proven Success:** Recognized for exceptional commercial achievements and consistently exceeding targets – especially in formalized recognition programs.
* **Consistent Excellence:** A strong track record of meeting and surpassing expectations.
* **Stability and Growth:** Demonstrated ability to achieve long-term success and growth within previous roles.
* **HR Tech Expertise:** Extensive experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, ideally with HR technology solutions (Recruiting, HCM, LMS, etc.).
* **Industry Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the challenges faced by HR, Recruiting, and Employee Development leaders.
* **Leadership:** Recognized subject matter expert with experience coaching or mentoring others.
* **Curiosity and Creativity:** Naturally curious and creative in your approach to solving problems.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of **SaaS Customer Success or Account Management experience**, ideally in HR technology solutions (Recruiting, HCM, LMS, etc.).
* **Proven track record** of managing a portfolio of accounts, securing renewals, and **driving revenue growth** through cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
* **Strong sales acumen**, with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with HR and L&D decision-makers.
* **Analytical skills** and the ability to leverage data to guide client conversations and uncover opportunities.
* **Proactive and collaborative mindset**, with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  

Target Total Compensation: This position offers OTE of $110,000 to $140,000, split between a base and variable compensation.

**Our Policy**
--------------

At Wonderlic, we are in the business of identifying potential, and we encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Wonderlic is proud to be an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. Here, diversity is valued and celebrated, and this is what makes us such a successful team. Wonderlic does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, parental status, military/veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

In addition, we will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please get in touch with us at jobs@wonderlic.com to request an accommodation.
