bbe4ca7ec881d2b56fcd.title: Manager of Customer Experience
bbe4ca7ec881d2b56fcd.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Manager of Customer Experience!
  
  
Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!
  
  
Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.
  
  
**Location:** Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.
  
**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $84,000 - $105,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $84,000 - $126,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.
  
This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 15% Bonus Target.
  
  
**Employment Logistics:**  
The Manager of Customer Experience leads customer experience operations, overseeing staff, streamlining procedures, and ensuring efficient workflows. This role develops and executes strategies that enhance the end-to-end customer journey, improve customer satisfaction, and strengthen customer loyalty and retention. The Manager supports escalation pathways between OnTrac’s Commercial and Operations organizations and leads a team of 4–5 employees who support the company’s largest volume and revenue accounts with daily operational questions and escalations.
  
  
**Unpacking the Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\*
* Six (6) paid company holidays
* Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.
  
  
**The Must-Haves:**  

* 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably including supervisory experience, with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Advanced knowledge of customer experience management principles, customer journey mapping, and service design methodologies
* Knowledge of customer satisfaction measurement tools, customer feedback programs, and customer analytics
* Financial literacy to manage budgets and evaluate team ROI
* Ability to lead a team of professionals and provide effective performance coaching
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

**Your Mission in Motion:**  
A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.
  

* Customer experience strategy: Develop and execute strategies that enhance the end-to-end customer journey, improve satisfaction, and strengthen customer loyalty and retention.
* Customer operations & workflow management: Manage customer experience operations, streamline procedures, and ensure efficient, consistent workflows.
* Escalation management & cross-functional alignment: Support escalation pathways between Commercial and Operations, ensuring daily customer questions and operational issues are routed and addressed effectively.
* Strategic account support: Oversee customer experience support for OnTrac’s largest volume and revenue accounts, ensuring timely responses to daily operational questions and escalations.
* Team leadership & performance development: Lead, plan, schedule, and coach a team of 4–5 employees, providing direction and driving consistent performance.

**Paving your way to your success:**  

* You translate customer experience goals into clear, actionable plans.
* You communicate effectively at all levels, tailoring your approach and message to the audience.
* You provide clear direction and support to team members within established company policies.
* You convert functional plans into actionable operational processes and oversee their execution.
* You develop and drive operational initiatives that achieve tactical objectives.

**Posting Timeline:**  
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting
  
  
**Disclosures:**  

* Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base salary offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: Geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.
  
  
Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.
  
  
**ADA Statement:**  
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. If you require reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other employment benefits, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
If you are excited to be part of our team and grow with our OnTrac family, we invite you to apply!
  
  
OnTrac is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
Lasership, Inc. dba OnTrac Final Mile with its affiliates, including OnTrac Logistics, Inc. (collectively, "OnTrac" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or age. Join us in our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you are excited to be part of our team and contribute to our talent acquisition efforts, we invite you to apply.

f5c9f19bcc41e444f236.title: Patient Access Manager
f5c9f19bcc41e444f236.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Entity: Clinical Practices of the University of Pennsylvania (CPUP)**

**Department: Department of Family Medicine and Community Health**

**Location: Penn Presbyterian**

**Hours: Full-Time**

Summary:

  

* The Patient Access Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing all aspects of patient scheduling, access operations, and clinic capacity management to ensure a seamless, efficient, and patient-centered experience for the Department of Family Medicine and Community Health. This role provides operational leadership in managing provider templates, developing and maintaining standard operating procedures, and ensuring efficient use of exam room resources. The manager drives the creation and maintenance of scheduling decision trees and collaborates closely with the Access Center to optimize scripting and workflow alignment.
* Additionally, the Patient Access Manager leads the implementation, adoption, and ongoing maintenance of access-related tools and technologies, ensuring they support organizational access goals and provider practice needs. The role is accountable for designing and delivering access reporting and analytics that inform operational decisions, identify barriers to care, and support continuous improvement. This position requires strong analytical skills, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to partner with providers, clinic leaders, IT, and centralized scheduling teams to improve access, throughput, and patient satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

* Collaborates with departmental Billing Manager and Administrative Coordinator to streamline patient intake.
* Patient scheduling, billing, and coordination of servicesMaintains a patient and customer focus based on patient satisfaction and other indicators
* Provides support to departmental operations to achieve established goals
* The Access Manger will be responsible, in collaboration with departmental leadership, for streamlining patient access and intake across different locations across the department including our community sites and programs.
* Developing and structuring a robust patient access program while partnering closely with provider and operations leadership
* Aligning best practices for patient intake and record collection for a multidisciplinary clinical department.
* Partner closely with department leadership to maximize clinical template efficiency for 50 plus providers.
* Collaborates with the primary clinical providers, practice care teams and data analyst to create, use, and maintain a navigational reporting structure that is able to track the progress of patients who are receiving navigational services.
* Responsible for access team metrics/reporting to key departmental stakeholders
* Functions in an organized and time conscious manner.
* Ensures that the Department access team facilitates well-coordinated, timely compassionate and multidisciplinary care.
* Works across health care disciplines to assist in coordinating patient tests, procedures, appointments, and treatments.
* Develops and continuously improves screening and triage algorithms and processes.
* Tracks departmental processes and reports to ensure access KPI benchmarks are developed and met.
* Adheres to department access policies and recommends changes as appropriate, with a focus on continuous process improvement and optimized patient access.
* Participates as a member of the disease site and network teams.
* Manages the scheduling functions for new, return and simulation patients.Maintains oversight of provider templates in partnership with physicians and practice administrations
* Monitors and oversees the simulation scheduling process to ensure timely completion of order requests received utilizing effective communication and documentation to the clinical team and patient
* Reduces and eliminates preventable patient care delivery impacts, and ensures communication is provided to department service delivery areas when unresolved financial issues could affect a delay in treatment
* Monitors account assignments and work-queues to ensure accounts are being worked timely and appropriately
* Acquires and maintains EPIC scheduling and registration certification
* Works with Operational Leaders to ensure staffing is in accordance with visit volume
* Manages and partners with IS to correct system issues and problems that impact services provided by the department

Education or Equivalent Experience:

  

* Bachelor of Arts or Science (Required)
* 5+ years progressive experience preferably in health care setting with emphasis in Patient Access / Call Center Management (Required)
* Master of Arts or Science and 3+ years progressive experience preferably in health care setting with emphasis in Patient Access / Call Center Management (Preferred)
* Relevant experience will be considered in lieu of degree

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

54db8cd2766e35855c10.title: Remote Support Engineer
54db8cd2766e35855c10.description:
Come join our team! At Unlimited Technology, we are committed to our company's core values of Passion, Collaboration, Innovation and Adaptability. With offices throughout the United States, we are a premier cyber and physical security specialty contractor, and we are growing at a rapid pace. We have a wide range of talented and experienced individuals that deliver cutting edge technology solutions to meet our customers' ever-changing needs. We secure the facilities and networks of the world's leading brands and critical infrastructure and are recognized leaders in the physical and IT security, cyber, and managed services industries. UT offers a rewarding career, great benefits, and the chance to learn and work with ground-breaking technology and premier clients.

The Remote Support Engineer is a senior technical resource routinely relied upon to resolve the most complex issues across supported security platforms, and serves as the assigned technical escalation point for Remote Support Engineer I and II personnel.

Remote access is the primary means of support, and support is provided to all customers who submit a service request and can be accessed remotely, with Shield agreement accounts receiving priority. The position serves as a subject matter expert for supported platforms, leads remote troubleshooting on enterprise, multi-site, and mission-critical environments, and develops and recommends troubleshooting procedures, knowledge articles, and support best practices. This is the Escalate, Resolve and Improve level.

**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the Remote Support Engineering Manager and has no direct reports. Work is assigned through the Remote Support Ticket Request Queue. The Remote Support Engineer III escalates to the Remote Support Engineering Manager and works closely with Service, Project Management, Installation, Systems Engineering, and manufacturers. Engineering levels are cumulative. This position performs the full scope of Remote Support Engineer work across all levels of issue complexity; the responsibilities below reflect the highest level of independent work expected of this position.

**EXPECTED LEVEL OF INDEPENDENCE**

Works as a senior individual contributor and technical authority, providing technical leadership, peer review, mentoring, and escalation support without direct personnel management responsibility. Serves as the assigned escalation point for Remote Support Engineer I and II personnel.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Advanced Support & Escalation

* Provide advanced remote technical support and resolve complex issues across integrated security systems, including enterprise and multi-site environments.
* Serve as the assigned technical escalation point for complex service issues and for Remote Support Engineer I and II personnel.
* Analyze system architecture, configurations, logs, databases, communications, and network performance to determine root cause on the most difficult issues.
* Lead advanced technical escalations with manufacturers and vendors through to resolution.
* Provide remote support for small-scale project work, and identify when project scope exceeds what the support team can absorb without affecting service response.

* Participate in the on-call rotation and extended-hours coverage as the senior escalation resource.

**Communication & Coordination**

* Serve as a primary technical point of contact for assigned service requests throughout the service request lifecycle, from initial response through resolution.
* Provide timely, professional, and proactive status updates to customers, and communicate troubleshooting activities, findings, and recommended actions in terms the customer can act on.
* Set appropriate expectations regarding response, diagnosis, and resolution, including when an issue is complex, requires on-site support, depends on a manufacturer or vendor, or will extend beyond the initial estimate.
* Confirm customers understand the current status of their request, the next steps, and any actions required on their part before closing communication on an issue.
* Communicate clearly with field technicians during active troubleshooting, providing direction, diagnostic guidance, and confirmation of findings so field time is used effectively.
* Keep Service, Project Management, Installation, and Systems Engineering informed of issue status, dependencies, and anything affecting schedule, scope, or customer expectations.
* Escalate promptly and with context when an issue exceeds the engineer's scope, authority, or available information, providing documented findings so the receiving party can act without repeating work already performed.
* Document communication, commitments, and agreed next steps in the ticket record so any engineer picking up the issue has the full history.

**Preventative Maintenance & Shield Delivery**

* Lead preventative maintenance support on complex and enterprise systems, verifying through the software applications that testing is performed correctly, confirming proper operation, and providing reporting back to the client.
* Deliver and oversee maintenance obligations owed under Shield agreements on complex accounts, including software and firmware upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
* Deliver end-user training to enterprise and multi-site customers.

**Technical Leadership & Improvement**

* Develop and recommend troubleshooting procedures, technical standards, knowledge articles, and support best practices for approval.
* Identify recurring and systemic issues, and recommend design modifications, improved maintenance practices, configuration changes, or equipment replacement to improve system reliability and performance.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Remote Support Engineer I and II personnel, and review technical documentation and service records for accuracy.
* Support engineering and project teams with technical assessments, system recommendations, and turnover readiness, and participate in customer technical meetings.
* Lead application of cybersecurity, system hardening, and secure remote-access practices across customer environments.
* Maintain advanced manufacturer certifications across supported platforms, including recertification as platforms release new versions.
* Assume work from other engineers within the team during absence, deadline pressure, or capacity constraints as assigned.
* Follow site-specific safety programs when visiting customer and project sites, and stop work and escalate when conditions are unsafe.
* Maintain professional conduct in occupied, escorted, and secure customer environments, and protect the confidentiality of customer security information, credentials, and system documentation. Other duties as assigned.

**EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of technical experience in electronic security, systems integration, or technical support, including enterprise and mission-critical environments.
* Advanced experience troubleshooting and supporting integrated security systems remotely, including access control, video management, intrusion detection, and intercom systems. Experience with multiple enterprise platforms, which may include Genetec, Software House (CCURE), Hirsch, Gallagher, Lenel, AMAG, Milestone, Exacq, DMP, Radionix, BVMS, Mercury platforms, Hanwha, Axis, Verkada, Avigilon, Brivo, and Salient CompleteView.
* Advanced knowledge of networking, servers, databases, virtualization, and operating systems, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, Windows Server, and firewall configuration.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, system hardening, and secure remote-access practices.
* Advanced manufacturer certification on primary supported platforms required and maintained throughout employment, combined with demonstrated advanced proficiency across multiple supported technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, review technical documentation, and serve as a technical escalation point.
* Ability to manage multiple complex technical issues and priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
* Proficient with ticketing, documentation, and knowledge management tools, with Bluebeam for reviewing drawings and as-built records, and with Microsoft Office.
* Ability to travel up to 20% and meet applicable customer, site-access, badging, and background investigation requirements.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Technical Leadership – Provides sound direction on complex technical issues.
* People Development – Coaches and develops technical talent.
* Customer Focus – Prioritizes system reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Problem Solving – Drives issues to root-cause resolution.
* Communication – Clearly communicates with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration – Partners effectively across Engineering, Service, Operations, Installation, Business Development, and Project Management.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Primarily an office-based technical role; prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer, communicating in person, by phone, and through virtual platforms, and available outside standard business hours as coverage and escalation require.
* Occasional access to customer and project sites, equipment rooms, and construction areas; ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb ladders, and wear required PPE.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 20 pounds occasionally, with assistance or mechanical aid for heavier items. Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required.

This description defines the scope of the position. Assignment to and advancement between levels is determined by the Manager based on sustained demonstrated performance, business need, and available position, and is not established by performing individual tasks described at a higher level.

This description is not an exhaustive list of all duties or skills required, and incumbents may be assigned additional duties. Unlimited Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision coverage
* Life insurance
* 401 (k) w/company match 100% up to 3% and an additional 50% match of 2%
* Paid time off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Company Equity after 1 year

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, sex, age, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.***

f564f18909040bf5e8c9.title: Director, Human Resources
f564f18909040bf5e8c9.description:
**USPack** is a leading logistics provider custom built for the evolving needs of businesses in today’s same-day delivery world. At **USPack** our focus every day is to help brands and businesses win in the delivery economy. That’s why we keep our finger on the pulse of the latest trends and developments that impact our business and our customers’ businesses. That’s how we stay ahead. That’s how we help our customers win.

**Find out more at:** **www.gouspack.com**

At **USPack**, we know our people set us apart. And that’s why we do everything we can to invest in them and help them grow every day.We don’t put people in jobs, we work with them to develop long-term career paths that are rewarding, challenging, and fulfilling. We’ve built an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and a sense of belonging. We value input, we demand collaboration, and we recognize performance. We work together, we play together, and we succeed together! **Get on the path to a successful career that delivers more!**

**USPack’s Benefits for Full Time positions include:**

* 401(K)
* Health Insurance
* Disability/Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Holidays

**USPack’s Benefits for Part Time positions include:**

* 401(K)
* Paid Sick Time

The **Director, Human Resources** leads the strategic vision and day-to-day execution of the HR function across the organization. This role balances forward looking strategy with practical oversight of core HR areas, including talent acquisition, employee relations, compliance, organizational development, compensation and benefits, and workforce planning.

The Director ensures HR initiatives align with business goals, strengthen operational performance, and maintain regulatory compliance. This position also plays a key role in building a consistent, accountable, and performance focused culture across corporate teams and support functions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following essential duties satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Individual tasks shall include but not be limited to the following:

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Strategic HR Leadership:**

* Lead the development and execution of enterprise-wide HR initiatives including but not limited to succession planning and leadership development.
* Analyze workforce trends, metrics, and reporting to support data-driven HR decision-making.
* Partner with executive leadership to design and execute a long-term human capital strategy aligned with business objectives and industry trends.
* Advise on organizational design, talent planning, change management, and workforce scalability to support growth and seasonal demand.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - HR Operations and Compliance:**

* Maintain and update the employee handbook, HR policies, and procedures to ensure legal compliance and alignment with company culture.
* Lead HR audits and manage risk mitigation strategies in partnership with legal and compliance teams.
* Oversee daily HR operations to ensure consistent, efficient application of policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including wage and hour regulations, OSHA and DOT standards, and employment eligibility requirements

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning:**

* Direct end-to-end recruitment efforts, with emphasis on high volume roles within logistics, transportation, and warehousing environments.
* Oversee workforce planning and staffing models to align operational demand with budget and headcount strategy.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Employee Relations and Engagement:**

* Promote a respectful, performance driven culture across diverse employee populations.
* Provide leadership on employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution.
* Coach leaders on effective communication, performance feedback, and engagement best practices.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Performance Management and Development:**

* Oversee the company’s performance management framework to ensure alignment with business goals and individual accountability.
* Support career progression and succession strategies to strengthen long term organizational stability.
* Develop and implement training initiatives supporting compliance, skill development, and leadership growth.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Compensation and Benefits:**

* Oversee compensation strategy, including base pay, incentive plans, and benefits administration.
* Partner with finance and operations on annual merit cycles, incentive planning, and workforce budgeting.
* Monitor market trends to maintain competitive and equitable total rewards programs.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Provide leadership and direct oversight of HR Manager and administrative HR staff.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications - Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Demonstrated strategic thinking and strong business acumen, with the ability to align HR initiatives to operational and financial objectives.
* Comprehensive knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Effective conflict resolution and negotiation skills, with the ability to navigate complex employee relations matters.
* Experience managing HR operations across multi-site or geographically dispersed environments.
* Proficiency in analyzing workforce data and interpreting HR metrics to inform decision making and strategy.
* Expertise in organizational development and leading change initiatives within dynamic business environments.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and partnerships across all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated cultural competency and commitment to fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace.
* Required travel on occasion **up to 10%** to support organizational objectives.

### **Qualifications - Education, Experience, Certificates, and Licenses:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree or HR certification such as SHRM SCP or SPHR preferred.
* Minimum of 8 to 10 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated success in both strategic HR planning and hands-on execution within a fast paced, multi site organization.
* Experience utilizing HRIS platforms and workforce data reporting tools.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred.

**Shift Days:** Monday-Friday

**Shift Hours:** 8:00AM - 5:00PM (Available to work extra hours, weekends, and holidays preferred.)

**Pay Rate:** up to $110,000 salaried (Dependent upon experience level.)

At **USPack**, our values are at the heart of everything we do, every day. They’re living breathing reminders of who we are, what we do and how we should treat those around us. They guide our actions, our interactions, and our decisions. They are what drive us.

**We are:**

**Driven by integrity** –We're driven by honesty, transparency, and trust. We know that actions speak louder than words. We hold ourselves to higher ethical standards that help build credibility and follow through on commitments. 77846468ab2b8acc9d11.description:
Senior Director, Member Engagement Operations (Remote)

**About Us:**

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- *We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.*- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

**Why Work at Matrix?**

  

* The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
* A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
* Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
* Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

**About the role:**

**Type:** Full Time, Salary

**Compensation:** $134,000-$202,000/yr., 20-30% Bonus

**Location:** Fully Remote, must be in the United States

**Hours:** Full Time Days

**Benefits Offered to include:** Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

**What to Expect:**

The Sr. Director, Member Engagement Operations is responsible for leading the operational execution of Matrix Medical Network's omnichannel member engagement strategy, ensuring a seamless, consistent, and effective experience across all member interaction channels. This role provides strategic operational leadership and accountability for contact center operations, business process outsourcing (BPO) partnerships, member engagement technologies, and performance optimization.

The Sr. Director oversees the integration and execution of member engagement activities across voice, text, chat, digital self-service, and scheduling channels, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve member access, engagement, conversion, and operational efficiency. This leader is accountable for vendor performance, quality outcomes, and the successful implementation of an evolving, technology-enabled engagement model.

Working collaboratively with Marketing, Product & Technology, Enterprise Demand & Planning, and Clinical/Compliance leadership, this position translates enterprise strategies into scalable operational processes that support business objectives, improve the member experience, and drive measurable performance results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Member Engagement Operations & Omnichannel Execution**

* Lead the operational execution of Matrix's member engagement model across multiple communication channels, including inbound and outbound calls, two-way text messaging, chat, digital self-service, and scheduling.
* Ensure consistent, coordinated member interactions throughout the engagement lifecycle, from initial outreach and appointment scheduling through visit confirmation and completion.
* Develop and implement scalable operational processes that improve member accessibility, responsiveness, engagement, and conversion.
* Oversee the integration of engagement channels to create a seamless member experience while optimizing operational performance and resource utilization.
* Partner with Enterprise Demand & Planning to align workforce deployment, channel utilization, and operational activities with business demand and engagement priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance member engagement through alternative channels, strategic partnerships, and innovative outreach approaches.

**Contact Center & Vendor Management**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight of outsourced contact center and BPO partners, ensuring alignment with established service expectations, contractual commitments, and performance standards.
* Lead operational planning, onboarding, transitions, and performance stabilization for BPO partnerships to ensure service continuity and business readiness.
* Establish vendor governance, performance scorecards, service-level expectations, and accountability measures to drive consistent operational results.
* Monitor vendor and agent-level productivity, quality, efficiency, and member engagement outcomes, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to evaluate vendor capabilities, identify operational risks, and recommend improvements to the overall service delivery model.
* Ensure consistent operational processes, quality standards, and member experiences across internal and outsourced engagement activities.

**Technology, Automation & AI-Enabled Engagement**

* Lead the operational implementation and adoption of technology-enabled engagement solutions, including automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI capabilities across voice, text, and chat channels.
* Partner with Product & Technology to optimize contact center platforms, member engagement systems, and digital scheduling capabilities.
* Establish operational processes and performance standards for AI-enabled tools, including automated quality assurance, interaction documentation, call dispositions, and real-time agent guidance.
* Leverage engagement analytics, propensity models, and next-best-action capabilities to improve outreach effectiveness, channel selection, and member conversion.
* Oversee the operational utilization and optimization of enterprise engagement platforms, including Care Compass and Genesys.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and operational capabilities that improve member engagement, productivity, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate operational controls, quality monitoring, and compliance considerations are incorporated into technology-enabled engagement processes.

**Performance Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators to evaluate member engagement effectiveness, operational efficiency, vendor performance, and overall service quality.
* Drive performance improvement initiatives focused on contact rates, acceptance rates, conversion rates, cost per completed assessment, and member experience outcomes.
* Utilize operational data, reporting, and analytics to identify performance trends, service gaps, and opportunities to improve engagement strategies and processes.
* Develop and implement quality assurance frameworks that evaluate both individual agent/vendor performance and the end-to-end member engagement experience.
* Ensure scheduling, reminders, confirmations, and visit completion processes are accurate, coordinated, and effective across applicable visit types.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce operational costs, improve productivity, and enhance member satisfaction.
* Provide regular performance updates, operational insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Marketing to operationalize member communication strategies, messaging, and content across engagement channels while maintaining clear functional accountability.
* Partner with Product & Technology to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions and operational workflows.
* Work closely with Clinical and Compliance leadership to ensure member engagement processes support clinical requirements, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Demand & Planning leadership to align workforce management execution, staffing priorities, and channel capacity with operational needs.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives supporting new engagement capabilities, vendor transitions, process improvements, and enterprise transformation efforts.
* Identify operational risks, dependencies, and opportunities, proactively developing solutions that support business continuity and strategic objectives.
* Serve as a key operational advisor to executive leadership on member engagement performance, capabilities, and improvement opportunities.

**Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for assigned teams, vendor relationships, and operational initiatives.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operational priorities, and accountability measures to support high-performing teams and partners.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, innovation, and member-focused service delivery.
* Develop organizational capabilities to support evolving engagement technologies, operational models, and business requirements.
* Effectively lead through organizational change, balancing strategic priorities with timely execution and measurable results.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline preferred.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, contact center operations, member engagement, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multichannel contact center operations, including outsourced BPO partnerships.
* Proven experience managing vendor performance, operational transitions, and complex service delivery models.
* Experience within Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, managed care, value-based care, or related healthcare environments strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, technology-enabled solutions, and performance optimization initiatives.
* Experience leveraging AI, automation, predictive analytics, or advanced engagement technologies in a production environment preferred.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business results within aggressive timelines.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong understanding of healthcare member engagement, contact center operations, and omnichannel service delivery models.
* Expertise in outsourced vendor management, performance governance, quality assurance, and operational accountability.
* Working knowledge of contact center technologies, CRM platforms, digital engagement tools, and workforce management principles.
* Ability to translate strategic business objectives into actionable operational plans, processes, and performance expectations.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret operational metrics and drive data-informed decisions.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled engagement technologies, automation capabilities, and emerging contact center innovations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex operational transformations and manage competing priorities in a dynamic business environment.
* Strong executive communication, relationship management, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to identify operational risks, develop solutions, and execute improvements while maintaining service continuity.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a focus on accountability, team development, change management, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory requirements, member privacy, and compliance considerations relevant to member engagement operations.

**Our Culture**:

* We have a clear vision of where we are going, and we are guided by core values that embody our organization and our culture.
* We emphasizes innovation and growth, and you will be given the opportunities and tools to develop personally and professionally.
* We encourage and celebrate collaboration.
* We have a deep commitment to positively impact the communities in which we work and to make a difference in the lives of who we serve.

* Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

* Business Professional - Non-Exempt

* Facilities and Administration

The Facilities Development Manager plans, coordinates, and executes capital projects across the firm’s real estate portfolio, including law firm office buildouts, renovations, infrastructure upgrades, and related facilities initiatives and projects. This role serves as a day-to-day point of contact for project coordination, budgets, timelines, issue escalation, and communication between internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with firm standards.

  
  

This position will also serve as a key contact for Office Services and Office Coordinators, providing operational structure and support across the firm’s nine offices.

  
  

While this position offers the flexibility of a hybrid work arrangement, it is essential to note that in-person presence is required as the job demands. The nature of the role necessitates regular on-site attendance to effectively fulfill the responsibilities and ensure seamless operations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Project Planning & Execution:**

* Develop project scopes, budgets, and schedules for capital improvement initiatives.
* Conduct feasibility studies and risk assessments.
* Prepare and manage RFPs, bids, and contract negotiations.
* Support ongoing management of the firm’s real estate portfolio, including law firm office buildouts, relocations, renovations, and related facilities planning initiatives.

**Communication and Organization**

* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Maintain detailed project documentation and ensure timely follow-up on all action items.
* Schedule and lead project meetings with internal teams/stakeholders and external vendors.
* Provide regular updates to the Director of Facilities on progress, challenges, and next steps.
* Expertise in scheduling, meeting coordination, note taking and follow-up processes.

**Timeline Adherence:**

* Monitor project milestones and proactively address delays to keep projects on schedule.
* Implement corrective actions when timelines are at risk.

**Budget Management & Reconciliation:**

* Manage project budgets, track expenditures, and reconcile costs against approved allocations.
* Prepare financial reports and ensure transparency in budget adjustments.
* Support annual budget planning and Capital Improvement Planning (CIPs) by identifying project needs, estimating costs, and aligning proposed investments with firm priorities.
* Report out to stakeholders on a regular basis.

**Construction & Vendor Management:**

* Oversee contractors, consultants, and vendors to ensure adherence to specifications and timelines.
* Monitor progress, when applicable present change order requests, and resolve issues promptly.

**Compliance & Quality Control:**

* Ensure compliance with building codes, ADA requirements, and safety regulations.
* Implement quality assurance processes throughout the project lifecycle.

**Collaboration & Communication:**

* Coordinate with internal teams, architects, engineers, vendors, and external partners.
* Maintain clear communication and provide updates to stakeholders.
* Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for facilities-related project coordination, responding to routine questions, escalating issues as needed, and ensuring timely communication between internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Support day-to-day facilities and administrative services operations, including invoice coordination, understanding site-specific needs, and serving as a point of contact for local Office Coordinators across firm locations.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree. Minimum 5 years in facilities management or capital project management, with proven experience in large-scale renovations or construction projects. PMP and/or FMP certification a plus.

Must be comfortable with travel as needed for project oversight, vendor coordination, and site visits. Estimated travel requirement: **up to 30%** but must be flexible to project demands.

  

Stradley Ronon offers a competitive benefits package that includes medical, vision, dental, and prescription drug coverage; health savings account (with applicable medical plan); flexible spending accounts; life insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; and 401(k). Additionally, the firm provides family forming and hormonal health benefits; childcare leave; backup child and adult care; pre-tax commuter benefits; an employee assistance program; a wellbeing program; vacation and other paid time off.

  
  

**No agencies please.** For questions regarding this position, please contact Julie Oates, Talent Acquisition Manager, at joates@stradley.com. Outside agencies, search firms and/or their representatives will not be compensated in any way for unsolicited candidate submissions, or submissions made through anyone other than a Legal Recruiting Department representative.

  
  

Stradley Ronon Stevens & Young, LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This role will provide project coordination, operational, and documentation support to PMO leadership and collaborate with internal teams and federal stakeholders to manage cost estimation, proposal reviews, project delivery, reporting, onboarding, and process improvement activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage project resources/direct reports and subcontractors, including work allocation monitoring of activities; timesheet approvals, performance support, professional development, resource activation, and timely completion of commitments.
* Support PMO leadership in coordinating activities and project operations directly related to the execution of Federal Partner agency mission objectives.
* Collaborate with federal stakeholders and internal teams to support project delivery, issue tracking, and status reporting.
* Create, maintain, and review project documentation, including proposals, cost estimates, burn reports, statements of work, and standard operating procedures.
* Assist with onboarding new resources and coordinating team activities across internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports, monitor project activities, and help track action items, risks, and issues.
* Support executive and client-facing reporting by consolidating updates and preparing clear, accurate communications.
* Coordinate across Operations, Strategy, Contracts, Development, and Partner Services teams to support project needs.
* Promote collaboration, organization, and process consistency across PMO activities.
* Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, ensuring the team stays agile and responsive.
* Support the development and implementation of project management best practices and tools within the PMO.
* Manage and track project deadlines to ensure timely delivery of project milestones and deliverables.
* Support additional PMO-related activities as assigned.
* Create, manage, and review project documentation, including proposals, cost estimates, burn reports, statements of work, standard operating procedures, status reports, meeting materials, and executive briefings.
* Oversee project financial and operational performance by monitoring funding, labor, burn rates, forecasts, charge codes, invoices, timesheets, and resource data; identify and resolve discrepancies.

**What You Will Need****:**

* Bachelor’s degree OR Additional FIVE (5) years of equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum FIVE (5) years of project coordination, project management support, client support, or related experience.
* Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred
* Experience supporting project documentation, reporting, and operational processes.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, including experience developing or maintaining burn reports and tracking tools.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, track, and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Experience creating or maintaining standard operating procedures and other process documentation.
* Ability to support risk and issue tracking and follow established mitigation procedures.

**What Would Be Nice To Have****:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong skills in Microsoft products, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and SharePoint.
* Strong interpersonal and customer support skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification or equivalent.

* Knowledge of federal grants management processes.
* Experience working with federal clients, programs, or government-facing environments.
* Experience supporting PMO functions in a consulting, federal, or mission-driven environment.
* Experience with enterprise software platform tools, such as Jira or Salesforce.

The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

**What We Offer:**

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Benefits include:

* Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

e249d5a01b95fe17f6db.description:
Job Description:

**Role title:** Manager, Data Migration

**Salary range:** $90,000 - $125,000 USD

**Location:** Remote - US - Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta

**The opportunity**

Applied is building the connective intelligence that moves insurance. Every function contributes to that work. In this role, you will lead a team of Data Migration Engineers who move customer data from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products.

As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager sets priorities, adapts plans when resources or operations shift, and makes sure customers get high quality migration outcomes. You guide your team on technical work and partner with Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to deliver complex, end-to-end projects.  
  
This role works hand in hand with a global Data Services team using a Follow the Sun delivery model. You will keep work moving across regions and time zones, hand off cleanly, and step in when a project needs extra attention. You work within established policies, procedures, and business plans, and you take direction from your senior leader. Success here takes steady judgment, clear communication, and a coaching mindset as tools, platforms, and processes keep evolving.

**What** **you’ll** **own**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Migration Engineers, including regular 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, and corrective action or performance improvement plans when needed
* Own the team’s performance and results, using project data, quality dashboards, and workload metrics to track progress and guide improvement
* Provide technical guidance to your team, colleagues, and customers on data migration approaches, including script review, scope review, and troubleshooting complex issues
* Adapt priorities and project plans when resources, timelines, or operational needs change, so the team works on what matters most
* Monitor projects daily and weekly, spot risks early, and step in on escalations and project fires across Slack, Jira, and email
* Review and approve script requests, development tickets, and post-activation scripts, following Data Services policies and procedures
* Support quality control by monitoring quality boards and dashboards, and by driving fixes when issues show up
* Monitor and manage team costs, including timesheets, additional compensation, and weekend coverage hours
* Recommend changes to Data Services policies, processes, and tooling, and keep documentation current as those changes roll out
* Partner with Development, Operations, and cloud and engineering teams to resolve defects, escalate infrastructure issues, and shape new or evolving solutions
* Work with fellow managers, supervisors, and functional peers to align schedules, resources, and handoffs across regions and time zones
* Explain complex technical information clearly to audiences who know the subject, and present project and program updates that build cooperation across teams
* Take part in the management rotation for weekend coverage, including monitoring live merges and go/no-go decisions
* Help advance department initiatives, including adopting cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery and intelligent tooling that improves migration speed, scalability, and quality

**What** **you’ll** **bring**

* Experience leading or mentoring technical teams, with a track record of coaching people, setting clear goals, and handling performance conversations with care
* Strong working knowledge of database structures and SQL, with enough depth to review scripts and guide engineers through complex migration, integration, or transformation work
* Solid understanding of ETL concepts, data mapping, and data quality best practices
* Hands-on experience with SaaS data migration or ETL initiatives in a production environment
* Ability to manage multiple competing project timelines and adjust plans quickly, while keeping customers and quality front and center
* Comfort leading in a collaborative, global environment where work moves across regions and time zones
* Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics, present to peers and stakeholders, and gain cooperation across teams and with customers during escalations
* Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions within established policies and business plans, while staying calm when priorities change
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline

**What could set you apart**

* Experience or exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery and Cloud Storage
* Experience introducing automation, scripting, or AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, migration, or quality assurance
* Experience with insurance technology or agency management systems
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, Slack, or similar tools to track work, collaborate across teams, and document processes
* Experience with HR and workforce tools such as UKG for timekeeping and performance management

*Your background may bring strengths we have not listed here. If the role and its impact interest you, we encourage you to apply.*

**Build a career that moves an industry**

Applied is the connective intelligence transforming how insurance works. We build the platforms, data, and intelligent systems that connect agencies and carriers across the insurance lifecycle.

Here, careers move with the work. You can own meaningful decisions, build what reaches the market, expand your scope as the business evolves, and work alongside people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they create.

**What you can expect**

* **Work with reach:** Build products, services, or programs that support agencies, carriers, and teammates across the insurance lifecycle.
* **Ownership with context:** Make decisions with a clear view of customer needs, business priorities, and the teammates who bring the work to market.
* **Growth through scope:** Expand your impact through meaningful projects, cross-functional exposure, learning opportunities, and stretch work as the business evolves.
* **Built by people:** Work with people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they build, and who share accountability for moving the work forward.

Use the language above as a starting point for consistency and quality. Adjust as needed to fit the role, provided every claim is accurate, current, and tied to the work, team, or business impact.

**Benefits and support**

Our benefits support your health, time, and life beyond work.

**NORTH AMERICA**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage

* Holiday and vacation time

* Health and wellness days

* A day off for your birthday

**Compensation transparency**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $125,000 USD. Starting pay reflects the role’s scope and the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

**Candidate security**

Applied communicates with candidates through an @appliedsystems.com email address or our official careers portal. Our recruiters will never request payment or ask for bank account details, government identification numbers, or other sensitive financial information during initial recruiting conversations.

**Background checks**

Employment is contingent on successful completion of the background checks and verification steps that apply to the role and location.

**Use of AI in recruitment**

Applied may use AI-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, such as organizing application information, scheduling, and workflow administration. Hiring decisions include human review and follow applicable laws and company policy. [Insert any additional approved notice required for this role or location.]

**Equal employment opportunity**

Applied Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions based on job-related qualifications and business needs, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.
