6dfc13191f52623899e4.description:
Description:

At BRT, great driving team members keep the business moving—and strong relationships help them thrive. BRT is seeking a motivated, personable, and organized CDL-A Driving Team Member Recruiting and Retention Coordinator to attract qualified driving team members, create a welcoming hiring experience, and support lasting relationships with BRT driving team members.

If you enjoy meeting people, solving problems, and turning a good conversation into a great connection, this role puts those strengths to work. You will help candidates navigate the hiring process and stay connected with driving team members to strengthen engagement and long-term retention.

**What You’ll Do**

**Driving Team Member Recruiting and Onboarding**

* Develop and maintain a pipeline of qualified and experienced CDL-A driving team member candidates
* Respond to applications and candidate inquiries promptly and professionally
* Conduct initial telephone screenings to evaluate qualifications, experience, employment history, availability, and interest
* Explain BRT’s driving opportunities, compensation, benefits, schedules, equipment, operating areas, home-time expectations, and job requirements
* Maintain communication with candidates throughout the hiring process and coordinate interviews, applications, documentation, and pre-employment activities
* Partner with Human Resources, Safety, and Operations to help candidates move efficiently through the qualification and onboarding process
* Support driving team member referral programs, recruiting incentives, sign-on bonuses, job fairs, recruiting events, and driving team member-focused advertising
* Reconnect with qualified former applicants and eligible former team members when appropriate
* Maintain accurate recruiting records and help evaluate the effectiveness of recruiting sources

**Driving Team Member Engagement and Retention**

* Build professional, trust-based relationships with new and existing driving team members
* Conduct scheduled retention check-ins and stay interviews to understand the experiences, concerns, and ideas of new and existing driving team members
* Listen to feedback regarding communication, schedules, equipment, compensation, training, management support, home time, and other workplace matters
* Document concerns, communicate them to the appropriate manager, and follow up to help ensure they receive appropriate attention
* Identify recurring concerns and trends that may affect driving team member morale, engagement, and retention, with a focus upon strong Driver retention metrics
* Provide leadership with updates and reports on recruiting activity, turnover, retention risks, driving team member feedback, and opportunities for improvement
* Support initiatives that strengthen communication, recognition, engagement, and BRT’s workplace culture
* Maintain confidentiality, professional boundaries, and a positive, supportive approach when working with team members

**Work Environment and Schedule**

* Office-based / hybrid work arrangements
* Occasional evening or weekend communication may be necessary to accommodate driving team member and candidate schedules
* Occasional travel to BRT facilities, recruiting events, orientation locations, and driving team member operating areas may be required
* General office duties, extended computer and telephone use, and occasional lifting or carrying of recruiting materials weighing up to 25 pounds are part of the role.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time salaried position
* Hybrid Schedule: Work from home two days per week after completing your probationary period
* Standard core office hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-4:30 PM
* Supportive team environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and cross-training
* Performance-based bonus up to $4,000
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, paid time off, wellness program, and more

**Why Join BRT?**

Recruiting great drivers is just the beginning. At BRT, this role is about building relationships, following through, and creating an environment where drivers want to stay. Your efforts will directly support recruiting success, driver satisfaction, and long-term retention.

Bring your people skills, personality, and commitment to helping BRT make a great first impression and build lasting connections.

**Ready to Help Drive BRT Forward?**

BRT, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Requirements:

**What You’ll Bring**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Experience in recruiting, transportation, driving team member relations, team member engagement, customer service, sales, dispatch, or a related field required
* Familiarity with CDL-A transportation, petroleum hauling, tanker and hazardous-materials operations, including CDL licensing, required endorsements, and basic driver qualification requirements, is strongly preferred
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with candidates and driving team members.
* Excellent organization, time management, and follow-up skills
* Ability to manage multiple candidates, appointments, deadlines, and competing priorities
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* Proficiency with email, word-processing software, spreadsheets, applicant-tracking systems, AI, and other business technology
* Valid license to operate a motor vehicle and acceptable driving record when travel is required

1b7458c94bbaa2e6dd55.title: Master Coordinator
1b7458c94bbaa2e6dd55.description:
**On-site Position - Audubon, PA**  
  
A Master Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the PJM system is properly scheduled in accordance with PJM Market Rules and ensure that transactions in the PJM energy market are administered consistent with current rules and procedures. Additionally, s/he has the responsibility and the authority to take direct and timely real-time actions (without obtaining higher level approval) including directing shedding of firm load to prevent or alleviate System Operating Limit or Reliability Operating Limit Violations.
  
  
Master Coordinators must have a thorough understanding or the technical ability to obtain a thorough understanding of:

  

* The basic principles and theory of electricity and interconnected system operations, including all PJM operating and safety policies sufficient to maintain system reliability and robust markets.
* Forecasting techniques and analysis methodology.
* PJM Member Company operating policies, PJM markets, and unit scheduling procedures as well as an awareness of those of neighboring systems and their interactions with PJM.
* PJM computer systems, the real-time scheduling and transaction programs, the interrelationships of PJM Member Company and NERC tagging computer systems.
* Understanding of the regional transmission tariff by coordinating the scheduled use of transmission service and implementing curtailments as necessary.

This is a rotating shift position and requires staffing 7 x 24 including holidays. This position requires successful testing through the Profiles XT assessment and obtaining NERC/PJM Certification and other training requirements within the allotted timeframe. The Profiles XT assessment is a validated testing process that evaluates the success of system operators at PJM.  
  
The Master Coordinator position is as an entry point for all new hires and requires advancement to the next level – Generation Dispatcher - within a specified time period. All Master Coordinators must receive training and pass tests (written and simulator) for the Generation Dispatcher position no later than whenever management determines an on-the-job trainer is available for him/her and s/he has completed the necessary 12 week training period.

**Master Coordinator Training:**  
  
Training includes online training, self-study, one-on-one training, simulations, and On the Job Training (OJT). Twelve weeks of the training program consists of OJT under the supervision of an OJT trainer who guides the trainee in acquiring the knowledge and skills required for the position. Prior to being qualified as a Master Coordinator the candidate is required to successfully complete the Master Coordinator computer based final exam with a minimum score of 80%. The candidate is also required to successfully complete a hands-on examination on the Operator Training Simulator (OTS) with a minimum score of 80%.  
  
This position requires successful testing through the Profiles XT assessment and obtaining NERC certification at the Reliability Coordinator or Balancing and Interchange level and PJM Generation certification and other training requirements within the allotted timeframe. The Profiles XT assessment is a validated testing process that evaluates the success of system operators at PJM.  
  
Additionally, the Master Coordinator has the responsibility and the authority to take direct and timely real-time actions (without obtaining higher level approval) including directing shedding of firm load to prevent or alleviate System Operating Limit or Reliability Operating Limit Violations.  
  
**Essential Functions:**

  

* Maintain power system reliability by ensuring operations are in compliance with applicable NERC standards and PJM operating and emergency procedures.
* Operates PJM OASIS site and provides customer support to the energy scheduling process.
* Process all customer inquiries and requests for energy transactions, scheduling, and generation outage information in a timely and effective manner.
* Represent PJM as contact personnel for the following systems: OASIS, TMS, EES, NERC IDC, OATI, eDart generator outages, Supplemental Status Report, Generation Checkout, and Second Pass Commitment questions.
* Directs the scheduling of generating units of the PJM participants to meet the PJM load and reserve requirements for future operating periods to gain maximum system economy within established PJM reliability criteria.
* Monitors generating unit (over 1000 generators) capability changes, return dates, operating constraints, start-up and minimum run times.
* Works in conjunction with PJM’s Market Operations and Reliability Engineers to determine the generator unit scheduling strategy and directs the implementation of that strategy through the PJM participants.
* Monitors and adjusts the strategy as changes on the actual system occur.
* Forecasts (and revises) the PJM system load forecast for the next seven days by monitoring weather forecasts throughout the PJM service territory.
* Monitors all input data to the scheduling and transaction database for accuracy and resolves discrepancies with the PJM participants.
* Maintains records and logs of all pertinent scheduling and transaction related information used in after-the-fact analysis and reviews.
* Participates in training programs. Serves as a trainer for new Master Coordinators and familiarizes other employees, both with dispatching and outside the department, with the scheduling functions.
* Approves unit maintenance outages of generating units based on the projected PJM reserve situations.
* Takes arrangements for unit outages (tickets) and approves all maintenance outage requests.
* Reviewing participant data for correctness.
* Maintaining customer confidence and protect operations by keeping information confidential.
* Manages an increasing customer contact commitment and therefore, a greater focus on customer service competencies
* Must be able to remain a certified NERC and PJM System Operator
* Assists in the development, evaluation and enhancements to new or existing tools, applications and systems
* Continually demonstrates flexibility in adapting to an environment of rapid change and growing complexity.
* Ability to independently handle multiple changing agendas in a quick-paced, stressful, and deadline-driven work environment.
* Assists in administration of PJM Transaction and Energy Markets.
* Requires rotating shift work (including scheduled weekends and evening periods).

**Characteristics & Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* High School Diploma
* 0-5 years of experience
* Ability to visualize and solve complex problems
* Ability to apply analytical and mathematical solutions
* Experience in customer service/support

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor of Science, Engineering
* AS, Computer Science
* NERC Certified System Operator Upon Hire
* PJM Operator Certifications Upon Hire

58b009f98d8c477e2092.description:
**Please note:** This role is posted as Customer Support & Monitoring Specialist - Emergency Response for candidate sourcing purposes only. The official title for this position is **Wildfire Response Specialist**

Please note: We do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

***Location:*** *Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST/MST time zones are preferred.*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for "Most Innovative Housing Concept" and the Best of IBS Award for "Best Home Technology."

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We're building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

**About This Opportunity**

When a wildfire is moving toward a Frontline customer's home, you will be the calm, knowledgeable voice on the other end of the line. As a Wildfire Response Specialist, you will be part of Frontline's dedicated 24/7 response team, helping homeowners and commercial customers make sure their wildfire defense systems are ready, running, and doing their job when it matters most.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within 10 miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam, switching to a pool, tank, or well if water pressure drops. Your job is to make sure the people behind those systems are never on their own: before, during, and after a fire.

You will answer inbound calls and messages around the clock, reach out proactively to customers in a fire's path, troubleshootsystem and connectivity issues in real time, and coordinate with our engineering and field service teams so every issue is resolved. Off-peak, you will help customers get ready for fire season and help us build the playbooks, tools, and processes this team runs on. This is a remote, hourly role with rotating shifts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Active Fire Response**

* Monitor active wildfire incidents and Frontline's fire-tracking alerts, identify customers within alert range, and prioritize outreach based on fire proximity. behavior, and evacuation status.
* Proactively contact customers in a fire's path to confirm they received their alerts and understand their system's status, and guide them through activation or override decisions in the Frontline app.
* Verify system readiness in real time, including controller connectivity, backup battery, water pressure, and secondary water source, and resolve or escalate issues immediately.
* Provide calm, clear guidance to customers who are evacuating or under stress, always reinforcing that personal safety and official evacuation orders come first.
* Track incidents using official sources (e.g., CAL FIRE, InciWeb, National Weather Service Red Flag Warnings, and local evacuation zone maps) and share accurate, timely updates with customers and internal teams.
* Log system activity and performance during fire events, including activation, runtime, water source changes, and faults, and escalate failures to on-call engineering and field service without delay.

**24/7 Customer Support**

* Respond to inbound calls, texts, emails, and app messages from homeowners and commercial customers at any hour, in fire season and out of it.
* Troubleshoot the Frontline app, controller, alerts, and connectivity (Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite) over the phone, and walk customers through solutions step by step.
* Follow a defined escalation matrix to bring in engineering, field service, or leadership when an issue goes beyond first-line support, and own the issue through resolution.
* Create and manage service tickets and dispatch requests so field technicians have everything they need to act.
* Keep detailed, accurate records of every interaction, decision, and follow-up in our ticketing and customer systems.

**Post-Fire Recovery**

* Follow up with every affected customer after a fire event to confirm system status and schedule foam and water refills, inspections, or repairs with our field service team.
* Document system performance and property outcomes after each event so the data can inform product improvements and Frontline's performance reporting.

**Readiness & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead proactive readiness check-ins before fire season and during Red Flag Warnings: confirm the app is installed, contacts are current, and systems are healthy.
* Help build and refine the response playbooks, call scripts, escalation protocols, and knowledge base this team will run on.
* Spot recurring issues and customer pain points and share them with Product, Engineering, and Field Services so we fix root causes, not just symptoms.
* Performs additional related tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Must-Have:

* 2+ years in a high-pressure, customer-facing role such as emergency dispatch, alarm or central station monitoring, a network operations center, crisis support, or technical support for connected devices.
* A calm, steady presence under pressure, with proven ability to de-escalate distressed callers and communicate clearly and with empathy.
* Comfort troubleshooting connected technology over the phone (apps, Wi-Fi, cellular devices, controllers) and explaining it in plain language.
* Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize quickly when several urgent situations happen at once.
* Strong documentation habits and experience with ticketing or CRM systems.
* Availability to work rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays, and to take on extra shifts or on-call time during active fire events.
* A quiet, private home workspace with reliable high-speed internet and a backup connectivity plan.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Drive) and Slack.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

Nice to Have:

* Emergency communications or monitoring training as APCO or NENA telecommunicator training or The Monitoring Association (TMA) operator training.
* Incident Command System familiarity (e.g., FEMA IS-100 and IS-700) or wildland fire coursework.
* Working knowledge of wildfire behavior, Red Flag Warnings, and evacuation zone tools such as Genasys Protect or Watch Duty.
* Experience with irrigation, plumbing, sprinkler, smart home, or security system installation or support.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Experience in a high-growth startup or a role that helped build a new team or process from scratch.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Salary Range: $29.00 - $36.00 per hour, based on experience (non-exempt; overtime eligible).
* Company-provided cell phone and laptop
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
* Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
* Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
* Company-provided equipment
* Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
* And much more!

**Join Our Mission!**

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

*Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

46745d93e5f736cb353c.title: Senior Staffing Specialist
46745d93e5f736cb353c.description:
Coretek is seeking a highly organized and relationship-driven **Senior Staffing Specialist** to support the company's contingent workforce and recruiting operations. This role will be responsible for managing the full lifecycle of staff augmentation recruiting efforts, coordinating contractor onboarding activities, and ensuring a seamless experience for hiring managers, candidates, and external staffing partners.

In addition, the Senior Staffing Specialist will coordinate candidate travel and interview logistics for onsite interviews and provide recruitment support across the organization as business needs require. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at managing multiple priorities, and delivers exceptional customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Staff Augmentation & Contractor Management**

* Manage the recruitment and placement process for contract, contract-to-hire, and consulting positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing needs and identify qualified contract talent.
* Build and maintain relationships with staffing agencies, clients, hiring managers, and independent contractors.
* Facilitate offer, engagement, and assignment processes for contractors.
* Monitor contractor start dates, assignment extensions, and contract end dates.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable onboarding requirements.
* Maintain accurate contractor records and workforce reporting.

**Contractor Onboarding**

* Coordinate all onboarding activities for contract workers, ensuring a positive and efficient start experience.
* Partner with IT, hiring managers, security, and facilities teams to ensure equipment, system access, and workspace needs are fulfilled prior to start dates.
* Track completion of required onboarding documentation and compliance requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for contractor onboarding inquiries.
* Monitor onboarding metrics and identify opportunities for process improvement.

**Candidate Travel & Interview Coordination**

* Coordinate travel arrangements for candidates participating in onsite interviews, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.
* Prepare and distribute detailed interview schedules and candidate information packets.
* Act as liaison between candidates, hiring managers, and recruiter
* Ensure a professional and exceptional candidate experience throughout the interview process.
* Manage interview logistics including conference room scheduling, meals, and visitor coordination.

**Recruitment Support**

* Assist with full-cycle recruiting activities for permanent positions as needed.
* Source candidates through job boards, networking, referrals, and social media platforms.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate outreach.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate communication between candidates and hiring teams.
* Support employment branding initiatives, recruiting events, and talent pipeline development.
* Maintain accurate applicant tracking system (ATS) records and recruiting metrics.

**Success in this Role**

The successful Senior Staffing Specialist will serve as a trusted partner to hiring managers and staffing vendors, ensuring contractor positions are filled efficiently, onboarding processes run smoothly, and candidates experience a professional and welcoming hiring process while supporting broader recruiting initiatives across the organization.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in recruiting, staffing, talent acquisition, workforce management, or related HR functions.
* Experience supporting contingent workforce, contractor management, or staff augmentation programs.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and applicant tracking systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience working within an IT, technology services, consulting, or managed services organization.
* Experience coordinating candidate travel and interview logistics.
* Familiarity with onboarding platforms, HRIS systems, and contractor compliance processes.
* Experience working with recruitment agencies and vendor management programs.
* Bachelor’s degree

  
**Benefits**

Coretek offers a comprehensive suite of Health Benefits, flexible PTO, 401K and an amazing and energizing workplace culture that is rich with opportunities for professional growth and development.

c28fb010071681d9a5cd.title: E-Commerce Coordinator (Remote)
c28fb010071681d9a5cd.description:
About SuperOrdinary:

At SuperOrdinary, we're the driving force behind the global success of today's most exciting consumer brands. More than an agency, we'rethe go-to growth partner for brands looking to win in social commerce, connecting industry leaders like Disney, H&M, Laneige, Touchland, Glow Recipe, and Peter Thomas Roth with creators and consumers around the world. Our team of e-commerce, creator, and social commerce experts helps brands build influence, accelerate sales, and create meaningful consumer connections across the world's fastest-growing marketplaces.

We're at the forefront of the social commerce revolution, pioneering growth on TikTok Shop and other emerging platforms where content, community, and commerce come together. The playbook is constantly evolving, and so are we. We thrive in an environment where experimentation, speed, and continuous learning are essential to staying ahead.

We're looking for people who are naturally curious, solutions-oriented, and energized by solving complex challenges. The best teammates here have a hustle mentality, embrace change, and are always looking for better ways to build, test, and scale. We set a high bar for ourselves and for our partners, earning our reputation as the trusted experts brands rely on to navigate an ever-changing landscape and deliver exceptional results.

Ecommerce Coordinator

Role Overview

The Ecommerce Coordinator supports the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team in the day-to-day management and execution of ecommerce operations across platforms such as TikTok Shop and Amazon.

This role is focused on ensuring ecommerce accounts remain operational, organized, and customer-ready. The Ecommerce Coordinator will assist with order monitoring, customer experience, account health, integrations, reviews, fulfillment issues, and reporting while escalating more complex issues to the Ecommerce Manager.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple tasks across ecommerce platforms. TikTok Shop and FBT experience is strongly preferred, while Amazon Seller Central and FBA experience are a plus. This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats and supporting the team wherever needed.

Key Responsibilities

Ecommerce Operations

* Support day-to-day ecommerce operations across TikTok Shop and Shopify.
* Monitor storefronts, product listings, inventory, pricing, promotions, and account settings for accuracy.
* Assist with ecommerce account audits and identify issues that require attention.
* Maintain accurate trackers, documentation, and operational records.
* Escalate issues and risks to the Ecommerce Manager and Brand team.

Customer Experience

* Monitor and assist with customer messages across ecommerce platforms.
* Support customer service teams and VAs with customer escalations.
* Monitor customer experience issues and identify recurring concerns.
* Assist with resolving order-related customer issues in coordination with the appropriate teams.

Orders, Returns & Refunds

* Monitor orders for delays, cancellations, fulfillment issues, and other exceptions.
* Flag overdue or problematic orders and escalate them to the appropriate teams.
* Track unresolved customer and order issues through completion.
* Identify recurring order or fulfillment issues and communicate trends to the Ecommerce Manager.

Reviews & Customer Feedback

* Flag negative or concerning reviews for appropriate follow-up.
* Track recurring product, fulfillment, or customer experience feedback.
* Escalate potential product or account issues to the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

Account Health & Shop Performance

* Monitor TikTok Shop account health, shop violations, warnings, and other platform notifications.
* Monitor Seller Performance Score (SPS) and flag changes or areas of concern.
* Assist with gathering information and documentation needed for violation appeals or rectifications.
* Monitor marketplace requirements and escalate potential compliance issues.
* Support regular account audits and performance checks.

Integrations & Fulfillment

* Monitor ecommerce integrations for order, inventory, and product synchronization issues.
* Assist with troubleshooting Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, FBA, FBT, and other ecommerce integrations.
* Monitor fulfillment-related issues, including inventory discrepancies, shipment delays, tracking issues, and inbound problems.
* Escalate technical or fulfillment issues to the Ecommerce Manager or appropriate internal/external team.

Reporting & Documentation

* Maintain ecommerce trackers, reports, and team documentation.
* Assist with weekly and monthly reporting as needed.
* Gather data related to orders, customer service, reviews, violations, SPS, fulfillment, and account performance.
* Keep account information and action items organized and up to date.
* Help document recurring issues and solutions.

SOPs & Process Support

* Follow established SOPs and workflows for ecommerce operations.
* Assist with creating and updating SOPs, tutorials, checklists, and training materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and communicate recommendations to the Ecommerce Manager.
* Help ensure VAs and support teams are following established processes correctly.

Team & Cross-Functional Support

* Work under the direction of the Ecommerce Manager and in partnership with the Brand Success team.
* Support Brand Success Managers with ecommerce-related tasks and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with Customer Service, Operations, Logistics, Fulfillment, and other internal teams as needed.
* Complete assigned tasks and follow up on outstanding action items.
* Be willing to support different areas of the ecommerce operation based on business needs.

Qualifications

* 1-3+ years of experience in ecommerce, marketplace operations, customer service, digital commerce, or a related field.
* TikTok Shop/Seller Center experience strongly preferred.
* Amazon Seller Central and FBA experience is a plus.
* Experience with FBT or other third-party fulfillment programs is a plus.
* Experience with ecommerce customer service, order management, returns, refunds, or reviews preferred.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and ecommerce platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to identify issues and escalate them appropriately.
* Comfortable learning new platforms, tools, and processes.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and wearing multiple hats.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can be the day-to-day operational support for the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

The Ecommerce Coordinator does not need to be the primary decision-maker for the ecommerce accounts. Instead, they should be able to monitor, execute, identify, document, and escalate effectively.

A successful Ecommerce Coordinator will be someone who notices that an order is overdue, an integration is not syncing, SPS has dropped, a shop violation has appeared, a customer issue is unresolved, or negative reviews are increasing—and knows how to either resolve the issue using an existing process or escalate it to the right person.

The role is ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in TikTok Shop, Amazon, ecommerce operations, customer experience, fulfillment, and marketplace management while working closely with an Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

What We Offer:

* Career Growth: Join a rapidly growing business with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
* Competitive Compensation: Earn a competitive base salary (depending on experience and skill set), plus eligibility for a performance-based annual bonus
* Time Off & Flexibility: Take advantage of Flexible PTO, paid holidays, and paid sick leave to support a healthy work-life balance
* Retirement Benefits: Plan for the future with a 401(k) retirement savings program

* Comprehensive Healthcare: Access competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.
* Team Perks: Stay fueled with weekly catered team lunches plus a meal stipend provided twice per week.

89ca498b9b703460a331.description:
**How to Apply**
----------------

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should describe your specific interest in the position and highlight the skills and experience that directly relate to the position.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Clinical Trials Support Office (CTSO) is part of Michigan Medicine's strategic research initiative working towards improving clinical care, value, and health outcomes by successfully executing a diverse portfolio of high-quality clinical research. The CTSO provides the organizational structure of local service units, central infrastructure, and governance oversight. Within the CTSO, Clinical Trials Support Units (CTSUs) aligned by research foci, are trans-departmental and provide comprehensive pre- and post-award support to study teams, offering high-quality, efficient service in support of a wide variety of clinical research.

  

The CTSO helps life-changing research happen. The science we support is not only interesting, but it also has the very real potential to positively impact patients and their families. We are looking for a candidate who embraces their supporting role in pushing these scientific advancements forward. The CTSO is a relatively new organizational model. You'll have the flexibility to impact the entire team as our unit expands its mission to support clinical research. Creative problem-solving skills are strongly encouraged.

  

Like many administrative units across Michigan Medicine, the CTSO is currently operating under a virtual work model for administrative staff. This position would currently be a work-from-home position and is likely to require little in-person activity in the future.

  

The Portfolio Coordinator is responsible for providing operational and administrative support for clinical trials and clinical research serviced by the Michigan Clinical Trials Support Unit (MCTSU). Under the guidance of MCTSU leadership and the Portfolio Manager team, this position serves as the initial point of contact for new studies and supports other study start-up and ongoing activities.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

Provide administrative support for day-to-day operations and protocol-specific activities of a portfolio of clinical research studies. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  

* Serve as an initial point of contact for new studies, triaging and directing them to the appropriate team members or resources.
* Process intake forms and enter study information into the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS).
* Process unfunded agreements (UFAs) in the eResearch Proposal Management system (eRPM).
* Communicate with sponsors and study teams to obtain trial information and required documentation for study start-up.
* Facilitate connections with strategic partners and resources as applicable.
* Process and maintain user access to CTMS and electronic regulatory binder systems, including access requests for external study monitors.
* Review ongoing studies for quality and compliance, including IRB review status, enrollment and subject visit tracking in OnCore, and work with study teams to complete necessary updates.
* Coordinate meeting scheduling.
* Provide operational and administrative support to the Portfolio Manager team.
* Respond to routine questions from Principal Investigators, study coordinators, and other research staff regarding study-specific requirements; escalate complex matters as appropriate.
* Serve as a resource for CTMS and MiChart workflows related to clinical research.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

* Bachelor?s degree, or equivalent education and experience.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong communication skills, a professional attitude, and a customer service orientation.

**Desired Qualifications\***
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Michigan Medicine research practices, systems, and processes.
* At least one year of directly related experience in clinical research or clinical trials.
* Working knowledge of study team roles and processes involved in opening and maintaining clinical research studies.

**Modes of Work**
-----------------

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

**Work Schedule**
-----------------

Monday to Friday. Like many administrative units across Michigan Medicine, the CTSO is currently operating under a mobile work model for administrative staff. This position would currently be a work-from-home position and is likely to require little in-person activity in the future.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Michigan Medicine is firmly committed to advancing inclusion, diversity, equity, accessibility, and belonging, which are core to the culture and values of the Medical School Office of Research. Our community supports recruiting and cultivating a diverse workforce as a reflection of our commitment to serve the diverse people of Michigan and the world. We strive to create a work culture where each team member feels respected, valued, and safe.

**Background Screening**
------------------------

The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third-party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

**Application Deadline**
------------------------

Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended.

**U-M EEO Statement**
---------------------

The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

f706feb22b01f1888778.description:
**About OnPay**

**OnPay is a fast-growing software company headquartered in Atlanta, offering a modern cloud-based payroll, HR, and benefits solution for small to midsize businesses. We’re currently seeking talented and curious individuals to join our team. We want to hear from you if you are interested in joining an exciting and fast-growing company!**

**Learn more at** **OnPay.com**

**We’re on a mission to combine excellent client service with payroll expertise and superb technology — and we are scaling fast as we’ve just raised $100 million in growth funding led by Carrick Capital Partners.**

**The Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical **Implementation Analyst** to join our Implementation Team. In this role, you will play a critical part in onboarding new clients to our payroll platform by accurately migrating, auditing, and configuring historical payroll data and prior wage information. Your primary focus will be ensuring seamless wage transfers so our clients can process their first payroll accurately and remain fully compliant with tax and reporting regulations.

**What You’ll Do**

* Extract, clean, transform, and load prior quarter and year-to-date (YTD) payroll data from client legacy systems into our proprietary payroll platform.
* Audit and reconcile prior wage entries against tax filings (Forms 941, 940, state unemployment tax reports, and W-2 summaries) to ensure total balance accuracy.
* Configure employee tax setups, local jurisdictions, and deduction/earning accumulators based on historical data.
* Conduct testing and historical variance analysis to identify and resolve discrepancies prior to go-live.
* Partner with Onboarding Coordinators to troubleshoot complex tax setups or multi-state wage adjustments.
* Identify patterns in data errors and document best practices to improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data migration.
* Maintain detailed documentation and audit trails.
* Stay current on changing federal, state, and local payroll tax legislation affecting amendments and filing guidelines.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

* 1–3 years of dedicated experience in payroll tax processing, payroll auditing, or payroll tax resolution, with demonstrated expertise in payroll implementation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent experience, preferred..
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), preferred.
* Strong understanding of US payroll fundamentals, including YTD accumulation, tax withholdings (Federal, State, Local), FUTA/SUTA, and year-end reporting (W-2s).
* Meticulous accuracy when handling numerical data and financial records; strong spot-checking and auditing capabilities.
* Ability to identify root causes of data mismatches and reconcile balance discrepancies independently.
* Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving capabilities, and clear written/verbal communication skills.
* Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, startup-like environment.
* Team-oriented, resilient, proactive and solutions-focused.
* Customer-service mindset: clear communication, patience, and professionalism when working with stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritize effectively.
* Must be highly organized, dependable and self-disciplined with a strong work ethic.
* Solid analytical skills, ability to learn at a fast pace.

**Why OnPay?**

* Momentum that matters: We’re backed by over $100MM in new funding and scaling rapidly.
* Market-leading product: OnPay consistently ranks among the highest-rated payroll solutions, earning top marks for usability, customer satisfaction, and support.
* Remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S., or join our collaborative HQ team in Atlanta’s Ponce City Market if you reside in the Atlanta metro area.
* Competitive compensation: Base salary + bonus + stock options = real upside for high performers.
* Comprehensive benefits: 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision, Short- & Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Fertility Benefits, Parental Leave, and a 401(k) with company match.
* Growth culture: Join a team with deep employee benefits experience, payroll expertise, market momentum, and a genuine commitment to helping employees grow their careers.
* Client-first ethos: OnPay is built on a culture of transparency and service — from our transparent pricing to our commitment to making small business simpler.

**Location & Compensation**

* Remote (U.S.) | Atlanta HQ Optional
* Compensation includes a pay range of **$25-$30 per hour.** Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

**Recruiting Fraud Alert:**

**To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At OnPay, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at** **careers.onpay.com**

**Recruiters will never request payments or ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from OnPay, please email** **careers@onpay.com**

OnPay is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We want candidates from multiple backgrounds and lifestyles to create a broader set of perspectives. We make all employment decisions without regard to gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, color, religion, age, pregnancy, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable laws.

**Economic Mobility Career Development Coordinator (Bilingual English/Spanish Required) Empower Individuals to Build Meaningful Careers and Achieve Economic Success!**

**Xiente is seeking a passionate, bilingual, and results-driven Economic Mobility Career Development Coordinator to help individuals and families achieve economic self-sufficiency through career coaching, employment support, workforce development, and educational advancement opportunities.**

In this role, you will serve as a career coach, workforce advocate, and trusted resource, guiding participants through career exploration, job placement, skill development, and long-term career growth. You will collaborate with employers, training providers, community partners, and internal teams to create pathways to sustainable employment and economic mobility.

Why Join Xiente?

* Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals and families.
* Help participants secure employment, advance their careers, and achieve financial stability.
* Build partnerships with employers, workforce development organizations, and educational institutions.
* Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment focused on strengthening communities.
* Engage in rewarding work that promotes long-term economic mobility and self-sufficiency.
* Grow professionally while helping others achieve their career goals.

Position Summary

The Economic Mobility Career Development Coordinator supports individuals and families in achieving long-term economic self-sufficiency through employment services, career coaching, workforce development programs, and educational opportunities. This position provides individualized guidance, job readiness training, employment placement assistance, and ongoing support to participants as they work toward achieving personal and professional goals.

The ideal candidate is a skilled relationship-builder, effective communicator, and passionate advocate who is committed to helping participants develop career pathways that lead to sustainable employment and long-term success.

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesCareer Coaching & Employment Services

* Provide individualized career coaching, employment counseling, and workforce development support.
* Assist participants with career exploration, goal setting, and development of individualized employment and career advancement plans.
* Conduct assessments to identify participant strengths, interests, skills, and employment barriers.
* Utilize coaching and motivational interviewing techniques to support participant success and engagement.
* Monitor participant progress and provide ongoing guidance to support job retention and career growth.

Job Readiness & Workforce Development

* Facilitate job readiness workshops covering resume writing, interview preparation, workplace professionalism, communication skills, and effective job search strategies.
* Support participants in identifying educational opportunities, vocational training programs, certifications, apprenticeships, and career advancement pathways.
* Assist participants with job applications, resume submissions, interview scheduling, and employment preparation activities.
* Prepare participants for successful entry and advancement within the workforce.

Employer & Community Partnerships

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with local employers to identify employment opportunities and workforce needs.
* Engage employers to create career opportunities for participants and support successful job placements.
* Collaborate with educational institutions, workforce boards, training providers, community agencies, and other partners to expand participant opportunities.
* Participate in employer engagement activities, networking events, and partnership-building initiatives.

Participant Support & Resource Coordination

* Coordinate referrals to supportive services that address barriers to employment, including transportation, childcare, housing assistance, healthcare resources, financial literacy programs, and public benefits.
* Assist participants in accessing community resources that contribute to long-term employment success and economic stability.
* Advocate for participants and provide guidance as they navigate workforce and educational systems.

Documentation & Program Compliance

* Maintain accurate participant records, employment plans, case notes, assessments, and program documentation.
* Track and document participant outcomes including employment placements, job retention, educational attainment, and career advancement milestones.
* Assist with data collection, reporting requirements, and outcome measurement activities.
* Ensure compliance with agency policies, program guidelines, funding requirements, and confidentiality standards.
* Enter participant information accurately into case management and data tracking systems.

Community Outreach & Engagement

* Participate in outreach activities, job fairs, hiring events, recruitment efforts, workshops, and community engagement initiatives.
* Promote program services within the community and support participant recruitment efforts.
* Represent Xiente professionally with external partners, employers, and community stakeholders.

QualificationsRequired Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Education, Business Administration, Workforce Development, Counseling, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in workforce development, career services, employment counseling, job placement, case management, talent development, or related human service fields.
* **Fluency in both English and Spanish is required. Candidates must be able to effectively communicate, coach, and provide services in both languages.**
* Knowledge of career development practices, workforce systems, employment resources, and job search strategies.
* Experience working with individuals from diverse socioeconomic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and electronic data management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in workforce development, employment services, career coaching, adult education, economic mobility programs, or community-based organizations.
* Experience facilitating workshops, training programs, or group presentations.
* Knowledge of local labor market trends, employer engagement strategies, and workforce development initiatives.
* Experience building partnerships with employers, educational institutions, and community organizations.

Ideal Backgrounds

We encourage candidates with experience in the following areas to apply:

* Workforce Development
* Career Coaching
* Employment Services
* Talent Development
* Job Placement Services
* Adult Education
* Human Services
* Social Work
* Community Outreach
* Economic Mobility Programs
* Financial Empowerment Programs

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Strong coaching, mentoring, and motivational interviewing skills.
* Ability to empower individuals from diverse backgrounds to achieve employment and career goals.
* Excellent relationship-building and customer service skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish.
* Strong public speaking and workshop facilitation abilities.
* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to build productive relationships with employers, participants, and community partners.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team environment.
* Commitment to promoting economic mobility, self-sufficiency, and participant success.
* Ability to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and cultural responsiveness.

Working Conditions

This position requires a combination of office-based work, participant engagement, community outreach, employer visits, and workforce development activities. Local travel may be required to attend community events, employer meetings, job fairs, training programs, and participant-related activities.

Occasional evening or weekend hours may be necessary to support workforce development initiatives, hiring events, community outreach, and program activities.

**Work Location:** In Person

Join Our Mission

At **Xiente**, we believe economic mobility begins with access to opportunity. Through meaningful employment, education, workforce development, and supportive services, we help individuals and families build stronger futures and achieve long-term success.

If you are passionate about helping others discover their potential, achieve career goals, and create lasting economic stability, we encourage you to apply.

2f6f2ac2dd7ffe462d23.title: Lead Talent Business Partner - Ground Operations
2f6f2ac2dd7ffe462d23.description:
### **About Veho**

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities.

**About the Role**
------------------

At Veho, we're changing the delivery experience through technology and a network of people who get packages where they need to go. Our Ground Operations teams are essential to that work, managing package sortation, warehouse operations, and the daily execution that keeps our delivery network moving.

We're looking for a Lead, Talent Business Partner to support our Ground Operations organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the challenges of hourly workforces, builds strong relationships with frontline leaders, and knows how to handle difficult employee situations with fairness, urgency, and sound judgment.

You'll partner with operational leaders, warehouse managers, and supervisors to manage employee relations issues, raise performance standards, improve workforce stability, and create a better experience for our teams.

You'll spend time in our warehouses, work with employees across different shifts, and develop a firsthand understanding of what our teams experience every day.

We want someone who can solve problems independently, use data to identify opportunities, and find practical ways to make People support more efficient through technology and AI.

**Your goal is to help Ground Operations leaders build strong teams, address problems early, and create safe, accountable workplaces where people can do their best work.**

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Manage Employee Relations and Workplace Risk**

* Independently manage employee complaints, investigations, misconduct allegations, disciplinary matters, and other employee relations cases across assigned locations.
* Conduct fair, timely, and well-documented investigations, making sound recommendations and escalating sensitive or high-risk matters appropriately.
* Partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and People Operations on accommodations, leave concerns, retaliation allegations, employment separations, and other complex matters.
* Coach leaders on applying policies consistently, documenting employee concerns, and navigating employment requirements affecting hourly and non-exempt employees.
* Identify recurring employee relations issues and work with site leadership to address the causes, not just individual incidents.

### **Raise Performance Standards and Develop Frontline Leaders**

* Help managers set clear expectations for performance and behavior using Veho's A Player standards: extreme ownership, urgency, first-principles thinking, direct challenge, learning, and putting the team first.
* Challenge leaders when underperformance goes unaddressed, expectations are inconsistent, or decisions are not supported by facts.
* Coach managers on feedback, performance improvement, difficult conversations, and appropriate corrective action.
* Identify strong performers and emerging leaders, supporting their development, recognition, and opportunities for advancement.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and site leaders to reinforce hiring standards and improve the readiness of new employees.

### **Strengthen Warehouse Culture and Employee Experience**

* Build trust with employees and leaders through regular warehouse visits, direct conversations, and consistent follow-through.
* Identify concerns involving communication, fairness, manager behavior, employee well-being, or team dynamics before they become larger problems.
* Help leaders build teams where employees feel safe raising concerns, challenging ideas respectfully, and taking accountability for their work.
* Use employee feedback, engagement results, and exit insights to recommend practical changes that improve the employee experience.
* Partner with Operations and Safety on workplace concerns that affect employee safety, trust, or working conditions.

### **Improve Workforce Stability and Operational Readiness**

* Work with site and operational leaders to understand staffing levels, shift coverage, current headcount needs, and workforce challenges.
* Review attrition, attendance, and performance trends to identify where people issues are affecting operational execution.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and operational leaders on hiring priorities, onboarding gaps, and early-tenure retention.
* Support succession and internal mobility planning for frontline and site leadership positions.
* Recommend changes that improve workforce stability while accounting for the practical needs of warehouse operations.

### **Use Data and Technology to Make Work Easier**

* Use people data and operational metrics to identify patterns, prioritize issues, and recommend improvements.
* Apply approved AI tools and automation to reduce repetitive work, simplify reporting, and make manager resources easier to access.
* Measure whether new processes improve response times, consistency, or the quality of People support.
* Partner with Talent Strategy & Operations to adopt enterprise tools and share improvements that could benefit other locations.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality, accuracy, and human oversight when handling sensitive employee information.

### **Support Operational Change**

* Partner with leaders during site openings, leadership changes, staffing adjustments, and organizational transitions.
* Help managers communicate changes clearly, respond to employee concerns, and maintain continuity during implementation.
* Represent Ground Operations in cross-functional People initiatives, ensuring new practices work for hourly employees and warehouse leaders.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Employee relations expertise:** Experience independently managing investigations, employee complaints, disciplinary matters, and complex workplace issues.
* **Hourly workforce experience:** Experience supporting frontline, non-exempt, shift-based, or distributed employee populations.
* **Sound judgment and high EQ:** You can build trust, handle sensitive situations, manage conflict, and make fair decisions under pressure.
* **Performance management:** You're comfortable challenging managers, coaching through difficult conversations, and ensuring performance issues are addressed.
* **Operational understanding:** You understand the realities of frontline work and can balance business priorities with employee needs.
* **Analytical skills:** You can interpret workforce trends and use data to identify practical solutions.
* **Ownership and execution:** You manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and work independently across multiple locations.
* **Employment practices knowledge:** You understand the employment laws and policies relevant to hourly workforces, including wage and hour, leave, accommodations, and employee protections.
* **Technology fluency:** You're comfortable with HRIS and digital tools and willing to use AI to improve efficiency.
* **Communication skills:** You can work effectively with hourly employees, supervisors, and senior operational leaders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in warehousing, logistics, transportation, distribution, manufacturing, or fulfillment.
* Experience supporting multiple sites, locations, or operating shifts.
* Familiarity with high-volume hiring, seasonal staffing, and frontline retention.
* Experience supporting site launches or organizational changes.
* Experience using employee relations case management tools or HR automation.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success means stronger frontline leaders, fair and consistent employee relations practices, and a more stable workforce. We expect this person to get involved quickly and make a difference in the day-to-day experience of our teams.

### **First 30 Days**

* Build relationships with operational and site leaders, visit supported warehouses, and understand how people challenges affect daily operations.
* Review active employee relations issues, workforce metrics, and recurring manager challenges to identify immediate priorities.
* Independently resolve or meaningfully advance a significant employee or leadership matter.

### **By Day 90**

* Establish consistent employee relations case management with clear documentation, timely follow-through, and appropriate escalation.
* Demonstrate improved manager handling of performance or employee concerns through direct coaching.
* Take action on a recurring issue affecting retention, culture, or operational stability.
* Introduce a practical process or technology improvement that reduces manual work or improves People support.

### **Within 6 Months**

* Managers are handling routine performance and employee situations more confidently and consistently.
* Recurring employee relations issues are being identified earlier and addressed at their source.
* Supported locations show measurable progress on a priority workforce issue such as early-tenure turnover, attendance, or staffing stability.
* Strong frontline employees are receiving appropriate recognition, development, and opportunities to advance.

### **Within 12 Months**

* **Better employee relations outcomes:** Cases are managed fairly and efficiently, with fewer recurring preventable issues and stronger documentation.
* **Higher performance standards:** Leaders consistently apply Veho's A Player expectations, recognize strong contributions, and address performance gaps promptly.
* **Stronger workforce stability:** Targeted improvements in retention, attendance, or staffing readiness are helping reduce avoidable operational disruption.
* **More capable managers:** Frontline leaders require less intervention on routine matters and know when to escalate sensitive issues.
* **Healthier warehouse cultures:** Employee feedback shows progress in trust, communication, fairness, and accountability.
* **More efficient support:** Process improvements and adopted AI tools have demonstrably reduced administrative effort or improved response times.

**Location & Travel**
---------------------

**Hiring Locations:** Dallas, TX or Nashville, TN

**Work Arrangement:** Warehouse-based, with regular on-site engagement.

**Travel:** Up to 30% to Veho warehouse locations and company offsites, based on business needs.

This role requires flexibility to work with employees and leaders across different operational shifts.

**Why Veho?**
-------------

Our Ground Operations teams are essential to delivering a great customer experience. The people supporting those teams have a direct impact on how well our warehouses operate and how employees experience working at Veho.

If you enjoy solving complex employee challenges, developing frontline leaders, and helping operational teams perform at their best, we'd love to meet you.

Veho is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action.

Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime!

All California applicants, please reference our California Applicant Privacy Notice located here.

The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company. Additionally, Veho offers a competitive equity package, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and other benefits such as a 401 (k) and unlimited PTO for exempt-level roles.

Compensation Range: $120K - $130K

347b6c13d1e33519933f.title: Learning and Development Coordinator
347b6c13d1e33519933f.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a hands-on, organized, and collaborative Learning & Development Coordinator to help scale Oura’s learning ecosystem. In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day operations of our LMS, develop useful learning and compliance reporting, uphold standards for learning content, and help maintain L&D’s AI-enabled learning tools. You’ll partner with employees, subject-matter experts, vendors, and cross-functional teams to keep learning experiences accurate, accessible, and well organized.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Manage the learning platform (30%) Administer Sana@ŌURA, including user access, enrollments, assignment rules, course publishing and archiving, permissions, troubleshooting, and routine audits. Coordinate with the platform vendor and help improve how employees find and use learning resources.
* Build/maintain reporting that supports decisions (10%) Maintain dashboards and tracking for learning programs and compliance training. Respond to data requests, identify patterns or gaps, and make information available proactively to L&D and relevant partners.
* Steward AI-enabled learning workflows (5%) Monitor L&D’s learning agents and other AI-supported experiences for accuracy and usefulness. Investigate issues, correct or escalate errors, keep source content current, and recommend improvements. Help assess when automation is appropriate and when a human review or response is needed.
* Support learning content quality and governance (15%) Apply established standards for metadata, accessibility, formatting, version control, and publication. Support subject-matter experts and content owners, coordinate content reviews, intake calls and maintain the content audit cycle.
* Coordinate programs and learning operations (20%) Support program calendars, learning resource repositories, onboarding and manager-development logistics, vendor and contractor coordination, and the operational details that help programs run smoothly.
* Grow into instructional design and development (10%) Initially, edit, format, and publish learning materials using existing templates and standards. Over time, take on defined content and module builds and contribute to the design and delivery of learning experiences.
* Collaborate across teams (10%) Build productive working relationships with L&D colleagues, HR partners, IT and AI teams, vendors, and internal content owners to resolve issues and improve the employee learning experience.
