3afe0f2787ce9cfaac83.description:
**About iMPROve Health**

**Come join the iMPROve Health team!**

iMPROve Health is Michigan’s Medicare-designated Quality Improvement Organization, and we’re proud to be recognized as both a *Cool Place to Work* by Crain’s Detroit Business (four years running) and one of *Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare*.

As a nonprofit with more than 40 years of experience, we’re dedicated to improving healthcare across the continuum of care using evidence-based, data-driven strategies. We provide medical consulting and review services, along with data analysis, to federal agencies, state Medicaid programs, public health organizations, healthcare facilities, private health plans, and other third-party payers. Our team also specializes in impartial utilization review, dispute resolution, and peer review. Our mission is simple: help healthcare get better.

This position is 100% remote, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States while collaborating with a supportive, nationwide team. We prioritize work/life balance and invest in our employees’ growth through professional development and continuing education opportunities.

At iMPROve Health, we are committed to improving the quality, safety, and efficiency of healthcare. While we do not provide direct patient care, our healthcare professionals—including physicians, nurses, and experienced consultants—partner with providers to promote the use of evidence-based best practices. We offer our clients a trusted, impartial resource that understands the complexities of the healthcare landscape and is dedicated to thoughtful, high-quality solutions.

Join us in making a meaningful impact on healthcare—one improvement at a time.

**Payment Determinations Coordinator | Fully Remote**

**About the Role**

iMPROve Health is seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and experienced Payment Determinations Coordinator to support our Federal and State Independent Dispute Resolution Entity (IDRE) programs under the No Surprises Act (NSA).

In this role, you will coordinate payment determination activities, manage dispute cases and program deadlines, maintain accurate case records, and support compliance with applicable Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) requirements and contractual obligations. You will work closely with arbitrators, program managers, and organizational leadership to facilitate timely, accurate, and consistent case processing.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the Federal No Surprises Act, excellent project and time management skills, and the ability to navigate multiple electronic systems while managing competing priorities in a fully remote environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payment Determinations and Case Management**

* Coordinate dispute cases throughout the case lifecycle, from intake through final resolution.
* Review case submissions for completeness, accuracy, eligibility, and compliance with applicable program requirements.
* Coordinate case assignments to arbitrators, reviewers, and other appropriate decision-makers.
* Complete payment determination processing following arbitrator review in accordance with established procedures and program requirements.
* Monitor case status, deadlines, and outstanding activities to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate case information, documentation, and communications in CMS portals and internal databases.
* Respond to arbitrator inquiries and provide procedural guidance regarding case requirements and workflows.

**Program Operations and Compliance**

* Complete assigned contract deliverables and operational activities within established timelines.
* Monitor work plans, schedules, and case-processing activities to identify potential delays, risks, or operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with applicable CMS requirements, HIPAA, FISMA, URAC standards, contractual obligations, and internal policies.
* Conduct quality reviews to promote accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify discrepancies, compliance concerns, and opportunities for process improvement, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Assist with the implementation and enhancement of operational systems, tools, and workflows.

**Training and Documentation**

* Develop, update, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), job aids, templates, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and other operational resources.
* Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training related to IDRE workflows, CMS portal navigation, documentation standards, and communication protocols.
* Collaborate with program managers and leadership to ensure training materials reflect current regulatory guidance, contractual requirements, and internal policies.
* Conduct refresher training and assist in identifying knowledge gaps and additional training needs.
* Communicate process changes and updates to affected team members.

**Communication and Collaboration**

* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders, including arbitrators, providers, payers, legal representatives, and other dispute resolution participants.
* Serve as a point of contact for procedural questions, submission requirements, and case status inquiries.
* Maintain neutral, professional, and clear communication throughout the dispute resolution process.
* Collaborate with operations, compliance, legal, finance, IT, and other teams to resolve issues and support program objectives.
* Participate in meetings concerning operational priorities, escalations, stakeholder feedback, and policy updates.

**Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare operational reports related to case volume, resolution outcomes, turnaround times, outreach activities, and performance metrics.
* Maintain spreadsheets, tracking tools, and dashboards to monitor service levels, response times, case aging, and operational trends.
* Analyze operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.
* Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least five years of project support experience in a corporate or professional environment, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
* Knowledge of the Federal No Surprises Act.
* Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, reliability, accountability, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Windows-based software, and web-based portals.
* Experience developing and maintaining moderately complex spreadsheets.
* Ability to navigate multiple electronic systems and cloud-based platforms while maintaining accurate records and data integrity.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a healthcare-related or relevant field.
* Familiarity with healthcare billing, reimbursement, and payer-provider processes.
* Experience reviewing medical claims, remittance advice, and Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
* Understanding of quality improvement concepts.
* Experience developing training materials, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Experience supporting portal development, system enhancements, or workflow improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with CMS portals, Salesforce, and other third-party platforms.

**Remote Work Requirements**

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be able to:

* Maintain a reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for business applications and virtual communications.
* Maintain a private, secure, professional, and distraction-free workspace.
* Protect confidential information, including protected health information (PHI), in accordance with HIPAA, FISMA, URAC, CMS, and organizational requirements.
* Work independently, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet established deadlines.
* Maintain regular availability and communication during scheduled work hours.
* Effectively collaborate through virtual meetings, approved communication tools, and electronic systems.

**Why Join iMPROve Health?**

Join a team dedicated to healthcare quality, regulatory compliance, and effective dispute resolution. In this role, you will contribute to important healthcare operations while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across a fully remote organization.

**Position Overview**

Bartlett Hall is seeking an organized, proactive, and relationship-focused **Hospitality Vendor Relations Specialist** to coordinate supplier communications, support purchasing activities, and help maintain reliable vendor services for restaurant operations.

This role works with food and beverage suppliers, equipment vendors, maintenance providers, and other service partners to support timely deliveries, accurate orders, consistent service standards, and efficient issue resolution. The ideal candidate communicates professionally, manages multiple priorities, and understands the importance of dependable vendor relationships in a busy restaurant environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Relations & Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned suppliers, vendors, and service providers.
* Maintain positive working relationships through clear communication and timely follow-ups.
* Communicate order requirements, delivery schedules, service requests, and operational expectations.
* Address routine vendor questions and coordinate solutions to service or delivery issues.
* Maintain accurate vendor contact information, service records, and communication logs.

**Purchasing & Delivery Coordination**

* Coordinate orders for food, beverages, restaurant supplies, equipment, and operational materials.
* Track order confirmations, delivery schedules, quantities, and outstanding items.
* Follow up on late deliveries, incorrect orders, shortages, damaged goods, and substitutions.
* Coordinate with kitchen, bar, restaurant management, and other teams to confirm purchasing needs.
* Help monitor inventory-related requests and identify recurring supply issues.

**Invoice & Vendor Documentation Support**

* Review invoices, purchase orders, delivery receipts, and other supporting documents for completeness.
* Compare billed quantities and prices against available order and delivery records.
* Flag discrepancies, duplicate charges, missing credits, and pricing differences for review.
* Track invoice status and coordinate follow-ups with vendors and the accounting team.
* Maintain organized records of vendor agreements, pricing information, certificates, and service documentation.

**Restaurant Operations Support**

* Coordinate vendor service appointments for equipment, facilities, cleaning, and maintenance.
* Communicate operational priorities and access requirements to vendors.
* Track outstanding service requests and confirm completion with the appropriate team.
* Escalate urgent supply interruptions, equipment issues, and service disruptions to management.
* Help ensure vendor activities are coordinated around restaurant operating hours and service needs.

**Performance Monitoring & Process Improvement**

* Monitor vendor reliability, delivery accuracy, responsiveness, and service quality.
* Maintain vendor performance trackers and summaries of recurring issues.
* Assist management with reviewing pricing changes, service concerns, and potential supplier alternatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve ordering procedures, documentation, and communication workflows.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in hospitality operations, vendor coordination, purchasing, customer service, or administrative support.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, and standard office software.
* Ability to coordinate multiple requests and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
* Professional judgment when handling confidential business and financial information.

**Preferred**

* Experience in restaurant, bar, hotel, catering, or food service operations.
* Familiarity with food and beverage suppliers, restaurant purchasing, or inventory processes.
* Experience reviewing invoices, tracking purchase orders, or resolving vendor discrepancies.
* Familiarity with restaurant POS, inventory, procurement, or accounting systems.

**Core Competencies**

* Restaurant operations coordination
* Purchasing and delivery tracking

* Documentation accuracy
* Time management and prioritization
* Team collaboration and accountability

ae4e9c93f8e26df1a0d0.description:
Assistant General ManagerPosition Summary

The Assistant General Manager (AGM) is a hands-on operational leader who partners with the General Manager to oversee the daily performance of a MyEyeDr. office. This position combines **patient experience, team leadership, optical sales, healthcare operations, administrative execution, and financial accountability**.

The AGM helps ensure the office runs efficiently from open to close while supporting doctors, associates, and patients throughout the entire visit. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading people, solving problems in real time, coaching performance, working directly with patients, and taking ownership of operational results.

This is not a back-office management position. The AGM is expected to be visible on the floor, understand each area of the operation, and step into the workflow wherever leadership is needed.

Key ResponsibilitiesLeadership & Team Development

* Partner with the General Manager to lead the day-to-day operation of the office.
* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and real-time support to Patient Service Coordinators, Optometric Technicians, Eyewear Consultants, and other associates.
* Help onboard and train new associates while reinforcing established operating procedures and service expectations.
* Identify performance and training gaps and provide appropriate coaching.
* Promote accountability, teamwork, professionalism, and a patient-first culture.
* Assist with staff scheduling, daily assignments, coverage planning, breaks, and workflow management.
* Help maintain an engaged, productive team capable of operating effectively during high-volume periods.

Patient Experience & Office Flow

* Ensure patients are welcomed promptly and receive a professional, efficient experience throughout their visit.
* Monitor patient flow between check-in, pretesting, the doctor, optical, and checkout.
* Identify delays or bottlenecks and redistribute team resources as needed.
* Assist with patient concerns and service recovery while working to retain patient trust and business.
* Support appointment management, confirmations, cancellations, no-shows, walk-ins, and schedule recovery.
* Partner with doctors and team members to maintain efficient clinical and optical workflows.

Sales & Business Performance

* Support achievement of office revenue, productivity, and patient-retention goals.
* Coach associates on uncovering patient needs and making appropriate eyewear and contact-lens recommendations.
* Help drive conversion, multiple-pair opportunities, annual contact-lens supply purchases, lens enhancements, protection plans, and other applicable products and services.
* Review office performance and identify opportunities to improve execution.
* Help ensure associates understand promotions, insurance benefits, pricing, and available patient options.
* Balance strong business performance with an excellent patient experience.

Eyewear, Contact Lens & Lab Operations

* Help oversee eyeglass and contact-lens orders from point of sale through delivery.
* Monitor work-in-process and outstanding orders and ensure issues are addressed promptly.
* Support use of Encompass, MyLink, insurance portals, and other approved systems required to process patient orders.
* Ensure orders requiring office intervention are identified and resolved.
* Help maintain an organized lab and ensure order documentation, trays, promise dates, and statuses are accurate.
* Ensure received eyewear is appropriately inspected and processed before patient notification.
* Follow up on delayed orders and ensure patients receive timely updates.
* Identify recurring order errors and coach associates to prevent future issues.

Insurance & Administrative Operations

* Support accurate insurance preparation, eligibility verification, benefit application, and documentation.
* Help associates resolve insurance-related issues and appropriately escalate exceptions.
* Reinforce accurate patient demographic, insurance, order, and payment information.
* Help prevent missed claims, unbilled services, incomplete orders, and avoidable patient balances.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, company policy, payer requirements, and established compliance procedures.

Financial & Operational Controls

* Assist with opening and closing procedures and ensure the office is prepared for the next business day.
* Help maintain accurate cash, payment, deposit, and transaction controls.
* Investigate operational discrepancies and escalate variances according to company procedure.
* Perform authorized manager functions within company systems when appropriate.
* Support inventory receiving, transfers, returns, merchandising, supply management, and inventory accuracy.
* Help maintain an organized, clean, safe, and professional environment.
* Ensure required daily and periodic operational tasks are completed and documented.

Management Coverage

In the General Manager's absence, the Assistant General Manager may be responsible for directing daily office operations, assigning priorities, supporting associates and doctors, addressing patient concerns, and ensuring essential operational processes are completed according to company policy.

Qualifications

* Previous experience in retail, healthcare, optical, hospitality, or another high-volume customer-facing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and motivate a team.
* Strong customer-service and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment with operational and sales goals.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning and working across multiple computer systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment when handling patient concerns, employee issues, financial transactions, and operational exceptions.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule based on office and patient needs.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous supervisory or management experience.
* Optical, optometry, healthcare, or medical-office experience.
* Experience with insurance eligibility, healthcare administration, point-of-sale systems, inventory, or scheduling.
* Optical sales or eyewear experience.
* Experience coaching teams against measurable performance goals.

Prior optical experience is valuable but should not prevent a strong leader from being considered. Candidates with experience successfully leading teams in healthcare, retail, hospitality, banking, wireless, or other complex customer-facing environments may have highly transferable skills.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Assistant General Manager helps create an office where:

* Patients receive excellent and timely care.
* Doctors are supported by an organized and prepared team.
* Associates understand their responsibilities and receive consistent coaching.
* Appointments and available doctor capacity are effectively utilized.
* Patient orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.
* Outstanding orders and operational issues do not accumulate.
* Financial and inventory controls are consistently followed.
* Patient concerns are resolved quickly and professionally.
* The office meets or exceeds its performance goals.
* The General Manager has a dependable second leader capable of independently running the operation when needed.

The strongest AGM is not simply someone who can complete management tasks. It is someone who can **see what the office needs, organize the team around it, solve problems before they become larger problems, and consistently improve both the patient experience and business performance.**

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Experience:

* Optical: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Job Description Summary**

‎

Hours & Location:  
Full Time: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm EST  
Fully Remote - equipment provided  
  
Bilingual required: English and Spanish  
  
The Diagnostic Scheduler utilizes email, telephone and message requests to schedule patient testing for physician ordered diagnostic tests. S/he receives a message from any location for request for test scheduling and contacts patient to schedule within 24 hrs. Tests will be scheduled within a 48hr period of being ordered pending schedule and equipment availability. S/he notifies the office when patient/test is scheduled and provides patient instructions on the test they will receive over the phone. S/he schedules multiple tests at appropriate times without overlap and checks phone and email messages frequently throughout day. S/he understands STAT priority and schedules these patients first. S/he may assist in other areas as needed. S/he checks in patient notes for insurance changes and updates any personal contact information changes. S/he keeps a log of patients needing tests scheduled and records when complete; typically works alone, with little supervision. All other duties as assigned.

* Contacts patients within 24 hrs. to schedule

* Schedule STATS first
* Updates patient notes with insurance/contact information as needed
* Quick notification to offices when test is scheduled

* Associate's degree or equivalent from two-year college or accredited radiologic school; six months to one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

The Specialty Operations Senior Consultant plays a critical role in shaping successful outcomes for highly complex reinsurance claims. In this position, you will lead the resolution and settlement of high exposure assumed reinsurance matters—including asbestos, pharmaceutical, toxic tort, environmental, sexual abuse and molestation, and other mass tort claims.  
You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable Specialty Operations team where independent judgment, analytical skill, and strategic decision making are valued. This is an opportunity to influence meaningful outcomes, work with challenging and evolving legal issues, and contribute to our continued success within a highly specialized claims environment

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Independently manage** a portfolio of complex reinsurance claims involving asbestos, environmental, and other latent injury exposures—analyzing liability, damages, and contractual obligations to drive informed and strategic claim outcomes.
* **Interpret and apply** facultative and treaty reinsurance contracts, as well as CGL, umbrella, and excess policies, to determine coverage, using underlying facts and relevant case law.
* **Establish accurate case reserves**, leveraging cedent reporting, internal assessment, and designated authority levels; seek management approval for exposures exceeding authority.
* **Develop and execute action plans** for the evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of reported claims.
* **Maintain thorough and timely documentation**, ensuring claim files reflect clear reasoning, compliance with internal guidelines, and proactive communication with management.
* **Stay current on emerging legal trends**, industry developments, and significant case law, applying this knowledge to enhance claims strategy and decision‑making.
* **Serve as a corporate witness or representative** in litigation, arbitration, and other dispute‑resolution settings when required.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

This position does **not** include supervisory responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Experience:**

* **5+ years** of relevant experience preferred; **3+ years** will be considered for strong candidates with demonstrated capability.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of reinsurance contracts, insurance coverage principles, claim processes, and relevant case law. This role focuses on Property & Casualty reinsurance.
* Proven experience evaluating and resolving complex bodily injury and property damage reinsurance claims involving mass‑tort exposures.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in both virtual and in‑person settings with internal teams, management, external cedents, and brokers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and Copilot; aptitude for learning new technology and claims systems.
* Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well‑reasoned documentation.

**Limited travel will be expected** (approx. twice per year) to build team connections.

598f4ffa5a016d643d75.description:
**ABOUT US**

Terrabis is a leading privately held cannabis company with a bold growth strategy, focused on driving innovation and market expansion. Our approach integrates wholesale, retail, and customer experience to set industry standards and create value for both consumers and stakeholders.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing Coordinator, Ecommerce keeps Terrabis online menus accurate, complete, and consistent across multiple locations. Working primarily in Dutchie POS and Dutchie Ecommerce, with cross-training on Jane, this role handles day-to-day menu maintenance and supports website QA. The coordinator is also the intake point for store requests and customer complaints about the web experience, and manages support tickets with ecommerce and web providers from start to resolution under the oversight of the Marketing Manager. This role is a strong fit for a detail-oriented cannabis professional who is comfortable with consistent, repeatable work and eager to learn more about ecommerce.

Reports to: Marketing Manager, Ecommerce & Promotions

Schedule: Full-Time, Remote

Travel: Minimal, as needed (expensed)

Pay range: $55,000 - $65,000

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain online menus in Dutchie POS and Dutchie Ecommerce across multiple locations, including product names, categories, brands, images, descriptions, and availability.
* Audit menus regularly against POS and inventory data to find and correct discrepancies, missing products, duplicates, and incorrect information before they reach customers.
* Handle product listing updates and requests, including accessories and new product setup.
* Follow and help maintain menu standards for naming, categorization, and images so listings stay consistent.
* Review and edit product and strain descriptions so menu copy follows state advertising and compliance rules, including restrictions on effects claims, health claims, and slang.
* Build and maintain checklists and process documentation for menu maintenance.
* Serve as the intake point for store requests and customer complaints related to the web experience, from site bugs to menu discrepancies.
* Triage and log each request, keep the requester updated on status, and confirm the issue is resolved.
* Escalate site bugs, complaints, and menu issues that go beyond routine maintenance to the Senior Marketing Coordinator or Marketing Manager.
* Route discount and promotion requests to the Promotions Coordinator.
* Identify patterns across requests and complaints and share them with the Marketing Manager.
* Open support tickets with ecommerce and web providers, including Dutchie, Jane, and web developers, and manage each ticket from start to resolution.
* Submit clear bug reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots, and expected results, then follow up and verify fixes once released.
* Maintain a ticket log with status, owner, and resolution for every open issue.
* Support scheduled QA of the website and ecommerce menus on desktop and mobile, led by the Senior Marketing Coordinator, documenting bugs, broken links, and layout or checkout issues.
* Verify fixes after updates and report results to the Senior Marketing Coordinator and Marketing Manager.
* Cross-train on Jane Ecommerce and provide backup for Jane menu maintenance and fixes.
* Support the setup and ongoing monitoring of site analytics, such as GA4 and Google Search Console, as directed.
* As trained, support website content updates, ecommerce analysis, and the Terpli tool.
* Provide coverage during vacations and escalations as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 1 to 3 years of cannabis industry experience, such as inventory management, menu or ecommerce support, or cannabis retail operations.
* Experience with data entry, platform support, or compliance.
* Dutchie POS experience strongly preferred.
* Experience maintaining a product catalog, menu, or inventory data is a plus.
* Comfortable learning new software quickly; Dutchie Ecommerce and Jane training provided.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets for menu audits and product lists, including sorting, filtering, and comparing lists.
* Strong written communication and proofreading skills for editing product copy.
* Ability to clearly document website and menu issues, including steps to reproduce and screenshots.
* Familiarity with Asana or similar project tools is a plus; WordPress, Terpli, A/B testing, or site analytics experience is a plus but not required.
* Highly detail-oriented, with a methodical approach to audits and verification.
* Comfortable with consistent, high-volume tasks and able to stay accurate over time.
* Eager to learn and take on new tools and responsibilities as the role grows.
* Customer service mindset, with the patience and follow-through to handle store and customer complaints.
* Organized and able to prioritize multiple requests and escalate issues appropriately.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be 21 years of age or older.
* Must pass a background check per applicable state cannabis regulations.
* Must obtain and maintain state cannabis agent registration or badging if required for the role.
* Availability for occasional weekend or after-hours support as needed.

Terrabis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

04f5ee8a92839cd10ba3.title: Global Business Operations Manager
04f5ee8a92839cd10ba3.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

**Business Requirements Management**

* Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
* Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
* Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
* Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.

**Exception & Change Control Management**

* Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
* Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
* Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.

**Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management**

* Coordinate rollout of CRM capabilities, governance initiatives, and business process changes across the assigned zone.
* Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
* Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.
* Confirm country readiness against defined launch criteria and consolidate the results into a zone readiness view, including data readiness, business owner assignment, process documentation, training completion, and support model alignment.
* Coordinate post-launch stabilization with zone and country roles by tracking issue volume, adoption gaps, training needs, and open decisions until countries reach steady-state operations.

**Performance Monitoring**

* Track adoption and governance metrics at both zone and country levels.
* Analyze CRM utilization and performance trends across countries to identify shared improvement opportunities and country-specific needs.
* Coordinate remediation plans with zone and country owners for markets with low adoption or compliance metrics.
* Prepare consolidated zone scorecards and country-level management summaries covering CRM adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, and remediation progress.
* Identify recurring issues across countries and propose zone or global process, training, reporting, or system improvements to prevent repeat gaps.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong relationships across zone leadership, country commercial and CRM teams, CRM Excellence, Data & Analytics, and IT and Digital teams.
* Facilitate structured feedback loops among global, zone, and country teams, ensuring decisions, actions, and accountability are cascaded across levels.
* Bring zone and country stakeholders together around shared priorities, cross-country dependencies, and coordinated plans to achieve business goals.

**Success Metrics**

**CRM Adoption**

* Opportunity management compliance
* CRM utilization rates
* Forecast quality improvements
* CRM data quality and pipeline hygiene performance
* User adoption metrics

**Governance**

* Policy compliance rates
* Country audit findings
* Process standardization adoption
* Reduction in approved local deviations and governance exceptions over time

**Stakeholder Support**

* Country satisfaction scores
* Timely resolution of escalations
* Deployment success of global initiatives
* Established zone governance cadence with coordinated country action plans and clear ownership

**Transformation**

* Rollout readiness achievement
* Change adoption effectiveness
* Execution of country transformation plans

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Information Systems, or related field.

**Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in:
  + Sales Operations
  + Commercial Excellence
  + CRM administration or support

e9edfa01a3aaf2524d7d.title: Billing Specialist (SaaS Billing)
e9edfa01a3aaf2524d7d.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

The Accounting Business Unit at Fullsteam supports the financial health and growth of the company and its subsidiaries through accurate, efficient billing, accounts receivable, and collections processes. As Fullsteam expands through acquisitions, the Accounting Shared Services team plays a key role in standardizing workflows, integrating systems, and maintaining revenue integrity.

The **Billing Specialist** supports multiple Business Units (BUs) by managing billing transactions, resolving account discrepancies, and maintaining accurate customer records. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a customer-focused approach to ensure timely billing and efficient financial operations.

**Note:**

* This is a remote role with occasional required attendance at our Markham office, including regular monthly and quarterly team meetings. Advance notice will be provided.
* New hires must attend onboarding in person at our Markham office during their initial onboarding period.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Billing Operations

* Generate, review, send, modify, and terminate invoices and subscriptions accurately and on schedule.
* Create subscriptions, sales orders, and estimates as applicable.
* Process recurring, one-time, and usage-based billing, including importing billing files.
* Manage billing adjustments, refunds, account credits, tax exemptions, and payment applications.
* Manage subscriptions in NetSuite and Zuora, ensuring product access is appropriately suspended upon cancellation.
* Resolve billing and payment processing issues, including Paystand-related issues.
* Monitor billing transactions and investigate discrepancies or irregularities.

Account Reconciliation

* Reconcile billing records, customer accounts, payment transactions, and financial statements.
* Investigate discrepancies and assist with reconciling undeposited funds.
* Reconcile payments against Business Unit records and AR aging to ensure accurate dunning notices.
* Collaborate with Finance and Accounting teams to support accurate financial reporting.

Customer Support and Collaboration

* Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, payments, credit card applications, disputes, and account adjustments.
* Partner with Corporate, Business Unit management, Sales, Customer Service, Support, Revenue, and Operations teams to resolve billing issues and implement requested changes.
* Maintain professional, timely communication to support positive customer relationships.

Process Improvement and Compliance

* Identify opportunities to improve billing workflows, efficiency, and automation.
* Document procedures and maintain consistent processes across multiple Business Units.
* Follow applicable billing, payment security, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of SaaS billing models, payment processing, accounts receivable, general ledger concepts, and account reconciliation.
* Experience using ERP and billing platforms, particularly NetSuite and Zuora SuiteBilling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
* High attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines across multiple Business Units.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to analyze billing and payment data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a customer-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, acquisition-driven environment.
* Commitment to accurate financial reporting, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in billing, accounts receivable, or a related financial role.
* SaaS billing experience required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, NetSuite, and Zuora SuiteBilling.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience with FloQast and CRM platforms such as Salesforce is an asset.
* Knowledge of billing-related regulatory and compliance requirements is an asset.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Salary Range: $55,000–$65,000 CAD**

Fullsteam recognizes that your health and wellbeing are a priority. This is why we offer a full suite of benefits that include:  

* Medical
* Extended Health and LTD plan
* Dental
* Vision
* RRSP (with employer match)
* Health Spending Account
* Flexible paid time off

This posting is for an existing vacancy and will remain open until filled.

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

f87055cb5703f55f7ae7.title: Field Consultant, CLESS (Construction Defect)
f87055cb5703f55f7ae7.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

#LI-KP1

#LI-Remote

**Job Description Summary**

Do you have a strong desire to resolve insurance claims by providing prompt, courteous and fair service to customers? Are you a skilled investigator, negotiator and communicator? If you thrive in an environment where you can problem-solve claims resolution, while following processes that provide fair resolution, customer satisfaction and cost management, then we want to hear from you!
  
  
As a Field Consultant, we’ll count on you to promote and provide exemplary customer service. You’ll analyze, review and adjust commercial casualty claims, most of which are of a serious and complex nature. We’ll need you to investigate and evaluate property damage and negotiation resolutions. You’ll handle lawsuit files and oversee defense counsel activities. You’ll be responsible for the disposition of claims, according to your prescribed authority. In addition, you’ll have opportunities to provide advice, counsel and training to Claims representatives.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Responsible for the most serious and complex commercial bodily injury and/or property damage claims. Makes decisions within maximum authorization; recommends settlement values in the disposition of serious and complex claims. Adheres to high standards of professional conduct while delivering superior claims service.
* Plans and meets all deadlines necessary to promptly and effectively apply best claims practices to resolve all assigned cases in accordance with company guidelines.
* Uses various methods of settlement in cases where warranted. Assigns cases to outside vendors as warranted.
* Provides reserve analysis to ensure timely and accurate case reserves in accordance with best claims practices.
* Maintains current knowledge of assigned insurance lines; court decisions which may impact the claims function; current guidelines in the claims function; and policy changes and modifications. This may require attendance at various seminars or training sessions.
* May provide advice, counsel and training to Claims representatives of all levels. Provides specialized training and consultation to non-claims areas as requested.
* Creates and analyzes severe incident reports, reinsurance reports and other information to home office, claims management, and underwriting.
* Oversees defense counsel in all lawsuit activities throughout the life of the claim.
* Provides specialized training and consultation to non-claims areas as requested.
* Delivers a positive customer service experience to all internal, external, current and prospective Nationwide customers.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

**Reporting Relationships**: Reports to Commercial Claims Manager/Director. Direct and indirect reports not typically assigned.

**Typical Skills and Experiences**:

**Education:** Undergraduate degree or post-graduate studies preferred.

**License/Certification/Designation:** State licensing where required. Successful completion of required/applicable claims certification training/classes.

**Experience:** Eight years commercial casualty claims handling experience preferred.

**Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:** Superior knowledge of best claims practices used to resolve the most severe and complex bodily injury and property commercial claims. Knowledge of insurance contracts, medical terminology and legal aspects of court procedures affecting legal liability for all lines of insurance. Ability to operate various claims systems and related software. Proven ability to meet customer needs and provide exemplary service by informing customers of the claims process and ensuring a positive customer experience. Analytical skills to make independent decisions and resolve conflict in such areas as application of coverage to submitted claims, application of laws of jurisdiction to investigation facts, application of policy exclusions and exceptions. Ability to coordinate with defense counsel in the handling of cases involving serious and sometimes complex liability issues from inception through trial. Command of written and verbal communication skills for contact and/or negotiation. Organizational skills to effectively establish work priorities in accordance with objectives and standards. Ability to operate personal computer and related software.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by business unit executive and Human Resources.

**Values**: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

**Job Conditions**:

**Overtime Eligibility:** Exempt (Not Eligible)

**Working Conditions:** Normal office or field claims environment. May require ability to sit and use telephone and personal computer for extended periods of time. Representatives must be able to operate an automobile and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record. Must be able to make physical inspections of accident scenes and property loss sites. Must be able to climb ladders, balance at various heights, stoop, bend and/or crawl to inspect vehicles and structures. Must be able to work outside in all types of weather. Must be able and willing to work irregular hours and to travel with possible overnight requirements. May be on-call. Must be available to work catastrophes (CAT).

**ADA:** The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

**Credit/Background Check:** Due to the fiduciary accountabilities within this job, a valid credit check and/or background check will be required as part of the selection process.

We currently anticipate accepting applications until 11/26/2026. However, we encourage early submissions, as the posting may close sooner if a strong candidate slate is identified before the deadline.

**Benefits**

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.

This position could be filled within any of the lower 48 U.S. states.Smoke-Free Iowa Statement: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company, its affiliates and subsidiaries comply with the Iowa Smokefree Air Act. Smoking is prohibited in all enclosed areas on or around company premises as well as company issued vehicles. The company offers designated smoking areas in which smoking is permitted at each individual location. The Act prohibits retaliation for reporting complaints or violations. For more information on the Iowa Smokefree Air Act, individuals may contact the Smokefree Air Act Helpline at 888-944-2247.  
  
For NY residents please review the following state law information: Notice of Employee Rights, Protections, and Obligations LS740 (ny.gov) https://dol.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2022/02/ls740\_1.pdf

**NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:**

We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The **Cancer Care Executive** (CCE) is a senior strategic program leader within Varian’s Cancer Care Programmatic Services (CCPS), responsible for shaping, supporting, and scaling comprehensive oncology programs that transform cancer care. This role builds and strengthens long-term partnerships with cancer providers, cancer systems, and governments to enable high-quality, patient-centered care through innovative clinical, operational, financial and digital programs.

The CCE serves as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and is accountable for developing holistic cancer care program—integrating Varian and Siemens Healthineers technology, services, and global expertise with the unique needs of each partner.

Location: Flexible within the US. Field-based with Americas Travel.

**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Strategic Leadership & Customer Engagement**

* Act as the executive face of CCPS to healthcare leaders, government ministries, and key partners.
* Build high-trust relationships with C-level stakeholders, positioning Varian as a long-term partner in transforming oncology care.
* Lead executive-level discussions around care delivery, Programmatic design, financing, workforce optimization, and digital enablement.
* Ensure alignment of Varian’s portfolio and CCPS offerings with customer needs and health system priorities.

**Programmatic & Partnership Development**

* Design and oversee cancer care prorgams that may include network development, care model redesign, access expansion, and operational efficiency initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal business areas/lines to create CCPS solution contracts tailored to customer needs
* Negotiate, structure, and support execution of long-term agreements, including performance-based and value-oriented/ results-focused contracts.
* Drive sustainable revenue growth by advancing CCPS engagement pipeline and closing strategic deals.

**Execution & Impact**

* Act as executive sponsor on key customer engagements, ensuring high customer satisfaction and long-term value realization.

**Qualifications**  
**Education & Experience**

* Advanced degree in Healthcare Administration, Medicine, Business, or related field (MBA, MPH, MD, PhD preferred).
* 10+ years of leadership experience in oncology, healthcare strategy, consulting, or healthcare delivery systems.
* Proven track record of working with hospital executives, health systems, or government stakeholders on large-scale healthcare initiatives.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of the cancer care continuum and evolving oncology ecosystem.
* Strong executive presence, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to design and structure complex partnerships, including financial and contractual models.

* Proven ability to drive cross-functional collaboration in a global matrix environment.

**Impact & Opportunities**  
The Cancer Care Executive plays a pivotal role in advancing Varian’s mission of “a world without fear of cancer” by:

5e9a10c5dc6f698e915d.title: Clinical Operations Specialist, Medical Assistant
5e9a10c5dc6f698e915d.description:
**Rothman Orthopaedics** is looking to hire a full time **Medical Assistant** to work as a **Clinical Operations Specialist** based in our **Malvern, PA** office. This position will require travel to our office in West Chester as needed for coverage purposes.

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM

**Job Summary:**

The Clinical Operations Specialist provides a blend of clinical and operations support to the office. Clinically, the COS will function as a Medical Assistant, Non-Surgical Clinical Assistant, or any other applicable clinical role as needed. In this capacity they will ensure the smooth flow of patients during office hours and support a variety of clinical and administrative functions. Operationally, the COS will serve as a Front Desk Receptionist or Front Desk Therapy Receptionist. The team member is responsible for greeting, checking in, verifying insurance, obtaining insurance referrals and any other applicable administrative tasks as needed. In this role the COS serves as a liaison between the patient and the medical staff in the office. The COS is an Operational role designed to meet the operational needs of the office - regular travel and schedule flexibility are inherent in this position.

**Key Accountabilities:**

Excellence in patient satisfaction, compliance with schedule prepping, responsiveness to voicemails, emails, and clinical messages, timeliness with pre-certifications and authorizations, compliance with all clinical policies and procedures, and adherence to documentation standards. Accurate collection of copays and capturing of referrals, efficient documentation of demographic and insurance information, obtaining referrals, excellence in time management and indepedent problem solving ability. As this is a support role designed to fill operational needs, utmost reliability and punctuality are vital.

**Essential Duties:**

* Greet patients and visitors in a prompt, courteous, helpful manner. When applicable, maintain flow of patients from waiting room to exam room to discharge. Upon completion of their appointment, direct them to surgery scheduling and/or to the exit.
* Demonstrates a commitment to delivering unsurpassed service and quality patient care recognized by Patients, Physicians, Clinical Teams, Peers
* Check patients in by entering, verifying, and updating demographic and insurance information. Record arrival times, referral information, and payment information.
* Ensure RCM Console and Ready to Bill errors are addressed daily to ensure timely claims submission. Ensure referrals have been received, are in the patient's chart and attached
* Make follow up appointments for patients when needed or act as liaison to appropriate ancillary departments such as physical therapy and MRI.
* Answer telephone calls in friendly and professional manner, answer questions within their scope of knowledge, forward/transfer calls to the appropriate team members or take messages as needed. Handle correspondence within 24 hours of reception.
* Assist patients with ambulatory difficulties through the office.
* Follow procedure for requests for medical records and for Disability/FMLA paperwork. Take payment when necessary and document requests in the patient chart.
* Accurately batch out at end of shift and ensure all payments balance. Complete assigned paperwork and escalate any discrepancies to the office manager.
* Assist other team members with upset or irate patients by deescalating the situation and providing support.
* Maintain workspace in a neat and organized manner. Stock supplies in the lobby, front desk, pod workspaces, and exam rooms.
* Prep the schedule by obtaining referrals, confirming coverage status, and checking for any potential issues in advance of patient appointments. Reach out to patients prior to appointment when needed. Print out front sheets, last notes, and other requested documentation for the physician team.
* Attend meetings, participate in office activities, teambuilding exercises or special projects as required. Exemplify the culture and values of the organization in all interactions.
* Clean and autoclave instruments using proper sterile technique.
* Records vitals and medical history in the patient chart in accordance with MIPS guidelines, scan all pertinent documents into patient chart, obtain and record vitals, request and make available reports and images from outside facilities.
* Pull up/load/import pertinent studies for the physician, prepare for injection and aspiration procedures, dispose of biohazardous waste in accordance with OSHA regulations, replace sharps containers when full.
* Bring patients back to see the physician in efficient and timely manner; assist patients with clothing and preparing the body area to be examined. Empty and restock laundry.
* Complete pre-certifications and authorizations for imaging studies and injectable medications. Submit requests for authorizations to centralized departments as applicable. Provide follow up care and instructions to patients at conclusion of their appointment.
* Applies or removes casts/splints. Make orthotic devices by bending, forming and shaping materials to prescribed specifications. Fit, test and evaluate devices on patients and make adjustments for proper fit, function and comfort.
* Reads and responds to email communications within appropriate time frame.
* Identifies weekly schedule, including schedule changes, published by manager.
* Handle specimens (including urine, blood and drainage from incisions, aspirated fluids, etc.) and label accordingly. Follow order instructions of provider to ensure specimen is sent to appropriate lab for analyzation.

**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or GED minimum education requirement
* Active National Medical Assistant Certification preferred, but not required
* Current CPR certification required
* Minimum (1) year in a medical office environment
* Medical office procedures and terminology
* Computer skills including, but not limited to, MS Office Suite
* Experience with scheduling and billing systems and EMR preferred
* Basic medical assistant skills including phlebotomy, handling of body fluid samples, removal of sutures and staples, and OSHA regulations preferred

**Pay Range:**

$17.00/hr - $24.00/hr

**Our Commitment to Employees:**

Come work at Rothman Orthopaedics! Our employees are our single greatest asset, as such, we strive to provide a professional, nurturing environment where every member of our team can make a meaningful difference in the lives of others. Our employees enjoy competitive pay, comprehensive health and dental benefits, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, and retirement savings plans.

Rothman Orthopaedics is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regards to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We value developing an inclusive and equitable environment that strengthens our organization and allows us to better attract and retain a diverse workforce that is representative of our patients and our community. We model our values by creating and enacting practices that encourage participation from all backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

8ba2f34ebb698d11a611.description:
Vida is looking for a licensed RN or LPN to manage clinical review requests, escalations, and member inquiries in a fully remote, virtual care setting. You’ll analyze medical records, investigate concerns from members and internal teams, and see each case through to resolution. Along the way, you’ll help shape quality, safety, and process improvements across our clinical operations.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Intake, triage, track, and respond to clinical review requests, escalations, and inquiries in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Review and analyze patient medical records, extracting relevant clinical information for presentation to providers and leadership as needed.
* Investigate and address clinical escalations originating from members, Member Support, Account Management, Clinical Operations, and other internal stakeholders.
* Respond to member inquiries professionally, compassionately, and in accordance with Vida clinical guidelines and program requirements.
* Collaborate closely with Providers, Clinical Assistants, and cross-functional teams to support continuity of care and efficient resolution of member concerns.
* Monitor cases through resolution and ensure timely follow-up and documentation.
* Support quality assurance initiatives by identifying trends, process improvement opportunities, and potential member safety concerns.
* Assist with provider performance monitoring, quality reviews, and operational audits as assigned.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely documentation within all required systems.
* Utilize provider messaging platforms, templates, workflows, and telehealth technologies efficiently and appropriately.
* Perform all duties within the scope of practice and in accordance with Vida clinical guidelines.
* Additional responsibilities as needed.

### **Qualifications:**

* Active RN or LPN license in good standing.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in a primary care, family medicine, internal medicine, or outpatient clinical setting.
* Experience reviewing medical records and clinical documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proven ability to analyze situations, identify issues, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment.
* Strong computer and technology proficiency.
* Able to efficiently utilize cloud-based technologies including Slack, Google Workspace, Zendesk, Zoom, electronic medical records, and telehealth platforms.
* Able to navigate multiple systems simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
* Commitment to providing compassionate, patient-centered support.
* Able to adapt to evolving workflows, technology platforms, and operational processes.

### **Preferred:**

* Experience in a telehealth or virtual care environment.
* Experience with utilization management, prior authorizations, or clinical review processes.
* Experience supporting obesity medicine, chronic disease management, primary care, or population health programs.
* Experience with quality assurance, compliance, clinical operations, or care coordination activities.
* Familiarity with electronic prescribing systems and electronic medical records.

8b43c09995dc4fa96206.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
8b43c09995dc4fa96206.description:
Description:

**Overall Purpose:** Will support the administration and continuous improvement of the company's quality management processes. This position focuses on quality documentation, customer communication, nonconformance management, corrective actions, and maintaining compliance with applicable quality standards and customer requirements. The Quality Assurance Specialist will work closely with customers and internal departments, including sales, customer service, operations, and purchasing, to investigate quality concerns, coordinate timely resolutions, maintain accurate records, and prevent recurring issues.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality Systems and Documentation**

* Maintain quality management system documentation, including procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other controlled documents.
* Ensure quality records are accurate, complete, organized, and maintained in accordance with company procedures and applicable requirements.
* Prepare and maintain certificates of conformance, material certifications, quality reports, and other customer-required documentation.
* Assist with maintaining compliance with ISO 9001 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Coordinate document updates, revisions, approvals, and distribution to ensure employees have access to current documentation.
* Support internal and external quality audits by organizing records, gathering documentation, and coordinating responses to audit findings.
* Maintain tracking logs and reports for customer complaints, nonconformances, corrective actions, and other quality-related activities.

**Customer Quality Support**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer quality inquiries, documentation requests, and quality-related concerns.
* Communicate with customers to gather information, clarify specifications or requirements, and coordinate the resolution of quality issues.
* Coordinate responses to customer complaints and ensure appropriate internal personnel are engaged in the investigation and resolution process.
* Prepare and submit customer responses, corrective action reports, and supporting documentation within established deadlines.
* Monitor open customer quality issues and provide timely status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain professional, responsive relationships with customers while helping protect customer satisfaction and confidence in Gallagher Fluid Seals.
* Partner with sales and customer service to ensure quality requirements and customer expectations are clearly understood and communicated internally.

**Nonconformance and Corrective Action Management**

* Document and track nonconformances, customer complaints, supplier issues, and internal quality concerns.
* Coordinate root cause investigations with relevant departments to identify contributing factors and determine appropriate corrective actions.
* Facilitate the assignment, implementation, and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor corrective action due dates and verify that required documentation and supporting evidence are completed.
* Assist in evaluating the effectiveness of corrective actions and identifying opportunities to prevent recurrence.
* Escalate overdue actions, recurring issues, and significant quality concerns to management.
* Maintain organized records of investigations, resolutions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement.

**Continuous Improvement and Reporting**

* Compile and analyze quality-related data, including customer complaints, nonconformance trends, corrective action status, and recurring issues.
* Prepare periodic quality reports and performance metrics for management review.
* Identify trends and opportunities to improve processes, documentation, communication, and customer satisfaction.
* Support process improvement initiatives in collaboration with operations and other departments.
* Assist with the preparation and coordination of management reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
* Help promote consistent adherence to quality procedures and a culture of accountability throughout the organization.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; an associate degree or additional relevant education is preferred.
* Experience in quality assurance, quality systems, customer service, manufacturing administration, or a related role.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with customers.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple issues, deadlines, and follow-up activities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to coordinate investigations across departments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and handle customer and company information professionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting an ISO 9001 quality management system.
* Familiarity with corrective and preventive action processes, root cause analysis, and nonconformance reporting.
* Experience preparing customer corrective action responses, such as 8D reports, or similar documentation.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial distribution, gasket fabrication, or industrial sealing products.
* Familiarity with certificates of conformance, material certifications, customer specifications, and supplier documentation.
* Experience with ERP systems or electronic document control systems.
* Exposure to internal audits, external audits, and management review processes.

**Physical Demands:**

* The employee is regularly required to move throughout the facility
* Presence at KOP facility is required on a regular basis
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* The employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee is required to use hands and fingers to pick, feel, and/or inspect material. The employee will also reach with arms and hands as needed.
* Ability to lift 25 – 50 pounds on occassion
