02ac7c9d5cca9509b081.title: QE Automation Engineer
02ac7c9d5cca9509b081.description:
Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information.

Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process.

Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com**

Kapitus has helped small and midsize businesses access capital for two decades, funding roughly $2 billion to date and building toward $6 billion and beyond. We originate, decision, fund, and service financing every day across a growing set of products and partner channels. As we scale, we are investing in the technology and quality foundation that growth depends on.

We are building an automated regression capability that lets us release faster with higher confidence, and we are hiring senior QE engineers to design and build the automated suites that make it real. You will work across the product with cross-functional teams, writing and maintaining scalable Playwright and TypeScript automation that runs in our pipelines and catches problems before customers do, and you will help convert today's manual regression into reliable, reusable automation.

**What You Will Do:**

* Partner with the team: Work with developers, product managers, and business analysts to understand requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Automate across layers: Design and implement automated coverage for functional, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Build and maintain the framework: Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automated frameworks and scripts using Playwright with TypeScript.
* Validate API:. Develop and execute automated API tests to validate system functionality, integrations, and reliability.
* Troubleshoot with developers: Work closely with developers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues, providing timely feedback.
* Engage in Agile ceremonies: Take part in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Harden regression suites: Build and maintain reliable automated regression suites that validate software stability and release readiness.
* Integrate into CI/CD. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor results, and improve reliability and feedback speed.
* Convert manual to automated: Convert existing manual test cases into automated coverage, capturing domain knowledge so nothing is lost as automation grows.
* Stay current: Track fintech industry trends, emerging tools, and best practices in QA and the financial domain.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 5-7+ years as a QA or QE engineer, with substantial hands-on test-automation experience.
* Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and review automated test scripts using Playwright with TypeScript.
* Strong understanding of automation framework architecture, test design patterns, maintainability, and quality-engineering best practices.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and Swagger.
* Experience testing Salesforce solutions and full-stack applications across UI, API, integration, and data layers.
* Experience with version control including GitHub, Bitbucket, and SourceTree.
* Experience with Jira for project and bug tracking, and Confluence and Zephyr Scale for documentation.
* Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum and experience working in Agile environments.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, working effectively within a cross-functional team.
* Experience in the financial services industry is a plus.
* Test automation: functional, regression, API, integration, and end-to-end automated testing.
* Automation framework: advanced hands-on Playwright and TypeScript, or comparable modern automation technologies.
* Application platforms: hands-on testing of Salesforce and full-stack applications, including front-end, back-end, API, integration, and data-layer validation.
* API testing: Postman and Swagger.
* Version control: GitHub, Bitbucket, SourceTree.
* Project management and bug tracking: Jira.
* Documentation: Confluence and Zephyr Scale.
* Basic knowledge of security and performance testing.

**Nice to Have:**

* Additional languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript.
* Experience with Selenium, Pytest, and Jenkins.
* Familiarity with AWS services and cloud-computing concepts

  

**Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:**

* **Competitive Salary** **Range** of $96,300-$154,400 annually. Kapitus is providing this as a good faith salary range to comply with applicable law. The applicant's final salary will depend on a number of factors including the applicant's geographic location, skills, and experience
* **Annual Incentive Compensation Eligibility** – Up to 10% annually

* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.
* **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out-of-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well-being.
* **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.
* **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.
* **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.
* **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include:
  + Pet and car insurance discounts.
  + Financial services such as LegalShield.
  + Relaxation and stress management tools.
* **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life.
* **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities.
* **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.**
* **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary.

  

**About Kapitus:**

Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth.

**Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity.

**Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.**

d69b24ec0e1f2d8dc56d.title: Lead Software Test Engineer, Safety Critical Embedded Systems
d69b24ec0e1f2d8dc56d.description:
**About Forterra**  
  
At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

**About the role**

Forterra is looking for a Lead Software Test Engineer to establish and run verification and validation for the

safety critical embedded software used on our autonomous ground vehicles. This is initially an individual

contributor role. You will set the software test approach, build the automation and test environments,

execute the work, and maintain the evidence needed for customer and safety reviews. You will work

closely with software, systems, and safety engineers to find problems early and make sure the software

behaves correctly when things go wrong. As the capability grows, the role may develop into a technical

lead for a small test team

Someone who can build a practical software test capability from the ground up and is comfortable

working directly in the code, test environments, and evidence. This person should be able to work across

software, systems, and safety engineering while staying focused on finding meaningful failures and

making the product more dependable

**What you'll do**

* Set the verification and validation approach for safety critical embedded software from kickoff through qualification, including the test plan, test procedures, results, and reports.
* Turn system, software, and safety related requirements into practical tests with objective pass or fail criteria.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, tests, results, and anomalies.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks for embedded software, including software in the loop and hardware in the loop environments.
* Exercise failure behavior through fault injection, timing and jitter tests, communications failures, memory faults, power and clock faults, negative tests, boundary tests, and stress tests.
* Use static analysis, dynamic analysis, and coverage results to find gaps and help the team close them.
* Prepare and maintain test evidence, including plans, procedures, results, V&V matrices, compliance matrices, anomaly records, tool qualification records, and contributions to the safety case.
* Work with software, systems, and safety engineers to review designs for testability, improve requirements, and support technical reviews and assessments.
* Provide technical guidance through test plan reviews, design reviews, pairing, and mentoring.
* Help establish the practices and infrastructure needed to grow a small software test capability.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of experience testing embedded systems or safety critical software.
* Strong working knowledge of C or C++ and Python for test automation.
* Experience working with requirements management and requirements traceability using tools such as Jama or DOORS.
* Familiarity with MISRA C or MISRA C++, static analysis, and structural coverage methods such as branch coverage and MC/DC.
* Experience testing software on an RTOS such as QNX, including work with embedded targets, debuggers, and instrumentation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to separate hardware, software, and firmware problems in a complex system.
* A practical, organized approach to managing several priorities and producing clear technical documentation.
* Ability to work remotely with up to 25% travel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience applying safety critical development and assurance standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508,
* DO-178C, MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH, or JS-SSA-IG.
* Experience with QNX, Linux, NXP S32G, or similar embedded platforms.
* Experience with CAN, CAN-FD, Ethernet, UDS, J1939, or other vehicle networks and diagnostic protocols.
* Understanding of robotics domains such as motion control, planning, perception, fault management, and vehicle interfaces.
* Experience integrating electromechanical systems in automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, defense, or similar environments.
* Experience providing technical leadership through design reviews, mentoring, or improvements to shared test and development practices.

US Salary Range  
$125,000.00.—$150,000.00 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate and is based on a wide variety of compensation factors. The salary offered to candidates will vary based on a variety of factors including (but not limited to) relevant work experience, education, specialized training, critical expertise, training, and more. Equity in Forterra is included in most of our full-time, high-demand roles and is therefore considered part of Forterra’s overall compensation package. In addition to base salary and equity, Forterra offers competitive benefits for full-time employees including:

* Premium Healthcare Benefits: Three plan options, including an HSA-eligible plan, with Forterra covering 80% of the plan premium for you and your dependents.
* Basic Life/AD&D, short and long-term disability insurance plans 100% covered by Forterra, plus the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents.
* Extremely generous company holiday calendar including a winter break in December.
* Competitive paid time off (PTO) offering 20 days accrued per year.
* A minimum of 7 weeks fully paid parental leave for birth/adoption.
* A $9k annual tuition reimbursement or professional development stipend.
* Fully stocked beverage refrigerators with all the Celsius your little heart desires.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan, including traditional, Roth 401(k), and after-tax deferral with company match up to 4%.

Your recruiter will be able to share more information about our salary and benefits offering during the hiring process.

**CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position may require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.** For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here.

Forterra is an equal-opportunity employer, providing and promoting equal employment opportunity in all personnel practices. Forterrans are unique, talented individuals who are united through a shared passion to deliver autonomous systems that enable national resilience and a robust supply chain.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran and disability status, and criminal history, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

Forterra is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

04560650add30eecbd84.description:
**Quality Assurance Engineer (L3)**
===================================

NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.) | Full-time | Engineering | Reports to: Quality Assurance Lead

**Who we are.**
---------------

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

*Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup*

**The Quality Assurance Engineer Role.**
----------------------------------------

Our customers rely on Reality Defender to make high-stakes calls in real time — whether the voice on a bank's phone line or the face in a job interview is real. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll make sure what we ship holds up to that standard, testing our APIs, SDKs, web app, and real-time integrations, and building the automation that lets us release faster without breaking things. This is a full-time role based at our NYC headquarters or remote within the U.S., reporting to Quality Assurance Lead. Responsibilities include:

* Own test planning and execution for assigned product areas — APIs, SDKs, the web app, and real-time voice and video integrations — from requirements review through release sign-off.
* Build and maintain automated test suites (API, end-to-end, and regression) and integrate them into our CI/CD pipelines.
* Find, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact, and work with engineers through to resolution.
* Test the reliability and performance of real-time detection under realistic conditions — latency, load, varied audio and video quality, and different platforms and devices.
* Help maintain the test data and media sets used to validate each release.
* Partner with the AI Research and Red Team to support model release validation and regression testing.
* Help Customer Support and Solutions Engineering reproduce and triage customer-reported issues.
* Contribute to QA standards, documentation, and release checklists across the engineering team.

**Who you are.**
----------------

* 3+ years of experience in software QA or quality engineering, testing web applications and APIs in a fast-moving release environment.
* Hands-on experience writing automated tests in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar, using frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or code-based API tests) and working within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).
* Strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to finding edge cases — you think about how things break, not just whether they work.
* Clear written communication: your bug reports and test plans are easy for engineers to act on.
* Experience testing audio, video, or real-time communication products (WebRTC, telephony, conferencing). (nice to have)
* Experience testing ML-powered products or working with test datasets. (nice to have)
* Exposure to performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust, JMeter). (nice to have)

**Within 12 months, you'll…**
-----------------------------

* Own QA for multiple product areas with minimal oversight.
* Have helped establish quality metrics (escaped defects, coverage, release stability) that the team tracks and acts on.
* Be improving QA tooling and practices beyond your own areas.
* Be ready to take on broader scope and mentor newer QA team members.

**What we offer.**
------------------

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

* Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents
* Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents
* Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees
* FSA/HSA and 401k programs
* Equity compensation
* 20 days of PTO per year
* 12 weeks of Parental Leave
* Learning and Development budget
* Monthly wellness benefits
* Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

* Daily in-office lunch through UberEats
* Commuter benefits
* Remote Fridays
* Happy Hours and other local events

Base salary range: $120k-$150k, based on experience and location. Includes equity.

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

**About Care Access**

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.**

With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com.

### **How This Role Makes a Difference**

The **Manager, Data Quality** leads a centralized team of Data Coordinators responsible for accurate, timely, and complete clinical research data across the Care Access site network. The role turns study, sponsor, and organizational requirements into clear operating practices that protect data integrity and reduce administrative burden for site teams.

The Manager guides the team, plans workload, monitors quality, and partners across functions to identify discrepancies early, resolve issues quickly, and keep data reliable for research decisions.

### **How You'll Make An Impact**

* **People Leadership and Team Development:** Lead and support Data Coordinators by setting clear expectations, assigning work, coaching performance, and building team capability through training, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
* **Operational Oversight and Capacity Management:** Set daily and weekly priorities across assigned studies and sites, balancing team capacity with participant visits, sponsor timelines, monitoring activity, and database milestones. Identify risks early and adjust plans to maintain service levels.
* **Data Quality and Compliance Governance:** Maintain quality control practices for source review, EDC/CRF transcription, reconciliation, and documentation. Review performance trends and confirm activities align with protocol, GCP, sponsor requirements, and Care Access procedures.
* **Query and Issue Escalation Management:** Track open, aging, and high-risk queries; remove barriers to resolution; and coordinate escalations with site teams, investigators, sponsors, CROs, and internal quality and operational compliance partners. Ensure decisions and follow-up actions are documented in approved systems.
* Process Improvement and Reporting: Define and monitor site-level metrics for quality, timeliness, workload, and recurring issues. Standardize best practices, improve workflows, and communicate performance trends and risks to leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work with Clinical Operations, Operational Compliance, site leadership, and study teams to align data coordination activities with study requirements and network priorities. Join sponsor, monitoring, and internal operational meetings as needed.
* **Other Responsibilities:**  
  + Support the rollout of new studies, tools, reports, and process changes.
  + Contribute to audit and inspection readiness by reviewing follow-up items, trends, and quality issues.
  + Take on other duties and special projects that align with the role.

### **The Expertise Required**

* Strong understanding of clinical research data workflows, including source documentation, EDC/CRF entry, query management, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
* Ability to lead and develop a remote team, set accountability, and manage competing priorities.
* Working knowledge of GCP, protocol compliance, sponsor expectations, and quality management principles.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends and risks, and lead practical process improvements.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with site teams, investigators, sponsors, CROs, and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and clinical research systems, including EDC platforms and quality management systems.

### **Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience**

* Minimum Education:
  + High school diploma or GED required; bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, clinical research, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum Experience:
  + Five or more years of experience in clinical research, clinical data management, site coordination, or a related area required, including at least two years leading, coaching, or coordinating the work of others.
  + Experience supporting multi-site clinical research operations and sponsor-facing data activities preferred.
  + Experience reviewing, entering, reconciling, or maintaining structured data in electronic systems, spreadsheets, trackers, or databases.
  + Experience working with confidential or regulated information, with a focus on accuracy, documentation quality, and appropriate information handling.
  + Familiarity with electronic data capture systems, case report forms, clinical source documentation, and query resolution preferred.

### **How We Work Together**

* **Location**: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.
* **Travel**: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.
* **Physical demands associated with this position Include**: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $75,000 - $95,000 USD per year for full time team members.

### **Benefits & Perks (US Full Time Employees)**

* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Company Paid Holidays
* 100% Employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

* Bi-weekly HSA employer contribution

**Notice to Rhode Island applicants:** Care Access complies with Rhode Island law prohibiting smoking in enclosed areas within places of employment. Care Access is also subject to is subject to Chapters 29–38 of Title 28 of the Rhode Island General Laws.

**About the Role**

As a Quality Control Supervisor, you are responsible for ensuring food safety and quality standards are met by routine monitoring of receiving/distribution, production, and food storage activities. The QC Supervisor will oversee a team of Quality Control Associates and Quality Control Leads and ensure adherence to established food safety standards, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) throughout the food process flow.

This role operates within a fast-paced culinary manufacturing environment where associates work around production equipment, food preparation areas, and active operational workflows. Strict adherence to safety, sanitation, and food safety standards is required.

  
  

**Role Details**

* Pay Rate: $27.50
* Overnight shifts include an additional $2.00/hour premium, automatically applied to any hours worked between 11:00 PM and 5:00 AM
* Job Location: Swedesboro
* Position type: Full-Time

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the Quality Control (QC) team, monitoring performance, supporting scheduling, and coordinating shift coverage
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all QC checks, including daily task assignments, end-of-shift reports, and coordination with Production, Sanitation, and Facilities teams
* Review and verify USDA/FDA, food safety, sanitation, and production records; maintain record retention systems and prepare reports for USDA inspectors and FSQA requests
* Oversee QC equipment register, ensuring annual calibration compliance and accurate documentation of thermometers, scales, and sanitation chemical concentrations
* Conduct routine GMP audits, cleanliness inspections, adenosine triphosphate (ATP) swabbing, and weekly food safety inspections in coordination with the Sanitation team
* Monitor and document Critical Control Points (CCPs), including cold storage temperatures and the cooling of cooked products, ensuring full compliance with HACCP and Food Safety Plans
* Perform in-process and final product quality checks, including label verification, leak detection, and batch testing.
* Identify and manage non-conforming products, maintain hold logs, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)
* Support administrative functions including Quality Management System (QMS) and Safety Chain updates, trend analysis, SOP/document writing, and oversight of facilities’ temperature monitoring systems
* Maintain QC supply inventory and ensure sanitation team records (daily, weekly, monthly) are completed accurately and on time
* Monitor the receiving and delivery process for product received (fresh, frozen, and dry products) and confirm these products are received at required temperature; confirm/verify requirements as listed in HACCP Plan/Food Safety Plan)
* **Distribution Center -** Assist in facilitating the daily operations and activities in the outbound warehouse areas prior to dispatch, while ensuring food safety measures are met during the process
* Manage and support training initiatives
* Complete other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years of supervisory or related leadership experience in a Quality Control or Quality Assurance role in a Food Service Environment
* Experience supervising or leading team members
* 6+ months experience using technology such as smart phones and tablets, inputting, accessing, modifying, or outputting information
* Self-motivated and self-directed with strong communication skills
* Experience working in a USDA/FDA Regulated Facility or a GFSI certified facility preferred
* HACCP Certified or equivalent a plus
* PCQI Certified or equivalent a plus
* Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment
* Familiar with Xray/Metal Detector or similar Food Manufacturing equipment preferred
* Familiar with Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP) gas and/or Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) manufacturing preferred
* Ability to work effectively in team environments

**Requirements**

* 18 years old and legally authorized to work in the US
* Ability to read and comprehend safety policies and operational manuals in English; ability to communicate effectively with team members and follow verbal instructions to ensure a safe and productive work environment
* Able to lift, pull, and push 50 pounds of weight by oneself
* Able to stand a full shift while working
* Ability to perform repetitive tasks including bending, reaching, and squatting
* Able to work evenings and weekends
* Comfortable working in various temperatures including cold environments (34-40 degrees Fahrenheit depending on site) and occasional freezer temperatures that can range anywhere from 0-10 degrees Fahrenheit
* *This list of qualifications and requirements also reflects the qualifications and requirements used as vetting criteria for our AEDT (Automated Employment Decision Tool)*

With extensive experience in developing biologics and bioconjugates, we offer a seamless service delivered by fully integrated teams, from early discovery to commercial manufacturing.

We are Abzena. More than a CDMO, we are a responsible and dedicated partner that takes care of your products from concept to patient.

  
  

The Supervisor, Quality Operations leads day-to-day QA oversight for GMP manufacturing of intermediates and drug substances. This role directs and develops Quality Operations personnel, while ensuring compliant execution of on-floor support, documentation review, environmental monitoring, and batch disposition activities.

The Supervisor plans and prioritizes team workload, provides technical guidance, escalates quality risks, and partners with Manufacturing, Analytical Services, and other Quality functions to resolve issues in real time. be68cedb64715a2660be.title: Junior QA Engineer
be68cedb64715a2660be.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We’re building our quality practice from the ground up, and you’ll be our first dedicated QA team member. Today, testing is handled by our developers and product team. Our mobile app is built in React Native and ships on both iOS and Android. You’ll start with hands-on manual testing across both platforms, then build the foundations for automation: UI/UX regression tests and software test fixtures that simulate point-of-sale (POS) terminals, so we’re no longer tied to physical hardware for every test cycle. Much of that work will be done in TypeScript and Node.js, so this role is a good fit for someone who enjoys writing code, debugging, and building tools. Because there’s no established QA team yet, you’ll work closely with the engineering team and have real influence shaping how we test, what tools we use, and how quality is measured.

This is a great fit for a curious, self-motivated person who wants to learn fast, take ownership early, and help define what QA looks like at our company.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Create our first formal end-to-end manual test plans and execute them on iOS and Android for new features, bug fixes, and release candidates
* Write clear, reusable test cases from product requirements, designs, and user stories, and organize them into a living test library
* Identify, document, and track defects with precise reproduction steps, noting whether issues are platform-specific or shared across iOS and Android, and work directly with developers to verify fixes
* Use Node.js and TypeScript tooling to debug issues, inspect logs and API traffic, and help pinpoint root causes
* Perform exploratory testing to uncover edge cases, device and OS-version differences, and usability issues
* Help establish baseline QA processes: bug reporting standards, release checklists, and test documentation
* Begin building automated UI/UX regression tests for our React Native app
* Develop test fixtures and mock services in TypeScript and Node.js that simulate POS terminal behavior, reducing our reliance on physical hardware
* Help evaluate and recommend testing tools and frameworks, and bring automated tests into our CI/CD pipeline over time
* Partner with engineers and product managers during project planning, standups, and release readiness reviews

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* Hands-on programming experience in **TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js**. You’re comfortable writing scripts and small services, working with async code, using npm, and debugging with logs. Coursework, internships, bootcamps, and personal projects all count.
* Working familiarity with **React and React Native** (components, props, state, hooks, and how a UI renders), enough to understand how our app behaves and where bugs tend to come from. Building even a small React Native project, such as a personal or course app, is great preparation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and core QA concepts (test plans, test cases, regression and smoke testing, bug lifecycle)
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to problem-solving
* Self-motivation and comfort with ambiguity: you’ll often figure out the “how” yourself rather than follow an existing playbook
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to raise quality concerns with the engineering team and product stakeholders

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with React Native tooling such as Expo, Metro, or React Native debugging tools
* Experience with mobile UI automation frameworks such as Detox, Maestro, or Appium (WebdriverIO)
* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript testing tools such as Jest, Vitest, or React Native Testing Library
* Experience testing mobile apps on iOS and Android devices, simulators, and emulators (Xcode Simulator, Android Studio)
* Experience with Node.js servers or frameworks (e.g., Express, Fastify) and building or consuming REST APIs, WebSockets, or mock servers
* Experience with Git and basic version control workflows
* Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail)
* Familiarity with API tools like Postman
* Interest in or exposure to payments, POS systems, or hardware integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitrise, EAS)

**What You’ll Learn and Grow Into**
-----------------------------------

* Designing a scalable React Native UI automation framework from the ground up
* Building mocks, simulators, and test fixtures for hardware and payment integrations in a production-quality Node.js and TypeScript codebase
* Understanding how React Native apps interact with native iOS and Android layers, and where platform-specific bugs come from
* Gaining hands-on exposure to debugging distributed systems, including tracing issues across services, understanding common failure modes, and learning proven solution approaches alongside our engineers
* Defining QA standards and best practices that the company will build on
* Shifting quality left by partnering with developers earlier in the development cycle
* Growing into a senior or lead quality role as the QA function expands, with the chance to help hire and onboard future team members

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Direct access to our engineering team, who will support your technical growth and give you context on our codebase, architecture, and POS integrations
* High visibility and real ownership: your work will directly shape how we ship
* $60,000 - $80,000
* 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, with four Blue Cross Blue Shield medical plans to choose from (including an HSA-eligible option) and dental and vision through Guardian
* Unlimited PTO and a location-agnostic schedule, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.A.

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

Tabbed is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed.

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K

**Remote Customer Service Agent**

**Make an Impact Through Meaningful Work (and Actually Enjoy Where You Work)**

At Disabled Veteran Solutions (DVS), we do more than answer calls and close tickets. We help people access critical government-based programs and provide vital support to our network of mission-critical partners. Every conversation matters, and the support you provide genuinely changes someone's day.

We are looking for dedicated, tech-savvy, and people-first Remote Customer Service Agents. If you have remote experience and want an entry-level gateway into a long-term career where you can learn, grow, and thrive, you belong here.

This is a fully remote role. You can do your best work from the comfort of your own space-with no commute and no office distractions.

**TrainingOnboarding**: To set you up for absolute success, you will participate in a structured onboardingtraining program. **Training:** First two weeks following your start date **Schedule: 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

Update and Document Account Detail: Track communications, and identify areas where extra support can be offered, Accurately document all customer interactions, including inquiries, concerns, and resolutions Inbound Inquiry Handling: Answer inbound calls and emails to deliver a positive, solution-focused experience through the full customer and partner lifecycle. Technical Troubleshooting: Assist with basic technical troubleshooting, navigate web-based applications, and accurately create or escalate support tickets.

Appointment Management: Schedule appointments at designated service locations

Conducting follow-up calls to ensure issues are resolved and customers stay informed

Providing consistent, high-quality service in a structured, supportive environment

**What We Are Looking For:** We want dependable, thoughtful individuals who work well independently while staying connected to a remote team. While this is an entry-level position, strong tech skills and prior remote work experience are required.

**Required Qualifications:** High school diploma or GED (additional education preferred). Prior remote customer service experience, ideally in a call or ticket-based environment. Tech-savvy mindset with an in-depth understanding of web navigation, computer applications, and multitasking (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word). Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues independently and follow detailed directions. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to quickly build rapport. Comfort working remotely with minimal supervision in a structured environment. Ability to complete an extensive credentialing and background check process. Fluency in reading, writing, understanding, and speaking English language.

**Preferred Qualifications:** Bilingual (English/Spanish) skills are a strong plus.

**TechnicalWork Environment Requirements:** To set you up for success at home, you must provide: A reliable high-speed internet connection via a hardwired Ethernet cable (No Wi-Fi). A private, quiet, and distraction-free workspace. The ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously.

**ScheduleCompensation:** **Regular Schedule: A full-time, 8-hour shift scheduled within our operational window of 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM, Monday–Friday.** Consistency: Consistent attendance and reliability are essential for long-term growth. Compensation: Hourly pay $15.00 per hour, with room for advancement.

**Why Join DVS?** Disabled Veteran Solutions is a nationally recognized leader in business process outsourcing and a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB).

**Here is why people stay with us long-term:** Fully Remote: Work where you are most comfortable, focused, and productive.

Supportive Team: Work in a team-driven environment where people actually help each other succeed. Room to Grow: We love to promote from within. Supportive Culture: We operate in a team-driven environment where people help each other succeed. Work with Purpose: A workplace where your work has purpose – not just tasks.

**Ready to Join Us?** If you want a remote role where your work matters, your tech skills are valued, and you have a clear runway to build a long-term career, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and build a career with purpose at DVS.

19edb2ff24b4a0ef86f2.title: Strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager
19edb2ff24b4a0ef86f2.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Remote Location: Austin, TX; Boston, MA or Washington, DC

**Position Summary**
--------------------

At HackerOne, we are building a safer internet by connecting our customers with the expertise of the global security research community. As a Strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to some of our most complex enterprise customers, helping them maximize the value of HackerOne's platform, advance their security programs, and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

In this role, you will own strategic customer relationships, navigate complex business and technical challenges, and influence customer success strategies that drive retention, growth, and long-term advocacy. Beyond your individual portfolio, you will help elevate the effectiveness of our Customer Success organization by sharing expertise, strengthening best practices, and partnering across teams to deliver scalable improvements to the customer experience.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Austin, TX; Boston, MA or Washington, DC. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Own the strategic direction and post-onboarding success of a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise customers. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, align HackerOne's capabilities to evolving business and security objectives, and proactively drive measurable customer value, retention, and opportunities for growth.
* Apply **Data-Driven Decision Making** to evaluate customer program performance, identify trends and risks, and develop strategic recommendations that improve security outcomes and program maturity. Translate benchmarking, adoption insights, and customer data into compelling business narratives that influence customer priorities and internal decisions.
* Leverage **First Principles Problem Solving** to lead the resolution of complex customer challenges and escalations. Diagnose underlying business and technical issues, align cross-functional stakeholders, and develop durable solutions that address immediate customer needs while identifying opportunities for broader process and service improvements.
* Demonstrate **Change Agility** by guiding strategic customers through evolving security priorities, organizational changes, and new product capabilities. Anticipate challenges, adapt engagement strategies, and help customers navigate ambiguity while maintaining confidence, momentum, and measurable program outcomes.
* Champion an **AI First** approach by thoughtfully applying AI-powered tools to improve customer insights, identify emerging risks and opportunities, streamline repeatable workflows, and scale effective Customer Success practices. Share learnings and practical applications that help improve efficiency and effectiveness across the team.
* Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in HackerOne's platform, vulnerability disclosure, and bug bounty program management. a0f1758c818545a67f7e.title: Account Executive, Upsell
a0f1758c818545a67f7e.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

As an Account Executive on our customer expansion team, you'll help existing Steer customers get more value from our platform. This is a **full-cycle sales role**: you'll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You'll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you'll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We're looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

  

*The role is remote.*  
*Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.*

  

**What You'll Do**

* Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.
* Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
* Learn each shop's goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.
* Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.
* Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.
* Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.
* Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.
* Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.
* Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.
* A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.
* Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.
* Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

**Interview Process**

* Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

* Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

* Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

* Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

* Reference checks

**Benefits**

* 100% remote
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
* Generous parental leave
* FSA and HSA
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401(k)
* Learning stipend
* Work-from-home equipment
* Opportunities for career growth and development

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.
